articleTitle: Reliability modeling of systems with protective auxiliary components under imperfect inspections
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Systems with protective auxiliary component are common in engineering industry. The auxiliary components in these systems play an essential role to protect the main components from severe environment impact, however, dependence between the main and auxiliary components are usually ignored in most existing literatures. Besides, failures of auxiliary components are hidden in most systems since they do not halt the system. Therefore, inspections are necessary. In most existing studies, inspections are assumed to be perfect, which is not consistent with the reality. In this paper, a new reliability model is developed for systems with dependent main and auxiliary components under imperfect inspections. Some important indexes, such as system reliability and availability, are derived by the recursive and matrix methods, respectively. Thereafter, a numerical example is presented to illustrate the results and verify the correctness of the proposed method, in which influences of imperfect inspections are also studied by conducting sensitivity analysis on the inspection accuracy parameter.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic phased array inspection of defects in additive manufactured aluminum alloy considering velocity anisotropy
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The detection of defect in additive manufactured (AM) metal materials is of great importance for industrial applications, and remains a challenge due to the heterogeneity and anisotropic of AM materials. This study presents an internal defects detection method for WAAM aluminum alloy using phased-array ultrasound. The detailed ultrasonic testing guidance considering the properties of WAAM metal material for inspecting and locating the internal defects is provided. Phased array ultrasound multi-angle-scanning pattern is applied for detecting the AM parts more reliably. The multi-angle data fusion algorithm is applied to manage the raw data obtained by different angle beams for generating ultrasound data sets encoded with physical information. The velocity of ultrasound beams with different angles propagated in the WAAM material is investigated and the relationship between the velocity and the angle of incidence can be established using the quadratic regression analysis. A modified data fusion algorithm considering the actual velocity variations is proposed. Comparisons are made between the actual depth of the artificial defect in WAAM deposited 2319 aluminum alloy block and depth measured by data fusion algorithm without/with velocity anisotropy correction. Results show the modified algorithm improves the accuracy of defect localization.

articleTitle: A machine learning approach to reduce mental fatigue risk of pilots based on HRV data
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Fatigue is important in aviation because the risks associated with fatigue pose a threat to many people. The purpose of this study is to investigate the possibility of using a wearable ECG device to detect mental fatigue in pilots. 22 healthy individuals were recruited from Beihang University and each subject wore a Polar H10 heart rate band with a Polar IGNITE sports watch to record heart rate variability (HRV) data. To stimulate the fatigue state, each subject performed a simulated flight experiment of 1h and the number of blinks was recorded by the face recognition method as a label for fatigue. HRV data and blink frequency were collected every 5 minutes throughout the experiment. After feature selection, four HRV indicators SDNN, LF_HF, LF and VLF were extracted for subsequent analysis. Five machine learning algorithms: support vector machine (SVM), Random Forest, AdaBoost, K-nearest neighbor (KNN), Naïve Bayes (NB) were used to build a classifier for automatic detection of pilot fatigue. Naïve Bayes (NB) had the best performance and had an average CV F1 score of 0.9065 on the training set and 0.9250 on the test set.

articleTitle: Design and implementation for common mode voltage suppression algorithm of permanent magnet synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: With the aiming at inhibiting common mode voltage, reducing electromagnetic interference, and improving the service life of the motor, this paper making comparative study common mode voltage caused by of the traditional seven sections of SVPWM, five sections of SVPWM and nonzero vector PWM, which based on the principle of common-mode voltage production. Simulations and experiments show that nonzero vector PWM control strategy can reduce the value of common mode voltage to a third of the traditional control algorithm, which effectively restrains the common-mode voltage and improves the security and reliability of the motor.

articleTitle: Reliability acceptance test plan based on multi-level information
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The reliability acceptance test (RAT) is often used to decide whether the product should be accepted or rejected based on the reliability requirement. Conventional methods usually require long test duration and large test sample size or bring high risks for both costumer and producer. Therefore, in this paper, multi-source and multi-level information is used to circumvent the above limitations. Firstly, prior as well as the posterior distributions are given and posterior moments have been derived. Then, multi-level information can be converted into system based on system structure, and the RAT plan can be given based on multi-source and multi-level information fusion. Finally, this proposed method is applied to a numerical study and the results prove the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Study on high temperature storage reliability of crystal Oscillator
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: As the most accurate and stable oscillator, the crystal oscillator can provide a stable frequency signal source for the circuit. It has an extremely wide range of applications in various digital circuits and precision instruments, and is an important type of frequency control device. In the field of military and aerospace, crystal oscillators not only require good frequency accuracy and stability under long-term working conditions, but also require high storage reliability, which can meet the storage life requirements of products. In this paper, a high-temperature storage reliability study was conducted for a certain model of crystal oscillator. The high-temperature storage reliability test was designed and carried out. Through the degradation analysis and failure analysis of the test samples, the degradation trend of this model of crystal oscillator under high-temperature storage conditions and the failure mechanism of the leakage failure caused by the galvanic corrosion at the internal solder joints were found. The study in this paper has certain reference significance for the reliability research of crystal oscillator.

articleTitle: Topology optimization and lattice lightweight design of the Outsole of the return tank considering compound working conditions
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: On the premise of satisfying the safety of landing impact, the realization of lightweight design of the spacecraft return module is one of the key issues. Aiming at the lightweight design of the spacecraft return capsule under different conditions of hard landing, from the perspective of structural topology optimization calculation, the problem is studied and given based on the dynamic topology optimization of the Hybrid Cellular Automata (HCA) algorithm. The specific design plan is based on the LS-DYNA platform, and the dynamic impact topology optimization model of the return cabin under different working conditions is established. After analysis, the optimal material distribution and stiffener layout plans on the outsole structure was determined, and the conceptual design model of the outsole was obtained. Then use the body-centered cubic lattice structures to fill different areas of the outsole,and combine the size optimization technology to obtain the final lightweight outsole design plan. Compared with the traditional rib-skinned outsole structure, the design meets the safety requirements of hard landing while reducing the weight ratio to 24%. It demonstrates the dynamic topology optimization method based on the HCA algorithm in the lightweight design technology of the spacecraft return capsule. The feasibility and superiority in the additive manufacturing lattice lightweight designs method.

articleTitle: Features of folded-normal and quasi-normal distributions
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Modeling non-negative random variables needs to use distributions defined on the positive half-axis. It is desired that the distribution is analytically tractable. The 2-parameter foldednormal and quasi-normal distributions are two such distributions. To promote model application and help model selection, their features are studied in this paper. It is found that the foldednormal distribution is applicable for the situation where a dataset contains zero or very small observations and the quasi-normal distribution is both Weibull-like and normal-like. As variants of the normal distribution, they do not introduce additional parameters. This is a desired feature. Their appropriateness as life distribution models is illustrated by three examples that involve 24 datasets. It is shown that for some datasets these two distributions can have better goodness-of-fits than several well-known distributions such as Weibull, gamma and lognormal distributions. Interestingly, the folded-normal distribution is found to be appropriate for fitting the well-known bus-motor failure data. As a result, the paper is useful for reliability researchers and practitioners.

articleTitle: Calculation of importance measure of multi-state phased-mission systems with cascading effect
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Importance measure refers to the degree to which the system performance is affected by the failure or state change of single or few components in the system. It can be used to reasonably allocate detection and maintenance resources, so as to guarantee the common operation of the most important components in system. Traditional importance measures could not evaluate the multi-state phased-mission system (MS-PMS) with cascading effect. Then we propose a method to calculate the multi-state Birnbaum importance, reliability achievement worth, risk reduction worth and Fussell-Vesely importance of MS-PMS with cascading effect. Finally, we give a numerical example to verify this combination way.

articleTitle: Development of a safety performance-based model for assessing the civil aviation organization's risk
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Ensuring safety is always the first priority in the civil aviation industry because accidents will result in serious casualties and property losses. In order to implement safety performance management effectively, requirements from ICAO and CAAC are summarized. The research progress of safety performance management from academy and civil aviation industrial field is analyzed. The process of safety performance management and the relationship of safety performance management and other components of safety management system are presented. A model is proposed for assessing operation risk of a civil aviation organization based on established safety performance indicators. A case of three departments in an airport is used to validated the proposed risk assessment model.

articleTitle: The identification method of critical failure mode based on failure information
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the failure mode analysis of mechanical/electromechanical products, FMMEA (Failure Mode, Mechanism and Effects Analysis) method and FMECA (Failure Mode, Effects and Criticality Analysis) method are integrated, and the failure information of developed products and similar products is considered as prior data, and the comprehensive effect analysis of failure mode is carried out. Furthermore, the weak links of products and their critical failure modes, mechanisms and sensitive stresses are quickly identified, and qualitative and quantitative critical failure mode identification methods are formed according to the analysis requirements. Finally, an electromagnetic valve is analyzed in detail by using quantitative analysis process, and the critical failure modes, weak links and sensitive stresses of the product are determined.

articleTitle: Optimal inspection for systems with protective auxiliary component in dynamic environments
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: For multi-component systems, components can be classified according to the impact of component failures: failures of the main component cause the system failures, while failures of the auxiliary component cannot be directly detectable and may put the system at some risk. In this paper, we study a system equipped with main and auxiliary components, and what differs this paper from previous studies on maintenance strategies for such systems is that, we consider not only the failure dependence between components due to the protective effect of the auxiliary component, but also the complex scenario where the system operates in dynamically evolving environments. Environmental evolution results in variations of failure rates of the auxiliary component and some dynamic negative impacts on degradation of the main component. Since hidden auxiliary component failures can only be found by inspection, we consider periodic inspection and opportunistic inspection of the auxiliary component in developing the maintenance strategy. Then we model the system operation by using a semi-regenerative process to obtain the long-run average cost, and minimize the longrun average cost using the inspection period τ as an optimizable decision variable.

articleTitle: Crack segmentation of steel structure based on U-net model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: CV based on deep learning is popular for detecting damages of infrastructures, the crack image segmentation by UNet model was investigated in this work. 120 images with resolutions either 4928x3264 or 5152x3864 pixels were selected as dataset which contains damage images of steel structures. Crack and non-crack images were selected for dataset at a ratio of 1:1. Among of them, 110 images were used for training dataset and the other 10 images were selected for model testing. This research compared the results from different models trained by BCE, MSE and L1 losses. The results have validated that the BCE loss based model demonstrated the best performance with the mIoU (76.66%) higher than MSE-loss-model (4.4%) and L1-loss-model (11.61%), respectively.

articleTitle: Graphene doped flexible piezoelectric transducers for guided wave application
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In this study, a novel flexible piezoelectric transducers with high piezoelectric constant (d33) was fabricated by introducing ceramic powder and graphene particles. The optimization of the composition of the compound was investigated by orthogonal design of experiments. The result shows that volume fraction of ceramic/polymer and the mass of graphene particles play an important role in improving piezoelectricity. Microscopic analysis was also employed to analyze the composite film, which showed that the overall microstructure of the proposed composite film. After the composition optimization, screen printing electrode combined with flexible printed circuit were used to realize a convenient and stable transducer packaging. The test results on the cantilever beam reveal that the proposed transducer has an excellent sensing performance in both dynamic strain monitoring and ultrasonic guided wave sensing on curved surface.

articleTitle: Evaluation of tape winding molding pressure on performance stability of composite products
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In the tape winding molding process, the winding pressure is a key parameter to ensure the performance of the composite winding product. In order to verify the distribution law of winding pressure on the properties of composite products, a CNC winding machine was used to prepare test pieces for experimental research. This paper uses Quantile-Quantile Plot graphical method and Shapiro-Wilk statistical method to test the normality of three sets of data. The results show that there is a significant correlation between the winding pressure and the performance of the composite product. When the pressure is 200N, the performance of the winding product is concentrated at 19Mpa- 21Mpa, when the pressure is 1000N, the product performance converges to 25MPa-29MPa, and when the pressure is 1800N, The performance of the product is concentrated in the range of 24MPa- 31MPa, which proves that the distribution law of the performance obeys the normal distribution, and the product performance is stable.

articleTitle: Reliability modeling of avionics system considering preemptive reconfiguration strategy
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The preemptive reconfiguration strategy is one of the important fault-tolerant strategies in avionics systems. In the strategy, the functional role conversion of redundant units and the determination of system state under resource priority bring challenges to the reliability assessment. To solve this problem, this paper establishes a hierarchical DFT model for the avionics system. In the DFT model, preemptive reconfiguration (PR) gate and degraded AND gate are designed to accurately depict the preemptive reconfiguration behavior and system states. In addition, the article proposes a Monte Carlo simulation algorithm based on cut sequence set model, which can deal with structural function changing during the reconfiguration process.

articleTitle: In-plane mechanical properties analysis of hexgonal honeycomb with enhanced joints
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This paper focuses on the influence of the joint of hexagonal honeycomb structures on the in-plane equivalent elastic modulus and resilience ability. Firstly, a series of honeycomb samples with different joints and wall parameters are processed by additive manufacturing (AM) technology, then the uniaxial compression test and resilience measurement test are performed. Further, the elastic modulus and resilience of this structure are analyzed. The experimental data shows that the elastic modulus and resilience of the joint-enhanced honeycomb increased by 77.42% and 20.4%, respectively. In addition, by analyzing the geometry of joint-enhanced honeycomb and the experiment results, the combination of the shortening of cell wall length and the decreasing of cell wall thickness is proved to be the cause of the improvement.

articleTitle: Research on the failure characteristics analysis of the titanium alloy ring-stiffened cylindrical shell based on damage evolution
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Titanium alloy is excellent Marine metal material, but the plasticity and ductility of the same strength grade of titanium alloy compared with high strength steel are lower, leading to the difference of the failure mode under hydrostatic pressure. To simulate the failure mode of titanium alloy ring-stiffened cylindrical shell under deep-sea environment precisely, the experimental study of titanium alloy material is carried out in this paper. J-C plastic hardening model is chosen to analyze the ultimate strength of the ring-stiffened cylindrical shell based on fracture criterion, and ABAQUS software is used to calculate the evolution of damage for TC4ELI titanium alloy. Whereafter, the analysis of the stress state for the ring-stiffened cylindrical shell is committed under a different mode of buckling. The results indicate that the ultimate strength with ideal elastoplasticity is conservative, and the model with J-C plastic hardening and the evolution of damage can be used to simulate the crack initiation and propagation of hot spot regions accurately. When the ultimate strength of the structure is simulated, the distribution of stress triaxiality is different under different buckling modes for imperfection. In this case, A good research foundation can be provided to develop the precise analysis of the pressure hull.

articleTitle: Inference of a series system with masked data under general progressive type-II censoring
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In this paper, the investigation for the reliability of series system is contemplated under a general progressive Type-II censoring. Suppose that the lifetime of components from the series system is exponentially distributed and the observations include masked data. the expectation-maximization algorithm is used to find the maximum likelihood estimators. Besides, the relevant reliability indices are obtained under this status too. In addition, the approximate confidence intervals are also provided by utilizing the missing information principle. Finally, for the purpose of evaluating the effect of estimation methods, abundant simulation studies are carried out, whose results show that our proposed methods are effective.

articleTitle: Research on uncertainty of propulsion system of air-breathing hypersonic vehicle
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The propulsion system model is established based on the lift body structure of the aircraft, and the mathematical model of the factors affecting the performance of each part of the hypersonic aircraft propulsion system is derived. The generalized polynomial chaos expansion (gPC) method is used to study the uncertainty quantification (UQ) of the propulsion system's front body/intake duct, combustion chamber, and rear body/exhaust nozzle, and obtain the propulsion system The confidence interval of the front body/intake port drag coefficient, total pressure recovery coefficient, adiabatic kinetic energy efficiency and combustion chamber wall friction coefficient, combustion efficiency, combustion specific impulse, and rear body/tail nozzle thrust coefficient. The semi-global sensitivity analysis method is used to analyze the above parameters of the propulsion system's front body/intake, combustion chamber, and rear body/exhaust nozzle respectively, and the importance order of each design parameter is obtained, which is the preliminary structure design stage of the aircraft. Provide guidance.

articleTitle: Timely reliability simulation of single train communication network
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The train control system connects the train equipment through the network and schedules in the control center to ensure the safe and automatic operation of trains. The present analytic models cannot describe the network topology to calculate the timely reliability of the train control system. In this paper, the single train communication network is considered as the research object, the queueing process in the server of the network is described, and the data transmission process is simulated by using OMNET to obtain the reliability parameter results. And the analytical solution can verify such results obtained by simulation. It can be found that as the arrival rate increases, the packet loss rate and queuing delay both rise. The example proves the effectiveness of the proposed reliability analysis of the train control system network using simulation.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of hydraulic system in a NC machining center based on Bayes network
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Due to the complex state of hydraulic system of modern numerical control equipment, the traditional dynamic fault tree quantitative analysis is solved by Markov model and state transition equation. However, when the data is too much and complex, the problem of combinatorial explosion will occur in the solution of Markov model, which increases the difficulty of solving. Bayesian network technology inherits the state description and reasoning method of fault tree, and also has the ability to describe the polymorphism of events and the logical relationship of faults, which effectively reduces the problem of space explosion. It is very suitable for the reliability analysis of the system with many states and fast solving speed. In this paper, the discrete-time Bayesian network is used to analyze the reliability of the hydraulic system of numerical control equipment. Firstly, the logical relationship of the system fault is analyzed to establish a dynamic fault tree. Then, it is transformed into a Bayesian network model and a conditional probability table. The time is divided into three sections for reliability analysis, reasoning and calculation, and the results are compared with the Markov method. The efficiency of discretetime Bayesian network is verified, which provides help for fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Life prediction of neutron tube based on regression analysis and Wiener process
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Life prediction is a complicated problem to be solved for the neutron tube which is widely used and plays an important role in many industries. In this paper, research on life prediction using regression analysis and Wiener process was carried out in order to evaluate the service life of the neutron tube quickly. Failure modes of the prefabricated target sealed deuterium-tritium neutron tube were firstly studied. Life tests of the neutron tube were conducted during laboratory at room temperature for about 55 hours. Regression analysis was performed on the experimental data obtained by the life tests of the neutron tube. The service life of the neutron tube was predicted using the regression function and the uncertainty analysis was performed. In order to take the stochasticity of the performance degradation and the yield measurement of the neutron tube into consideration, the Wiener process in which the Kalman filter and the maximum likelihood estimation methods were applied for the parameter solving process was adopted to assess the service life of the neutron tube. A program of the Wiener process was developed and the residual life distribution of the neutron tube was obtained. The predicted life which consisted of the expectation of the residual life and the time of life tests was consistent with that using the regression function. Finally, the scope of applications of the methods and the results in this paper were discussed. The general process in this paper may be used to estimate the service life of the neutron tube in the early stage of development.

articleTitle: Reliability assessment of spool valve based on wiener process considering non-competing relationship of degradation processes
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Reliability assessment has been widely used and studied as one of the important roles in equipment operation and maintenance. Multivariate competing degradation models have been extensively studied, but some non-competing multivariate degradation processes still exist in reality. In this paper, we present a method of reliability assessment based on Wiener process which considering non-competing relationship. The multivariate degradation process studied in this paper consists of two degradation indicators. The Wiener process was applied to model two degradation indicators separately. Bayesian method is used for parameter estimation of unknown parameters of degradation models and quantification of uncertainty. A case study of spool valve is used for the demonstration and validation of the model presented in this paper.

articleTitle: A simulation assessment method of phased-mission reliability considering maintenance
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Considering the characteristics of muti-phased mission and repair of warship system, there are difficulties in the application of traditional solution methods to model and evaluate the system reliability. A simulation strategy combined with the state transition algorithm based on Monte Carlo method is proposed to calculate ship mission reliability. The mission reliability simulation is demonstrated with three examples and a complex warship system to verify the feasibility and accuracy of the method. The results suggest that the simulation model built in this paper is credible and has certain guiding significance for the design and improvement of warship task allocation.

articleTitle: Influence analysis of transmission characteristics of integrated circuit vibration fixture system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: At present, there are few researches on the structural design of integrated circuit vibration fixture, and the fixture structure selected by the empirical method lacks theoretical analysis and research. Based on integrated circuit fixture on the natural frequency and vibration response to demand higher characteristic, selection method of vibration fixture structure in the fixture design research, the maximum number of installation location is used to simulate assembly fixture structure. Considering the characteristics of vibration test sample number of integrated circuits and the influence of the natural frequency of the fixture structure, we choose the hexahedral H-shaped and Tshaped fixture structure with the most installation stations, respectively on the quality of the aluminum alloy material with the three fixture structure modal simulation and acceleration response analysis. Also, installation to test the sample tooling to fixture is analyzed on the structure natural frequency and the influence of the acceleration transfer response, selected suitable fixture structure. This work provides selection basis for integrated circuit fixture structure design and lays a solid foundation for subsequent fixture optimization design.

articleTitle: Abnormal behavior recognition for Li-Ion battery based on quantum clustering method before capacity degradation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The reliability and safety of Li-ion batteries are widely concerned by the manufacturers and the customers. The lithium plating mechanism and the dispersity in manufacture would increase the capacity fading of some batteries after a specific cycle. This phenomenon is abnormal to the capacity degradation comparing to the typical linear capacity fading. The non-linear degradation would not only shorten the lifetime but even leads to electrical short-circuit and explosions. This work proposes a framework to recognize these batteries before the non-linear degradation happens. The synthetic minority oversampling technique and the linear discriminant analysis are applied to preprocess the features from the original capacity-voltage curve during the charging and discharging process. As a nonparametric clustering method, quantum clustering is used to classify the normal degradation batteries and the abnormal degradation batteries. The recognition accuracy achieves over 98% in both categories, and the prediction is nearly 100 cycles ahead of the nonlinear points. This framework could also determine the obscure data that are hard to decide on the category or refer to some other underlying degradation patterns. As the prediction cycle point is larger, these outlier data are diminishing, and the recognition result is more accurate.

articleTitle: Manufacturing process risk analysis model considering human and organizational factors
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In the manufacturing process, human errors will lead to defective products, even result in safety accidents. In this paper a manufacturing process risk analysis model considering human and organizational factors is built by integrating Human Factors Analysis and Classification System (HFACS) with Bayesian Network (BN). The human and organizational factors (HOF) causing process failure is qualitatively analyzed by HFACS. Then risk of the HOF is estimated by BN method, with the conditional probability of BN nodes evaluated by Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (Fuzzy AHP) method. The proposed method is illustrated using an example study.

articleTitle: A two-phase wiener process model considering change process of degradation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Multiphase degradation products show a varies degradation phases due to complex failure mechanisms. Twophase degradation modelling approach has been studied recently. However, the switching process of failure mechanisms between different phases is still worth of investigation. Use change process to describe the gradual change of failure mechanisms. To describe the change process between various phases, a two-phase degradation model is proposed assuming that the failure mechanism is time linearly changing in change process. Simulation study is conducted to verify the reliability assessment and discuss the differences between two-phase degradation model with change point and two-phase degradation model with change process.

articleTitle: Aircraft cable performance evaluation and its verification experiment design
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aircraft cable is the central nervous system of aircraft avionics system, which plays a vital role in the safety and reliability of aircraft. The distribution of aircraft cables in the aircraft is very complex, and faults are bound to occur with the increase of service life. Aiming at the requirements of automatic detection or performance evaluation of high-speed and largecapacity aircraft cables, this paper proposes a method to realize the rapid detection of aircraft cables in the software application layer by using the unreliability of UDP communication protocol. A set of cable test method and cable fault injection method are designed. The experimental results show that there is a certain correlation between cable fault types and test parameters. It lays a foundation for the cable detection of complex avionics system.

articleTitle: Data-driven modeling of ship maneuvering motion excited by MPRS rudder angle signals
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: An identification modeling framework based on the excitation signals of multi-level pseudo-random sequence (MPRS) and v-SVM algorithm is constructed for predicting ship maneuvering motions. All data can be collected by on-board sensors during sea trials, which facilitates the updating of ship models and the accurate prediction of ship motions. In details, MPRS is used as rudder angle signals to obtain informative training data, and v-SVM is applied to improve the resistance to noise and generalization of the model. The validation of the method is carried out using the simulation data with added noise. A comparison with our previous study using multiple standard maneuver datasets as training data validates the effectiveness and advantages of the method. The results indicate that the proposed method can ensure the stability and generalization of the model with a small amount of data.

articleTitle: Study on seisimic PRA for shutdown state of nuclear power plant
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Seismic Probabilistic Risk Assessment (PRA) is currently the most advanced method for seismic safety analysis of nuclear power plant (NPP). At present, the seismic PRA (SPRA) under the at-power condition has been fully used in NPPs, and there are still many incomplete places in the study of low power and shutdown condition (LPSD). Therefore, this article takes the second generation pressurized water reactor NPP on the east coast of China as the research object, and the technical routes are based on the seismic PRA implementation guide EPRI 3002000709 and EPRI 1002989. Focus on the normal shutdown state (POS D: normal cold shutdown, cool down with RRA (residual heat removal system), primary circuit full of coolant, after RRA into operation, steam space flooding), this paper establishes and screens the equipment list and studies the initiating events and establishes seismic pre-tree (Initiating events potentially impacting the plant are reviewed to identify a comprehensive list of seismicinduced events that are modeled as initiators in the SPSA.) and seismic fault tree. In this paper, we established LPSD level 1 seismic PRA model, and got the result of the seismic core damage frequency. According to the results of the PRA of this LPSD earthquake, the contribution source of earthquake risk was identified, and suggestions for improvement were put forward for the quantitative results. The POS D research method can also be applied to other POSs.

articleTitle: The decision-making methods for informational instrumentation suppliers in the development stage
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: To improve the awkward situation that the supplier of informational instrumentation equipment fails to fulfill commitments for order within the time limit and causes losses, a decision-making method based on PBNE (Perfect Bayesian-Nash equilibrium) is proposed by improving the game process. The payment mode in the classical trading game, a model of interest exchange between the supplier and order is constructed, the method of interest balance has been deduced, and the awkward supplier problem has been solved.

articleTitle: An improved fused-method using degradation data and lifetime data with the gamma process
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The degradation data and lifetime data of products are two important types of reliability data concealed valuable reliability information, which can be used to improve the accuracy of reliability evaluation by fusing these data. However, there are some puzzles with the existing methods based on Bayes theory that the calculation is complicated and could be sensitive to subjectivity in some steps of Bayes methods. Meanwhile, the imbalanced data size can easily result in “imbalanced data” problem. Aiming at solving these problems, this paper examines a phased fusion approach of degradation and lifetime data for products whose degradation can be modelled by the Gamma process, which contained modelling the Gamma process degradation model on basis of degradation data, calculating the point estimation of parameters and updating the failure rate on basis of lifetime data. The product assessment is operated by fitting the Gamma distribution curve and solving the shape parameter and scale parameter. It is proved that the proposed method was more accurate and more efficient in operation than existing methods by the simulation study and example, which also avoided the “imbalanced data” problem.

articleTitle: Reliability and safety evaluation method of unmanned craft system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: For the reliability and safety evaluation of unmanned craft, this paper analyzes the reliability and safety evaluation model of unmanned vehicle system, further defines the key points of reliability and safety evaluation of unmanned craft, and gives the methods of reliability and safety evaluation of unmanned craft control system. Finally, combined with the evaluation model, the reliability and safety evaluation test scheme of unmanned craft control system is designed in this paper. It provides theoretical basis and technical support for efficient and low-cost reliability and safety assessment of unmanned craft in complex mission scenarios and environments in the future.

articleTitle: A study of production decisions in order-based companies based on service reliability
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: A mathematical model of integrated production planning with the objective of profit maximisation is developed to improve customer satisfaction by satisfying certain service reliability, helping order-based enterprises to solve the problem of difficulties in making production decisions in the face of fluctuating demand. Firstly, the concept of service reliability is proposed to indicate the probability that the quantity of products supplied by an enterprise can meet the quantity of products ordered by customers; then the integrated production planning mathematical model is constructed with the objective of maximising profit by considering constraints such as service reliability, staff, production capacity, overtime hours and orders, and is solved using the EXCEL planning solution tool. Finally, Professor Huang's food processing enterprise was selected for an example application to verify the feasibility of the model. The results show that the solution using this model can obtain production decision results that satisfy a certain degree of service reliability.

articleTitle: Estimation of series system via Weibull distribution from generalized adaptive progressively interval censored data
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: A generalized adaptive progressively interval censoring scheme is proposed in this paper which appears more flexible and cost-saving in lifetime testing, and estimation of series system is discussed under this scheme. When the latent lifetime of the components from the system follow the Weibull distribution, maximum likelihood estimators are obtained, and a stochastic expectation-maximization algorithm is applied for solving the complex computation. Further, the associated approximate confidence intervals are also constructed for the model parameters based on the missing information principle along with asymptotic theory. Finally, extensive numerical simulations and a real data example are presented for investigating the performance of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Performance based sustainment support mode of US military and its enlightenment to China's project construction
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In view of the increasingly prominent problem of model support in China, this paper investigates the performance-based sustainment support mode of the U.S. military, analyzes the reason and connotation of the concept of sustainment support proposed by the U.S. military, combs the implementation means of the U.S. military's life cycle sustainment support work, Performance Based Logistics (PBL), and combs the management tool to assist providers to carry out and assess their sustainment support work, Sustainment Maturity Level (SML), and puts forward some enlightenment and suggestions for China's model construction, so as to provide reference for improving the sustainment support ability of models.

articleTitle: Robustness improvement of interdependent networks with random attack
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: With the high degree of cooperation of communication technology, sensor network, communication unit and computing equipment, power system has gradually expanded from traditional single-layer network to interdependent network. Although this interdependent topology is helpful to realize the complex functions of smart grid, it also causes the disturbance to propagate in a larger range in the interdependent network and reduces the robustness of the system. Therefore, it has become a hot research topic for scholars in recent years to explore the cascaded failure model of interdependent smart grid and to suppress it. In this paper, we propose an open-loop discrete adaptive ant colony algorithm based on multi-agent to optimize in the solution network of cascading failures of interdependent networks and develop a better edge addition suppression strategy. The simulation results show that compared with the edge increasing strategy proposed in the current literature, the proposed edge increasing strategy can better suppress the cascade failure propagation range of the interdependent network and improve the robustness of the network.

articleTitle: A maintenance influencing factor evaluation method based on virtual reality fusion
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Maintainability evaluation based on virtual or entity has its own advantages. In order to evaluate the maintainability level more accurately and provide a feasible scheme for the application of digital twin technology, combined with ergonomics, the evaluation criteria of ship's visibility, accessibility and maintenance space are summarized. On this basis, a maintainability evaluation method based on the integration of virtual and real is proposed. Finally, an application case is given to prove the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Structure optimization and reliability evaluation of folding ferry plate
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Folding ferry plate is a bearing connection device, which often undergoes large deformation when carrying large mechanical equipment, and excessive quality increases the consumption of materials. To improve the stiffness and reduce the quality of the folding ferry plate, the folding ferry plate is optimized. Whether the optimized structure meets the requirements or not needs to be evaluated. To determine the folding ferry plate model with better performance, three key influencing factors are selected as experimental variables, and the orthogonal experimental design of the folding ferry plate model with three key factors and four levels is carried out. The influence of different key factors on the quality and deformation of the folding ferry plate is studied, and the optimal combination scheme of different factors is determined. Based on the total mass, deformation and the first, second and third natural frequencies of the folded ferry plate, the model state index method is used to evaluate the reliability of the structure before and after optimization. The results show that the quality of folding ferry plate can be reduced by 1.76 % and the deformation can be reduced by 15.56 % by selecting the optimal combination scheme, which realizes the optimization of folding ferry plate performance and improves the reliability of folding ferry plate after the orthogonal experiment.

articleTitle: A sequential sampling approach based on LOLA-DIST criterion
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: To solve the parameter optimization problem of quality control in the industrial manufacturing process, the high fidelity response surface model should be established to describe the nonlinear relationship between the input and output factors, which requires numerous expensive and time-consuming simulation calculations. Therefore, a sequential experimental design method based on LOLA-DIST (Local Linear Approximations, LOLA, the intersite and projected distance, DIST) criterion is proposed, which sequentially samples in zones with high nonlinearity and low distribution density and better balances global exploration and local exploitation strategies. A numerical example is given to verify the feasibility of the LOLADIST sequential sampling approach. The results show that compared with the existing sequential design methods, the sequential design based on the LOLA-DIST criterion achieves the target prediction accuracy with less computational cost and sample size and works for any metamodels.

articleTitle: Health monitoring of pressure transmitter sensing line based on convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Blockages of pressure transmitter sensing line are a recurring problem in nuclear plants. The traditional solution is to purge them with nitrogen periodically, which is time consuming and radiation intensive. It is thus desirable to monitor the status of sensing lines on-site. The noise analysis method is a promising method for sensing line health monitoring. However, the existing noise analysis methods, which evaluate the sensing line status by analyzing time domain or frequency domain features of process noise signal, are susceptible to working conditions of pressure transmitters. Further, blockage degree of the sensing line can not be determined by existing methods. Therefore, this paper proposes a machine learning based noise analysis method for health monitoring of pressure transmitter sensing line, in which 1-D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is used to extract features from process noise signals. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieved satisfactory results in diagnosis accuracy, false alarm rate and robustness of the model under different working conditions. Further, blockage degree of sensing line can also be evaluated

articleTitle: Study on Ship Structure Optimization Considering the Influence of Nonlinear Wave Load
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In this paper, a nonlinear wave load program is used to calculate the vertical wave load response of a super large container ship under different hull girder stiffness. The influence of the hull beam stiffness on the wave load is analyzed. The calculation method of nonlinear wave load in civil ship structure optimization model is given. The effects of nonlinear wave load on hull profile optimization is analyzed. The calculation results show that the decrease of the stiffness of the hull girder will lead to the significant increase of the wave load on the hull beam. The optimization effect of the mid-section area is reduced from 5.085% to 2.896% with the consideration of wave load. This shows that it is necessary to take the influence of stiffness variation on nonlinear wave loads into account in the structural optimization design of large ships.

articleTitle: Fault detection of gantry boring and milling machine based on FTA and FMECA
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In the reliability evaluation of the gantry boring and milling machine, the fault data is optimized and screened by the interquartile range method, and the reliability model of the fault data is optimally selected by MATLAB software, then the K-S test is used to determine the fault data distribution function of the gantry milling machine. To determine the accuracy of the calculation, a fault tree model is established to analyze the fault, calculate the importance of the minimum cut set, analyze the FMECA table for the high-frequency fault mechanism with high critical importance, and propose reliability improvement measures. Compared with the single fault tree combined with the data analysis method, the proposed method is more accurate to improve the reliability of the fault tree, reduce the subjective error of the fault tree, and improve the accuracy and efficiency of the fault mechanism judgment.

articleTitle: Reliability prediction of temperature control circuit for solid rocket motor casting core insertion control system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In the pouring and core inserting links of solid rocket motor charge, the effects of temperature, pressure, dosage and other factors on the rheological properties and forming process of propellant grain are obvious. Therefore, highly reliable casting and ferrule production is very important. A multi-parameter realtime integrated control system for pouring and inserting core realizes the monitoring and automatic control of the pouring and inserting process of solid rocket motor. In order to ensure the constant temperature of the pouring core, the temperature of the components in the temperature control module is controlled by active heating. The reliability of the temperature control module is directly related to the effect of active temperature control measures, which in turn directly affects the solid rocket motor charge quality. Based on the temperature control circuit, the reliability of the two redundant design schemes of system backup and unit backup is analyzed and compared. The results show that the reliability of the temperature control circuit using system backup is higher. According to the reliability prediction results and the characteristics of the temperature control module in the control system, the final implementation scheme of the temperature control module is determined.

articleTitle: Modeling and evaluation of public safety resilience based on Bayesian network: a case Study of COVID-19 pandemic
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In order to deal with the impact of public emergencies, through research on elasticity theory, an index framework for public safety resilience was given. On this basis, the process of applying Bayesian network to measure public safety resilience was studied. Finally, taking the COVID-19 pneumonia epidemic as an example, the paper analyzed the factors that affect resilience in public health incidents, and took residents of Beihang community as the research object, and obtains relevant data by questionnaires. Based on the Bayesian network, a public safety resilience model was constructed, and the main factors affecting the resilience of public safety are discussed through sensitivity analysis. The results show that the system, protective materials, medical conditions and daily drills are the main factors affecting the absorptive ability; the improvement of government behavior and ability is the main factor to improve and recover the public safety degree in the epidemic situation.

articleTitle: Dynamic performance analysis of flexible joints of different materials
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The development of solid rocket motors has always been faced with the problem of achieving large thrust and high performance propulsion with the simplest structure and the lowest cost; at this stage, under the action of extreme loads in complex working conditions, the dual nonlinear system dynamics modeling of the coupling of materials and large deformations And the method of solution, the non-linear change of the aging performance of the rubber material of the joint elastic part has an important influence on the dynamic characteristics of the system. Aiming at the dynamic performance of flexible joints of different materials, this paper adopts dynamic calculation method to carry out finite element calculation, and compares the finite element calculation results with the theoretical calculation results to analyze the differences. The results show that, during the swing process of the system, the force on the lower part of the flexible joint is more complicated, and the force distribution of the flexible joint of low modulus silicone rubber material is more uniform, the change is gentler, and the force on the flexible part is the least.

articleTitle: A new reliability method based on Markov chain Monte Carlo and Kriging model for small failure probability
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The combination of surrogate model and reliability analysis method can effectively solve the problem of large amount of calculation in traditional reliability methods. However, there will still be a problem of heavy calculation burden when deal the problem of small failure probability. Aiming at the problem of small failure probability in engineering, based on Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) and Kriging model, a reliability analysis method based on MCMC and Kriging model is proposed. Firstly, in order to obtain more information about the limit state function, an important probability density function is constructed. Then, for obtaining importance samples, MCMC method is applied to improve the sampling efficiency. Additionally, a stopping criterion for importance sampling is proposed to improve the efficiency and accuracy of learning function. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by numerical and engineering application examples.

articleTitle: Probabilistic fatigue life prediction for crankshaft of marine diesel engine
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Diesel engines are the most commonly used power plant of ships in the world. The crankshaft which transforms the translational motion generated by combustion to rotational motion, is the critical components which affects the fatigue life of diesel engine. In this paper, a probabilistic fatigue life prediction method for crankshaft is proposed. A three-dimensional finite element analysis (FEA) is used to analyze the distribution of equivalent von Mises stress of the crankshaft. The S-N/ε-N curve of the material obtained from existing literature is used to evaluate the parameters of Coffin-Manson model. The life model parameters are statistically identified using Bayesian estimation with Markov chain simulations. In addition to simulation examples, an actual case from Shanghai Marine Diesel Engine Research Institute is carried out using this probabilistic fatigue life prediction method. Then the probabilistic life and material dispersion are obtained, which is helpful for the design, replacement and maintenance strategy of the crankshaft.

articleTitle: Research on opportunistic maintenance strategy of series system considering fault correlation and component importance
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of the high maintenance cost of multi-component systems and the lack of targeted maintenance strategies for components of different importance, an opportunistic maintenance strategy model considering fault correlation and importance is proposed. Firstly, the fault chain theory is introduced to describe the fault correlation between components, and the comprehensive failure rate evolution model of the components under repairing non-new conditions is established; secondly, the Copula function is used to construct the system reliability model under the fault correlation; then the Birnbaum importance of each component is calculated , and combine it with the opportunistic maintenance coefficient to construct an opportunistic maintenance optimization model of the series system considering the importance and fault correlation. Finally, an example analysis of the model is carried out, and the optimal opportunistic maintenance coefficient and maintenance cost are found by a genetic algorithm. The results show that the maintenance strategy model considers fault correlation, economic correlation and component importance, which can not only carry out targeted maintenance on different components, but also effectively solve the problem of high maintenance costs caused by lack of maintenance and frequent shutdown of the system, this proves the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Residual life estimation of typical system with exponential-weibull distribution and known failure information
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In reliability engineering, it is of great significance to predict residual lives of systems. At present, exponential-Weibull distribution is more and more widely used since it can fit complex failure rates. Meanwhile, failure information is available in practical engineering systems, which can be utilized to get more precious estimations. Assuming that the lifetimes of components follows exponential-Weibull distributions, the closed-forms of residual life for typical systems, including series system, parallel system and r-out-of-n: G system are derived with known failure information and the calculation method is presented accordingly. Finally, examples are given to show the proformance of the proposed method. The results show that if the failure information of components is ignored, the residual life estimation results of the system will have a large deviation.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of the gear micro-pitting formation mechanism for surface roughness
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: A Micro-pitting damage is an early failure form of gear contact. Exploring its damage mechanism is very important to gear design, operation and maintenance. Considering the contact pressure distribution, sliding speed, rolling speed, film thickness and shear stress along the contact line, this paper takes into account the effect of the peak number of Gaussian surface roughness, and uses rheological methods to affect the crack initiation The number of minimum roughness peaks is calculated to simulate the crack initiation process, and a crack criterion method to predict the dangerous area of crack initiation is proposed. Then, considering the effect of accumulated stress, the topography of the contact surface gradually changes from a Gaussian rough surface to a non-Gaussian rough surface. Thus, after the crack initiation, this paper uses a non-Gaussian rough surface to further simulate the crack propagation process. The simulation results show that when the skewness of the non- Gaussian rough surface is constant, the crack propagation rate will increase with the increase in number of loads; when the skewness increases, the crack propagation rate will decrease.This paper first analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of the existing micro-pitting crack initiation and propagation model, then modifies the crack initiation criterion based on the number of Gaussian surface roughness peaks, and simulates the crack propagation with non-Gaussian roughness. Finally, an example is used to simulate and analyze the established model.

articleTitle: Establishment and validation of ambient temperature prediction model vehicle platform compartments
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Purpose: The purpose of this study is to accurately predict the temperature induced by the vehicle platform in the process of driving, which can provide a more accurate input for proposing the environmental adaptability requirements of onboard equipment and carrying out environmental adaptability design and test validation. Approach: A dynamic temperature prediction algorithm of the vehicle platform based on the measured data is proposed by starting from the thermal formation mechanism of the vehicle platform compartment, taking into consideration the comprehensive influence of various factors on the thermal environment of the compartment, and introducing the position relationship, According to the established model, taking the normal driving of the vehicle as the starting point, the sinusoidal function is used to fit and regress the ambient temperature, and the nonlinear minimum function to fit the model parameters. Result:The result of model validation shows that the established dynamic temperature prediction model can accurately predict the curve of the temperature in the manned compartment of the vehicle platform that changes with the condition of the vehicle in travel. The error analysis results show that the maximum median error of the dynamic temperature model is not more than 2% in relation to the existing position of the passenger compartment of the vehicle platform.

articleTitle: New expected maintenance optimization model for life degradation long storage equipments
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: For long-term storage systems such as rockets and missiles, maintenance is an important way to keep the equipment in good technical condition, maintenance strategy optimization about long-term storage equipment has received extensive attention from experts in the industry. Considering factors such as the complexity of the degradation mechanisms, the constraints imposed by failure, and the uncertainty caused by environment, we need to develop a more conservative repair strategy to meet practical needs. In this paper, we study the issue of maintenance optimization model for long-term storage systems. First, the Wiener process is used to establish a performance degradation model for long-term storage equipment. Second, a long storage system maintenance expected optimization model is established with the minimum maintenance start time as the optimization goal. Then, a genetic algorithm is designed to solve the model. Finally, the applicability and effectiveness of the model are demonstrated by an example.

articleTitle: Influence of temperature on fatigue life of lock test mechanism
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aircraft cabin door lock is very important in flight missions. The reliability test of a lock mechanism is carried out. Firstly, a test mechanism that meets the test requirements is designed, the fatigue life analysis method of key parts of the mechanism is determined, and the fatigue life analysis framework of the mechanism is proposed. Then LMS.Virtual.Lab software is used to analyze the multi-body dynamics of the test mechanism, and the load spectrum of the analyzed object is obtained. Based on the dynamic analysis and the five-block diagram of fatigue simulation analysis, the fatigue life of the analyzed object was analyzed by Ncode DesignLife software. Finally, the thermal and structural coupling analysis of the test mechanism was carried out by using ANSYS software. After obtaining the stress data, the fatigue life of the analyzed object under the coupling of temperature and mechanical load was studied, and the influence of temperature on the fatigue life of the lock test mechanism was analyzed.

articleTitle: LFCC-based transformer sound feature extraction and analysis
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: As one of the important components of the power system, the safe and stable operation of transformers is particularly important. However, the traditional transformer fault diagnosis methods have certain disadvantages. Sound-based online monitoring of transformers is a simple and reliable noninvasive monitoring method that does not interfere with the normal operation of transformers and can reflect the working status and abnormal conditions of transformers well. This paper firstly introduces the relevant feature extraction techniques and designs a linear frequency filter bank based on the commonly used Meier cepstrum coefficients (MFCC), combined with the actual operation of transformers. After that, the characteristic quantities of some transformer sound signals containing common noise are analyzed, and the corresponding conclusions are drawn by combining with real data, and verified the validity of the methods used.

articleTitle: Research on ship informational support management system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Ship is a kind of complex system. It faces a larger number of integrated logistics support works and its operational readiness and mission reliability are affected by support system. In order to improve the support efficiency, this paper studies a ship informational support management system based on interactive electronic technical manual and equipment support management technologies. It introduces the system composition, function and interface of the ship informational support management system.

articleTitle: A novel method for analog circuit fault prediction based on IAALO-SVM
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: As we all know, the stability of the analog circuit is an important guarantee for the normal operation of electronic equipment. During the operation of the product, once the analog circuit breaks down, it will affect the reliability and safety of the entire electronic product. Aiming at the shortcomings of the existing analog circuit prediction, combined with the characteristics of the small sample nonlinear data in the analog circuit, a fault prediction method based on Support Vector Machine (SVM) is proposed. To solve the problem that poor selection of parameters in SVM leads to poor prediction results, the Ant Lion Optimizer (ALO) algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of SVM. At the same time, the ALO algorithm is optimized to obtain the adaptive Ant Lion Optimizer (AALO) algorithm, which is used to obtain the optimized the SVM parameters. Finally, an analog circuit fault prediction method based on improved adaptive Ant Lion Optimizer-Support Vector Machine (IAALO-SVM) is proposed. In the case study, the IAALO-SVM method is used to predict the degradation and failure trends of the DC-DC switching power supply. Moreover, the prediction results of the IAALO-SVM method are compared with other algorithms such as neural networks, which demonstrates the superiority of this method in analog circuit fault prediction and can improve the accuracy and speed of electronic product fault prediction.

articleTitle: Reliability prediction and evaluation model of smart electricity meter based on edge computing
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of poor measurement stability and failure time of smart electricity meter in the process of life reliability analysis, this paper based on the least square method of regression analysis to estimate the parameters of Weibull distribution and accelerated life test model. The reliability index of smart electricity meter predicted by the new Weibull parameter estimation method is similar to that predicted by the point estimation method, but the reliability error of smart electricity meter predicted by the component stress method is large, indicating that there is an error between the actual operation of smart electricity meter and the predicted results in the design stage. The method proposed in this paper predicts the reliability of smart electricity meters under actual operation conditions, and predicts the correction factors of smart electricity meters' failure rate. The correction factors of various models are summarized to improve the reliability of smart electricity meters. In addition, the failure time before the smart meter is deduced and the failure rate of smart meter is more accurate.

articleTitle: A two-stage feature selection for rolling bearing fault diagnosis using ReliefF and SVM-RFE
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Selecting distinguishable features from small sample data of rolling bearings has become an emerging and trending research topic in recent years. In this paper, a two-stage feature selection method based on Euclidean distance and multi-class support vector machine is proposed to remove irrelevant features and redundant features. First, the fault data are formed to a multidomain feature set. Second, the ReliefF algorithm based on Euclidean distance is used to remove irrelevant features. Third, the support vector machine recursive feature elimination (SVMRFE) is used to remove redundant features. Lastly, the KNN classifier is used to verify the effectiveness of this method. This paper uses the rolling bearing public datasets. After comparison, the results prove that the method proposed in the article is better.

articleTitle: Analysis of initiating events in fire PSA under low power and shutdown conditions
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Probabilistic safety assessment (PSA) is one of the main methods for nuclear power plant fire safety assessment. At present, fire PSA at power condition has been widely carried out, but there are still few studies on fire PSA in low power and shutdown conditions (LPSD). The initiating events analysis is the starting point for the development of the fire sequences, and it is also an important step of the fire PSA. Fire PSA needs to identify the initiating events directly or indirectly caused by the failure of equipment and cables in fire, which is the basis for building the response model of fire PSA. Meanwhile, the power plant configuration and operate state under LPSD are also different. Therefore, based on the actual state characteristics of LPSD, this paper studies the fire PSA equipment and cables that may be affected and the initiating events that may occur in the fire compartment when the fire happened in LPSD, laying a dedicated list of fire initiating events as the foundation for the study of fire PSA in LPSD.

articleTitle: Lower confidence limit estimation for truncated distribution with small failure ratio
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Several joints of the nose landing gear retraction of an airplane have been observed failures in recent years. A reasonable method was proposed to estimate the lower confidence limit of the joint life. The amount of this airplane in outfield is lager so that two truncated distributions were used to predict the safe life of this joint. This paper used Lognormal distribution and 2-parameter Weibull distribution with sampling-based strategies. Compared with the life base on full-size fatigue test, the method combining Weibull distribution with Monte-Carlo can predict the lower confidence limit of the joint life well. It also shows that the case with a small amount of failure samples has significant engineering application meanings.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation analysis method of process safety based on a system behavioral model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: At present, the characteristics of weapon equipment, such as dynamic reconfiguration, fault sequence correlation, logic correlation, and the coupling effect of Man-Equipment- Environment in operation and maintenance, hinder the development of system safety analysis. In this paper, a modeling and simulation analysis method of task process safety based on a system behavioral model is proposed. Taking the task process as the main line, the critical safety links are analyzed. Based on GO methodology, the system behavioral model is established, which can cover the hardware failure, human error, and external environment.
