Then, based on the system behavioral model, the coupling and transfer effects of multi-source factors are analyzed, the risk transfer law in the task process is systematically studied, the possible accident consequences of the typical task process are identified, and the risk probability of the typical task process is obtained, which provides an effective method for the identification and improvement of the weak links in the safety design of the typical task process.

articleTitle: Optimal pricing for customized two-dimensional extended warranty policiesp
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The price of extended warranty is an important factor that influences the revenue of warranty providers. The pricing of two-dimensional extended warranty is challenging due to various uncertainties of warranty purchasing time, risk attitude, and usage rates. This study develops a pricing model for twodimensional extended warranty policies. If extended warranty is purchased at the time of product sale (Case 1), a fixed extended warranty region is offered. If extended warranty is purchased upon the expiration of the basic warranty (Case 2), the customer will be provided with a warranty region based on the usage rate of basic warranty. The objective is to optimize the extended warranty price of Case 1 and to jointly optimize the warranty region and price for each warranty menu option of Case 2 by maximizing the profit of the warranty provider. Numerical examples are used to illustrate the effects of some key parameters on the optimal results.

articleTitle: Wave loads design of a deep-sea mining vessel
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In response to the needs of deep-sea mineral development, deep-sea mining ships, a new type of ships, came into stage. The unique characteristics of deep-sea mining ships determines that the structures and working environments of such devises are different from that of ore carrier and FPSO. At present, the classification society has not yet issued a special classification specification for deep-sea mining ships, hence, related structures and load design problems are chaos. In this paper, the calculation of wave load is carried out by using three-dimensional frequency domain method to complete the design of a large-scale deep-sea mining ship. The transfer function and long-term prediction of vertical wave load and vertical wave shear force are computed. The results are compared with CCS and DNV Rules. The results support the structural design of deep-sea mining vessels.

articleTitle: Identification and evaluation method of bridge abnormal state based on cloud model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In view of the uncertainty existing in the current bridge technical state evaluation process, it is suggested to introduce anomaly identification in the evaluation process. Combined with the cloud model theory and the ensemble empirical mode decomposition method, a cloud model-based bridge abnormal state evaluation method is proposed. Firstly, the original monitoring signal is decomposed by EEMD(Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition) to obtain multiple IMF(Intrinsic Mode Function ) components, and the mutual information method is used to select the IMF components. Finally, based on the cloud similarity distance between the clouds generated by IMF, a new cloud is synthesized, and the final generated cloud is used to evaluate the operation status of the bridge. The research shows that this evaluation method can effectively evaluate the operation state of bridge quality engineering, and can effectively evaluate the reliability of the structure. The process is more objective and the results are more comprehensive.

articleTitle: A hybrid regression method for health prognostics of proton exchange membrane fuel cells
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cells (PEMFC) is a promising clean energy system, and the issue of limited durability make it difficult to be commercialized on a large scale. Health prognostic is an effective method for PEMFC to actively predict health degradation and to preventively improve durability. Voltage degradation prediction is a critical aspect of health prognostic of PEMFC. To accurately predict the voltage, a novel hybrid approach integrating polynomial regression with random forest regression is proposed. The voltage prediction is categorized into trend prediction and fluctuation prediction, and the polynomial regression and the random forest regression are used to predict the general trend and the fluctuation of voltage, respectively. The hybrid of these two regressions can jointly characterize the voltage evolution with high precision. The proposed method is demonstrated on a public dataset of PEMFC, the root mean square errors of the proposed method for long-term prediction and short-term prediction are 0.00986 and 0.00960, respectively. Comparison with the LSTM method and the Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference Systems (ANFIS) method have demonstrated that the proposed can achieve higher precision, and may further contribute to the health prognostics of PEMFC.

articleTitle: Accelerated degradation modeling of power MOSFET under multiple stresses
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Power MOSFET is one of the most critical components in power electronic converters. However, it often performs a lower reliability index under multiple stresses. Conventional single-stress accelerated degradation test (ADT) and corresponding statistical inference are unable to evaluate its reliability accurately. In this article, a new accelerated degradation model is designed by combining multi-stress accelerated model and the generalized Wiener process model. This comprehensive model not only establishes the relationship between drift coefficient and multiple stresses but also take the nonlinearity and uncertainties existing in degradation process into consideration. Subsequently, an ADT with temperature, electrical and vibration stresses for power MOSFET is carried out to obtain the degradation data under different stress levels, which is employed for unknown parameter estimation. Comparative analysis demonstrates that the proposed model can provide a more accurate and reasonable reliability assessment result. Keywords-accelerated

articleTitle: An automatic generation method of instrument flight procedure in space based on node fusion technology
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In order to improve the accurate display of flight procedure data in flight simulation, to improve the performance of all stages of flight procedure in space, use computer simulation technology and geographic information technology, analyze and deal the factors of instrument flight procedure such as turn point and anchor point of initial flight phase, an automatic generation method of instrument flight procedure in space based on node fusion technology (NFT) is established. Simulation experiments show that: NFT method has better accuracy and intuitiveness than other methods in 3D accurate drawing, it can effectively display the relationship between each point and each surface of the 3D space, and solve the problem of accurately constructing the space environment. articleTitle: Maintenance optimization design of automobile brake system based on importance measures
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The accurate measurement results of the importance of automobile brake system can effectively identify the key components and repair them in time, so as to prevent accidents from happening. At first, this paper introduces the basic structure of the automobile brake system, analyzes the causes of brake failures, and screens out the key components of the system. Then, the griffith importance measures and integrated importance measures are used to calculate the importance of each component to brake system. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the method, and the GIM and IIM sequencing of each component is given. Taking the cost of each component as a variable, and according to the calculated value of IIM, the optimization strategy under different working conditions is given.

articleTitle: FEM simulation determined band-pass filter with Kurtosis optimized bandwidth to detect faults
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Currently, a new method using finite element method (FEM) simulation definite band pass filter was developed to detect defects in axial piston pump bearings with agreeable performance. However, the bandwidth of the band-pass filter is not well addressed. As a signal processing technique, Kurtosis has achieved great success to extract fault features in mechanical systems. In this paper, Kurtosis is employed in optimizing the bandwidth of the constructed band pass filter. Firstly, FEM is utilized to obtain the first bending frequency of bearings with faults. Secondly, the band-pass filter is designed by using the first bending frequency to determine the center frequency and further search for optimal bandwidth using kurtosis. Finally, Hilbert envelope analysis is performed in order to filtered signal to extract faults. Experiment and comparison results of a faulty bearing in an axial piston pump show that the present improvement version of the FEM improved band-pass filter can be applied to extract fault features for the reciprocating motion systems with heavy impact-induced natural periodic impulses.

articleTitle: Multi-field coupling simulation and low cycle fatigue life prediction of turbine blades
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Through the finite element analysis, the aerodynamic load and temperature load in the flow field of the turbine blades are studied, and in-depth analysis is carried out. Based on the simulation results in the flow field, a multi-field coupling simulation calculation is performed to determine the dangerous points of the blade during operation. Regarding the blade fatigue life, first, use the Smith-Watson-Topper (SWT) model to predict the blade's low cycle fatigue life, and then take the shear strain range into account, modify the SWT model, use the modified model to predict the blade's low cycle fatigue life, and predict both. The results are compared, and the results show that the revised model prediction results are more accurate.

articleTitle: Research on comprehensive method of equipment update decision
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the decision-making problem of equipment update, this article judges the relationship between the equipment's natural life, technical life and economic life, considers five update schemes of the equipment maintenance and replacement, and gives a comprehensive update decision-making process. From the perspective of economic trade-offs, this paper establishes the equipment present value cost model and the unit use cost model to determine the optimal update schemes.

articleTitle: Application research of product failure cause based on improved AFD
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Anticipatory Failure Determination (AFD) is an analysis method based on TRIZ tools and using reverse thinking to predict product failure. Through the combination of AFD and TRIZ, component analysis, function analysis and resource analysis are used to establish a failure model that is suitable for mechanical products and can effectively analyze failure modes and causes. A shell-and-tube heat exchanger is taken as an example to verify the feasibility of the model, and the failure modes and causes of the shell-and-tube heat exchanger are analyzed.

articleTitle: An AD based robust design method for complex system conceptual design
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: System design is a complex process. Modern mechatronical systems with more function requirements, more complex structures, these factors bring complexity and difficulty in design process. This paper proposes a robust design method for complex mechatronical system's conceptual design. This method concentrates on the procedure of customers' requirements–system functions–system scheme, and then establishes the conceptual design process model with the help of the “domain” in Axiomatic Design theory. The conceptual design process model contains three parts of requirement domain, the function domain and the scheme domain. And two design rules are employed in the conceptual robust design model as follow: 1) the main functions are independence in the function domain; 2) the design variables must be robust in the conceptual domain. The function independence rule could guarantee the failure not propagation during the functions implementation process, and the variables robustness rule could ensure the system function and structure resist external interference. This mechatronical system conceptual robust design method could improve the inherent reliability in the system conceptual design stage, and also could shorten the products design and develop cycle and save product design cost. This paper implements this method in a typical product design, and verify its application validity.

articleTitle: Reliability optimization of hollow half-shaft based on Kriging model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In typical optimization design, the uncertainty of design variables is always ignored. This phenomenon will cause performance fluctuations, or even design failures. A method is proposed to improve the robustness of the hollow half-shaft of the steering drive shaft. Based on the Kriging surrogate model, an objective function is constructed by the method, which takes into account a variety of uncertain factors and increases constraint conditions. Conditions are the failure probability of stress within a certain range. Then the validity of the method is verified. The results show that the optimized hollow half-shaft reduces the mass by 2.7% (57.8g) and improves the reliability by 13.1%.

articleTitle: An aging-intensity-based parameter estimation on incomplete data for the three-parameter Weibull distribution
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The three-parameter Weibull distribution has been widely used as a lifetime model, and the maximum likelihood estimators of the parameters of this distribution are often inexistent. To address this issue, many approaches have been developed in the literature, but most of the approaches depend on some restrictive or unrealistic assumptions, e.g., the shape parameter is known or/and data are complete. This paper presents an aging-intensity-based approach without restrictive assumptions. It involves two main steps. In the first step, the shape parameter is estimated based on the aging intensity function at the characteristic life, which is estimated using regression. In the second step, the shape parameter is fixed and the other two parameters are estimated using the Weibull Q-Q plot. The proposed approach is applicable for a small sample and lightly censored data. Its appropriateness is illustrated by applying it to eight datasets.

articleTitle: Reliability assessment and life prediction of ion thruster
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Ion thruster, as a new space propulsion system, has the characteristics of high reliability and long life. Moreover, it is usually ion thruster tested subject to the testing time and cost. Therefore, the mentioned phenomenon leads to great difficulties in the reliability analysis of ion thruster. Motivated by the problems, the main failure mode and mechanism is firstly analyzed for ion thruster. The relationship model between the groove erosion depth and the operating time is established by a linear function. Meanwhile, considering most of thruster will experience several different given power due to the mission requirements, the cumulative damage method is used to estimate the useful life of thruster. Then, the lifetime distribution of ion thruster is given and the one-sided confidence intervals of life and reliability are derived. Finally, an engineering example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Evaluating grain size using phased array ultrasound attenuation method with diffraction correction
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In the propagation process of ultrasonic beam, diffraction loss has a great influence on the inversion of grain size by the phased-array (PA) ultrasound attenuation method. Combining the multi-Gaussian beam model and the time delay law of PA ultrasound, the diffraction correction method is developed in this study. Different steering angles and focal lengths are studied. Based on the Weaver's scattering theory, the theoretical scattering-induced attenuation is calculated and used to the inversion of grain size. The final experimental results indicate that the relative error of estimated result with diffraction correction is much less than that without correction. In addition, the result of multi-angles data fusion is better than that of a single angle.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of measurement errors of electric energy meters in cold and high-altitude environments
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Electric energy meters are the most important measurement devices in State Grid. The measurement accuracy of electricity meters is related to the interests of users and the reputation of the enterprise, and the measurement error of electric energy meters is affected by various environmental factors, such as temperature and humidity. However, quantization of effects of complex working conditions on performance stability and measurement accuracy of the electric energy meters is few. In this paper, the basic error data of electricity meters running on site for more than one year in high and cold regions of Heilongjiang Province and high-altitude regions of Tibet Province are collected. The metering errors of the batches of electricity meters in the two test bases under the conditions of power factor 0.8C, current 0.1Ib, Ib and Imax are compared and analyzed. Finally, the trend of the variation of the errors of electricity meters under the condition of power factor 0.8C is analyzed with the combination of temperature and humidity. The results show that the measurement error of batch meters in the Heilongjiang base in spring, summer, autumn and winter was greater than that in the Tibet test base, especially in winter.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of gate valve based on AKMCS
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The gate valve is the key structure in many engineering and its reliability significantly affects the system's performance. This paper carries out the reliability analysis of a gate valve based on an adaptive Kriging and Monte Carlo simulation (AK-MCS) method. To deal with the challenges of its reliability evaluation, the limit-state function, which associated with the liquid leakage problem and involves finite element analysis, is usually approximated by the Kriging metamodel. The computational efforts are significantly reduced utilizing the Kriging metamodel and the adaptive constructing strategy while the accuracy can be satisfied.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of ship behavior and structural loads in head seas
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Wave loads calculation method has been developed several decades and from the linear 2D strip theory to 2D+T approaches. Nevertheless, the nonlinear phenomena, such as springing vibration or green water need more accurate simulation. It is necessary to develop a practical method based on viscous theory. Technological development offers ever-increasing computational capacity, and the numerical simulation become more and more popular. Computational Fluid Dynamic (CFD) based on the Reynolds Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) equations gain its popularity for seakeeping applications, despite the need of intensive computational efforts. This paper aims to perform a fully nonlinear unsteady RANS simulation to predict the ship behavior and structural loads in head waves. The ship behavior and structural were successfully calculated from the CFD method and validated by using segment model test results. In addition, the results from the potential theory are supplied.

articleTitle: Simulation-based analysis for structural reliability of the crane rail beam under stochastic crane movements and irradiation conditions
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This study presents a simulation-based approach to investigate the effects of stochastic crane movements on the structural reliability of the rail beam under radiation conditions. The rail beam is discretized into 47 equispaced structural points for strain profile calculation caused by a stochastically moving crane. The Normal distribution, Uniform distribution and 3-parameter Log-normal distributions are applied to describe the stochastic crane distances, respectively. The reliability at each structural point of the rail beam is defined with respect to the emergence of irradiation creep, which is calculated based on the accumulated strain over a given period of time. And the reliability of the rail beam is then determined by the minimum reliability calculated at different structural points, according to the weakest link principle. As shown by simulation results, the rail beam reliability degrades with the most rapid rate when the crane distances follow a Normal distribution, rather than the other two distributions. This offers a possible way to improve the reliability of the rail beam by avoiding clustered movements of the crane around the middle of the rail beam.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of small ballast cleaning machine frame
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The working environment of construction machinery is relatively complex, so the finite element random vibration method is applied to study the reliability characteristics of a construction machinery component under complex alternating load conditions in this paper, focusing on listing the load characteristics under different working conditions. The finite element analysis model of a frame structure is established by using ANSYS analysis software. The stress and strain, natural frequency, vibration mode and random vibration of the structure are analyzed under different working conditions. Based on Monte Carlo method, the load and chain speed are taken as random input variables, and the reliability of frame structure under alternating load is analyzed by using stochastic finite element model. The results show that this method is suitable for the analysis of structural reliability characteristics in uncertain working environment, which provides theoretical support for the reliability design of this kind of construction machinery structure.

articleTitle: Nonlinear viscoelastic analysis based on dual neural networks
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Due to the complexity of materials, the mechanical analysis of viscoelastic problems becomes relatively difficult, so it has been widely concerned by scholars. Although the linear viscoelastic theory has been improved, there are still a lot of problems to be solved in the study of nonlinear theory and effective numerical methods. In this paper, the nonlinear viscoelastic problem is solved by the viscoelastic correspondence principle. In order to construct the nonlinear viscoelastic constitutive relation, the method of solving the elastic mechanics problem with dual neural network is presented, and the instantaneous stress and strain components in the nonlinear viscoelastic constitutive relation are calculated. Aiming at the problem that unknown parameters in the relaxation modulus fitting model are difficult to obtain, a custom neural network fitting method is introduced to fit the relaxation modulus. Dual neural network integral method is used to solve the integral problem in viscoelastic constitutive relation, the present stress and strain of a class of nonlinear viscoelastic materials are obtained, and the nonlinear viscoelastic problem is solved. Numerical examples show that the proposed method is an efficient and high-precision method for solving nonlinear viscoelastic problems.

articleTitle: Joint optimization of resource allocation and maintenance planning for multi-facility infrastructure systems
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This research considers an integrated resource allocation and maintenance planning with complex maintenance effects for infrastructure systems consisting of multiple facilities. We formulate the problem as the sum of multiple finite-horizon Markov decision processes subject to budget constraints and solve it using Lagrangian relaxation method. A two-stage method is presented to solve the Lagrangian dual problem via subgradient optimization. In Stage 1, the Lagrangian relaxation problem is decomposed into individual Markov decision process problems, which generally leads to maintenance policies violating budget constraints. A Lagrangian repair heuristic is proposed to repair the infeasible policies to high-quality feasible ones in Stage 2. A computational study is conducted to demonstrate the proposed model using a pavement system with two sections.

articleTitle: Case-based reasoning in improving quality of product development
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In order to improve quality in product developing process, a model to support product design quality improvement on CBR (Case-Based Reasoning, CBR) is proposed. In the model, design quality documents stored in the existing successful cases of case base are used to support the improving of design quality of similar products. According to the affiliated relationship among product structures, the artifacts and corresponding quality characteristics are represented by tree diagram to form the product structure characteristic tree. On the basis of this, the case representation method that the quality documents affiliated with artifacts are attached to corresponding artifact nodes of the product structure characteristic tree is put forward. The caseformed rules are deter-mined, and the way to determine the weight of artifacts and quality characteristics and the storage method of case are given. The similarity calculating method of quality characteristics based on fuzzy set theory is introduced. The key algorithm of case retrieval is studied. Finally, an example is analyzed to illustrate the proposed method.

articleTitle: A calculation method of pipeline reliability based on risk identification
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In the process of calculating the reliability of longdistance pipelines, a calculation method of pipeline section reliability, based on the semi-quantitative risk analysis widely used in the industry, is established to cope with the problems of low calculation efficiency of mathematical analysis and limited consideration of model failure factors. Based on this approach, the calculation efficiency is evidently improved by adopting some data of risk assessment results to carry out subsequent calculations. Moreover, the consideration scope of failure factors is enlarged with better practicality and easier calculation.

articleTitle: Integrated maintenance scheduling considering performance risks of machine
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Production, quality and maintenance are the three key functional characteristics for manufacturing system that are all achieved through the running machines. However, almost traditional studies on preventive maintenance only relied on simple failure probability of equipment, ignoring the impacts of production tasks and product quality on machine operational states. Despite the increased profits of product improved by preventive maintenance, it is meaningless to perform maintenance when quality improvement cannot compensate for maintenance cost. Thereby a preventive maintenance scheduling strategy for multistate manufacturing systems considering the influence of machine performance risks is proposed to decrease failure probability before it occurs. First, a new connotation of machine functional risk is expounded from explicit and implicit aspects to plan preventive maintenance. Second, the quantitative system evaluation of performance risks is established to describe the relationship between performance and cost. Third, the integrated maintenance scheduling for machines is developed to determine the maintenance time and degrees under the constraints of profit maximization. Finally, a case study of integrated maintenance scheduling on vehicle production is presented to verify its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Design of turbine accelerator and electromagnetic clutch for solar chimney power generation system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Solar chimney power generation system has the advantages of clean, no phase change heat transfer working medium, simple structure, low cost, and so on. It has been widely paid attention to and developed and can be combined with various forms of energy utilization, especially suitable for the rich solar energy resources, open areas, and thermal power supply is difficult to the region. To meet the minimum start-up requirements of a solar chimney power generation system, the minimum start-up wind speed of generator operation is studied on the angle between blade and turbine spindle connection (i.e., blade offset angle) and offset direction. The solar chimney power generation system is theoretically calculated and simulated to determine the minimum wind speed. Through ANSYS simulation of blades with different bias directions, the optimal bias angle is obtained as 6° by taking different downward bias angles. Appropriately reducing the area of blade pressure part reduces blade weight and saves material. Under the condition of not affecting the strength, the driving force is increased by changing the size of the blade root joint and the area of the blade tip stress area. Match accelerator and electromagnetic clutch.

articleTitle: Reliability study on fatigue life of axles of square bale pick-up and stacker trucks
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The high reliability of axles of square bale picking and palletizing truck in the working process is important. In this paper, reliability analysis of square bale pick-up and stacker trucks is performed. Firstly, the multi-body dynamics simulation software Adams is used to carry out the multi-body dynamics simulation of the square bale picking and palletizing truck to obtain the load on the axle during the working process. Secondly, the ANSYS software combined with Ncode software are used to analyze the fatigue life of axle. Thirdly, the response surface optimization method and the Six Sigma method are used to analyze the fatigue resistance and reliability. The results show that the optimized axle fatigue life is 2.74 x109 and reliability is 0.9993 , which meet the requirements of the pallet truck axles for square bale picking.

articleTitle: Failure mechanisms and reliability evaluation of RF front-end integrated circuit
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Attention is drawn to the problem of functional damage of an electronic device caused by high-power electromagnetic pulses. In order to have some insight into the electrical and thermal stability of the integrated circuit, a mathematical model of electromagnetic pulse on a bipolar junction transistor is developed. By use of the device simulator Medic, the internal behavior of the burned devices is analyzed. On the base of investigating the relation between electromagnetic pulse injection and voltage, current, power and energy, the damage threshold of integrate circuit is obtained by making the spot charts and fit-optimizing the spot with the software Origin. Combined with theoretical analysis, the damage regularity and mechanism of the device are summarized, which provide guidance for the subsequent protection design.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of general processing module of avionics system based on one-dimensional residual inception neural network
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: ocessing module is used to produce a failure mode dataset by fault injection and overlap sampling. An one-dimensional residual initial neural network is proposed, which uses the inception structure as the main body to achieve multi-scale feature extraction of the temporal sequence, and adds the residual structure to increase the model expression capability and avoid falling into overfitting. The result is also compared with various deep learning-based fault diagnosis models. Experiments prove that the proposed fault diagnosis method significantly improves accuracy and convergence speed in the fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: CE-CGAN: classification enhanced conditional generative adversarial networks for bearing fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Due to the limitations of actual working conditions and data acquisition equipment, the collected mechanical fault datasets are actually limited and class unbalanced, which limits the accuracy and stability of rolling bearing fault diagnosis. In this paper, we propose a classification-enhanced conditional generative adversarial network (CE-CGAN) to improve the quality of generated data and more importantly, to improve the accuracy of the diagnosis in the small samples and data imbalanced condition. The conditional generative adversarial network (CGAN) is used as the backbone. Aiming at the problem of inaccurate generation of data categories, the label embedding network of the generator is redesigned. The hinge loss is introduced to optimize network loss to improve the stability of this model. The new classification network is added to the model to improve fault diagnosis accuracy, which can collaborate with the generator to improve the quality of generated samples. The experiments show that our method can deal with the bearing fault diagnosis problem in the small samples case more effectively. The model could also improve the accuracy of classification and show better fault diagnosis performance in the case of class imbalance.

articleTitle: Quality assessment of analog to digital converter chip using test data set
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Analog to Digital Converter (ADC) chip test generates a test data set including several dynamic parameters at various frequency. It is a challenge to obtained its quality quantitatively from test data set due to its high dimension and various units. This paper develops a method named quality-spectrum to analyzing ADC quality characteristics using its data set. It displays all variation of test parameters on one picture. Meanwhile, the relationship among these parameters could be quantatitived through three viewpoints which is chip, parameter and frequency. First, define classifier rule according with the characteristics of ADC chip. Second, form the quality-spectrum which is a digital color image by mapping the test data set to a classification matrix Q and color it. Last, obtain the chip's quality distribution quantitatively by calculating the fault score of classification matrix Q from different dimensions. The quality characteristics distribution of ADC chips could be observed directly and calculated quantitatively through quality-spectrum. A test data set of ADC chip is used to verify the validation of this method.

articleTitle: Reliability estimation of gap logic null gates based on testing data
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The gap logic null gates (GLNGs) are crucial elements for explosive logic networks (ELNs). Aiming at overcoming the restriction that lack of testing data of GLNGs. This paper carried out an experiment and as a basis of that to conduct a reliability estimation of a GLNG. The considered GLNG and its functional characteristics are first introduced. Moreover, a testing databased reliability estimation model is proposed. The validation of the results is reached by an experiment and the collected testing data. The results show that the proposed model is applicable for the reliability estimation of GLNGs and the gate length interval of [0.68mm 1.24mm] is suggested to make sure the safety of the GLNG.

articleTitle: Heat reliability analysis of satellite based on graph neural network
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: To guarantee the normal work of the satellite in orbit in complex thermal environment, analyzing the thermal reliability plays a key role. To alleviate the time consumption of numerical methods and introduce the connections between the subsystems based on deep learning, it proposed to analyze the thermal reliability with the graph neural networks. Modeling the satellite into a graph, which can predict the temperature field with the limited input monitoring temperature and then the reliability analysis is facilitated by the method of interval estimation. The results validate the performance of the model for prediction and thermal reliability analysis.

articleTitle: Denoising method of high-frequency ultrasonic detection signals of flip chip based on orthogonal matching pursuit optimized by artificial bee colony
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Flip chip technology is one of the most popular packaging technologies. High-frequency ultrasound is often used to detect flip chip defects, but the detection process is subject to noise interference, which affects the accuracy of the detection results. For this problem, we propose an orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) algorithm optimized by artificial colony (ABC) to denoise the high-frequency ultrasonic detection signal of flip chip. The introduction of ABC effectively reduces the computational complexity of the sparse decomposition of the OMP and changes the space for searching atoms from discrete to continuous, thus reducing the error between the echo signal and the atoms to improve the reconstruction accuracy. In addition, the random search direction of the ABC algorithm is changed to further accelerate the convergence of the algorithm. Finally, the range of atomic parameters is designed and the coefficients are processed to achieve effective denoising using the characteristics of highfrequency pulsed ultrasonic detection. Experiments show that the proposed method can effectively remove the random noise and grain noise from the echo signal and outperforms the matching pursuit (MP) and OMP algorithms.

articleTitle: Reliability reallocation of civil aircrafts based on operational data
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In this paper, the reliability reallocation problem of civil aircrafts is investigated based on operational data. Specifically, a minimum-workload-based algorithm is proposed, which will not decrease the reliability of the whole system and will minimize the workload or cost of reallocation. After presenting the algorithm, we solve the reliability reallocation problem of the general landing gear, which show the efficiency of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Multi-stage preventive maintenance optimization with thresholds of reliability
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This paper studies the problem of multi-stage preventive maintenance (PM) optimization on the basis of reliability thresholds. According to the change rule of product's failure rate and by means of setting the reliability thresholds, the replacement cycle is divided into three maintenance stages, they are: (1) Stage I: do not carry out PM; (2) Stage II: carry out periodic PM; (3) Stage III: carry out sequential PM. In each stage, the failures are restored with minimal repair. Age reduction factor and quasi-renewal coefficient are adopted to derive the recursive relations of failure rate function in each stage. A multi-stage PM optimization model is established based on the reliability thresholds, with the aim to minimize the equipment's expected cost rate. Taking the gearbox, rotor and bearing of wind turbine as an example, a case study is conducted to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis of the effects of information security attacks on the flight safety of a typical multi-rotor UAV
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: To integrate the security and safety analysis for autonomous system is an attractive topic and one challenge is how to determine the effects of information security attacks on system safety. In this short paper, we meet the challenge with a case study. the target system is a multi-rotor UAV, which is composed of open source hardware and software. Possible information security attacks on the UAV are listed according to a security reference model. Then, their effects on the flight safety are analyzed. Finally, as a conclusion, the effects of the security attacks are divided into four groups for further studies.

articleTitle: Pilot study of operational health management approach for transformers in nuclear power plant
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Power transformer is one of the most important electrical equipment for safe and reliable operation of Nuclear Power Plant. For trouble free operation of transformer, it is necessary to monitor its health during the lifecycle. There are clear needs for the development of prognostics and health management techniques so that smooth operation of transformer as well as safe operation of nuclear power plant can be ensured. This paper focuses on transformer asset management using Health Index approach. According to actual available data from a nuclear power plant, this paper revises the referenced HI model (Kinectrics Inc.) to consider actual test results of transformer performed in the field, dissolved gas analysis and other test of oil, maintenance work orders on various components of transformer, health of tap changer etc. The final value of health index is associated with the predicted life and condition of transformer according to pre-defined limits. Revised health index model studied is tested by the actual test data collected from a real nuclear power plant. It shows that the improved method is practically feasible for nuclear power plant. Introduction, revised health index model, results, discussion and recommendations are described in detail in following sections.

articleTitle: Discussion on uncertainty distribution of component reliability parameters in PSA general database
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Component reliability data is an important basis for nuclear power plants to carry out Probabilistic Safety Analysis(PSA). There are many options for the uncertainty distribution of reliability parameters. In this paper, the uncertainty distribution of reliability parameters in the “Equipment Reliability Data Report on Nuclear Power Plant of China”(version 2018) and the U.S. NUREG/CR-6928 general database are studied. Three distribution types of beta distribution, gamma distribution and lognormal distribution are used in China's data report, and only beta and gamma distribution are selected in NUREG/CR -6928 general database. In this paper, when the reliability parameters are estimated according to the classical estimation method in our country, the paper puts forward the suggestion of using the Simplified Constrained Noninformative Distribution (SCNID), and some application examples are given.

articleTitle: Remaining useful life prediction method of product based on improved transformer and GRU
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: With the advancement of artificial intelligence and machine learning technology, deep learning methods, as a class of data-driven methods, have become more and more popular in Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction. Time-series prediction is one main branch in RUL prediction. Gate Recurrent Unit (GRU) networks have shown their effectiveness in various sequence tasks, whose accuracy is decreased when doing long-term prediction. Transformer is considered as a suitable method for capturing long-distance dependencies due to its attention mechanism, but it was originally proposed for Natural Language Processing (NLP) problems. In this paper, we proposed a remaining useful life prediction method based on improved Transformer and GRU(Gformer). Specifically, we used the Transformer encoder to perform feature extraction on the transformed input data. Multihead attention can help to focus on specific parts and capture remote dependencies in the time sequence. Meanwhile, since transformer encoder can't comprehensively analyze the multiple features extracted by the multi-head attention, we combined the GRU networks to solve this problem. Finally, a case study was applied to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A model of sustainment maturity level for projects
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The foreign conception of Sustainment Maturity Level(SML) is analyzed. On the basis of the correlation of life-cycle phase for projects, and the analysis of sustainment elements division between home and abroad, the model of sustainment maturity level for projects is established. The definition and intension of each level, the corresponding relation with life-cycle phase, the assessment occasion, assessment criterion and the key points of assessment are presented. This research provides a reference to sustainment maturity assessment for projects.

articleTitle: Transient dynamics gear stress analysis of planetary gear train workbench
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Gear stress is an important mechanical property that affects the failure of blower planetary gear train. Considering the influence of meshing clearance, meshing stiffness, friction and contact accuracy, the torsional dynamic simulation model of blower planetary gear system is established by aerodynamic analysis of blower external load, dynamic simulation model analysis of planetary gear system and transient dynamic gear stress analysis of Workbench. Firstly, the input torque and output angular displacement are calculated according to the aerodynamic equation under external load. Secondly, the contact accuracy of the simulation model is ensured by the Pure Penalty contact algorithm. According to the input torque and output angular displacement, the maximum contact stress and bending stress between the gears are calculated by Workbench transient dynamic analysis. Finally, the failure forms of gear is revealed by comparing the contact fatigue limit and bending fatigue limit with the contact stress and bending stress. It has certain guiding significance for blower gear design.

articleTitle: Evolvement of guided wave features during composite material degradation and its application in damage detection
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The evolvement of guided wave features during the process of composite material degradation is studied. It is shown via experimental data that the amplitude and time of flight (TOF) of waves clearly varies with the degradation of carbon-fiberreinforced polymers (CFRP) and a significant transition of both features can be observed when delamination appears. The features of amplitude and TOF are then used to estimate the type of damage of CFRP. An improved feature extraction method is proposed. Along with the Gaussian discriminant analysis method, the damage detection accuracy is improved.

articleTitle: Target search of UAV swarm through information augment and direction adjustment
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In this paper a UAV swarm model considering communication range and node degree is proposed based on complex network and the classic Vicsek model. The concept of grid information is introduced, and the grid information's influence to the UAV is introduced to improve the classic Vicsek model. Then based on information augment and direction adjustment of UAVs according to the grid information, the UAVs swarm performs searching tasks on fixed targets and moving targets. Based on the designed simulation procedure, the results show that the proposed method can locate the fixed targets and track the motion direction of moving targets. When the target can destruct the UAV within its attack range, the factor of direction adjustment will affect the resilience of UAV swarm.

articleTitle: Design and uncertainty analysis of ice cream bar turning mechanism based on axiom design and TRIZ theory
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This article uses a combination of Axiomatic design (AD) and Theory of Innovation Problem Solving (TRIZ) as the basis of the mechanism design framework. First, the product structure design matrix is generated through the modular design process in AD, and then the contradiction analysis in TRIZ is used for the coupling design parameters in the design matrix to obtain a feasible solution of the design plan. To verify the reliability of the design scheme when considering the actual errors such as the size and shape of the ice cream bar, the known uncertain factors were quantified and Adams simulation was used. Finally, a secondorder moment method is used to analyze the reliability of the key nodes of the turning mechanism, and the reliability of the node is 90.66%, which verifies the reliability of the mechanism design.

articleTitle: Embryonics-based reconfigurable digital system for aerospace applications
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aerospace technology has entered the era of high modularization and integration. In order to ensure the tactical performance of the aerospace system and improve the availability and reliability, a FPGA+DSP based heterogeneous multi-core digital system hardware design scheme is proposed in this paper. The scheme has flexible structure and strong universality, which is suitable for modular design. Furthermore, in order to enhance the reliability of the system, an embryonic-based circuit design framework for avionic applications is proposed. The design framework combines the advantages of bio-inspired self-repairing technology and dynamic reconfiguration, which supports on-chip self-test and fault tolerance. The proposed architecture can be widely used as a new platform for self-repairing systems.

articleTitle: Study on testability design of gas purification subsystem based on correlation matrix
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Testability modeling and analysis play an increasingly important role in improving the level of testability design of products. Based on the correlation matrix, the testability analysis is carried out with a gas purification subsystem as an example. Aiming at the complex feedback loop caused by the external condition test and the cycle, a method of disconnecting the complex feedback loop is proposed, which improves the testability and fault diagnosis ability of the subsystem, and provides a method guidance for the testability design of other systems.

articleTitle: Multi-physics coupling test design and failure analysis of intelligent door lock
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In this paper, the multi-physical field coupling test of the intelligent door lock is firstly designed based on the actual service scenario of the product. The failure analysis of the display circuit is implemented after the multi-physical field coupling reliability test. The failure reasons and mechanism of the intelligent door lock abnormal-display widely existing in the market are proved and reproduced. The research shows that there are two main reasons for the abnormal display in the market at present. First, the mechanical cracking of the outer bonding point of the LED on the display panel leads to the failure of the LED, which in turn leads to an abnormal-display for the intelligent door lock. Second, improper three-defense technology of the display circuit system leads to sulfide corrosion failure of the silver layer of the resistance surface electrode, and the resistance of the circuit system increases or opens failure, which makes the intelligent door not display in service.

articleTitle: Cutting simulations of high volume SiCp/Al composites
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Cutting simulation may show the microcosmic deformation and damage of SiCp/Al composites under the condition of cutting process. In this paper, two dimension orthogonal cutting mechanical model was set as the finite element mode. Al matrix was set by the Johnson-Cook constitutive equation, SiC particle was set as a type of line elastic material which was isotropic. The influences of tool rake angle and cutting depth on cutting force and chips of SiCp/Al composites were studied by using ABAQUS simulation software. The simulation results show that the influences of tool rake angle and cutting depth on the cutting force are significant. Cutting force decreases obviously with the increasing of tool rake angle. Cutting force increases obviously with the increasing of cutting depth. SiC particle happens brittle fracture and Al matrix happens plastic deformation in the cutting processing.

articleTitle: Research on a new three proofing technique for the electric meter industry
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The operational environment of industrial electronic products is more rigorous than that of household electronic products. Three Proofing (moisture proofing, salt spray proofing, and fungus proofing) has become an important topic in the electronics industry. As the core component of electric equipment, the PCBA (Printed Circuit Board Assemblies) needs extra protection. PCBA surface coating is widely used in the electric meter industry. The voltage sampling circuit and the current sampling circuit are the core parts of the electric meter, which are more sensitive to the influence of moisture, salt spray, and fungus. The traditional surface coating method comes into effect on Three Proofing to some extent, but it also takes some unfavorable factors. A new Three Proofing technique is proposed via the special treatment of solder paste. Anti crack resin and other components are added to the solder paste in a certain proportion. During Reflow Soldering Process, the resin melts and adsorbs on the surface of the solder joint, which forms a protective layer for the solder joint. Reliable experimental verification shows that the proposed technology not only has the function of the Three Proofing, but also solves the unfavorable factors of the traditional process. This provides a new feasible solution for Three Proofing of the electric meter industry.

articleTitle: Multiaxial fatigue life prediction of an aero-engine turbine shaft with a modified critical plane-based model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: For aero-engine components subjected to complex multiaxial loadings, estimating their fatigue damage and life accurately is important to ensure structural integrity and safety of the engine. To make up for the deficiency that results obtained through uniaxial fatigue life prediction models is sometimes unable to satisfy the requirements of engineering accuracy under practical loading conditions, this research carries out the fatigue life prediction of an aero-engine turbine shaft with a multiaxial fatigue approach, which can better reflect the fatigue damage evolution of the shaft. What's more, considering the influence of multi-critical sections on structure, this research modified the SWT model when predicting the fatigue life of turbine shaft. An actual engineering case is completed to validate the feasibility of the proposed approach, and the predicted result is consistent with practice.

articleTitle: Reliability and maintainability analysis of nuclear safety-level regulating valve for passive pressurized water reactor
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The reliability of the regulating valve is very important to the safety of nuclear power plants. This article has carried out reliability research and analysis on the nuclear safety-level regulating valve system in passive pressurized water reactor nuclear power plants. The failure mode, effects and criticality analysis(FMECA) method is used to analyze the passive pressurized water reactor nuclear power plant. The failure modes and causes of regulating valves in nuclear power plants are analyzed, and by collecting operating data of the same type of valves in nuclear power plants, the reliability data of the valves are given, and it has certain guiding significance for the design and maintenance of the nuclear safety level regulating valve of passive pressurized water reactor nuclear power plant.

articleTitle: Research on a comprehensive evaluation model of small and medium industrial gas boiler based on energy efficiency and emission data
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Industrial boilers are important energy supply equipment in modern socialized mass production and one of the main sources of air pollution. Which makes monitoring and managing energy efficiency emissions of boilers an inevitable requirement for environmental management. Most small and medium capacity industrial boilers are not fully equipped with online monitoring/testing functions for thermal efficiency parameters and emission parameters. Moreover, due to the instability of boiler operation system, operation and maintenance management and personnel operation specifications during boiler operation process also would affect the energy efficiency and emission optimization level of industrial boilers greatly. In view of the above characteristics, a multidimensional evaluation model of energy-efficiency emission of industrial boilers is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the multi-dimensionality evaluation metrics including boiler operation status detection factors, transformation technology application factors, personnel operation and process management factors is established, and then back propagation neural network, hierarchical analysis method AHP((Analytic Hierarchy Process) and fuzzy multi-attribute TOPSIS(Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to an Ideal Solution) method are used to judge index weights and evaluate score according to the actual condition, and finally the quantitative comprehensive evaluation value of energy-efficient emissions of industrial boilers is obtained. The established model was also verified by example.

articleTitle: Rest life prediction of rotating machine based on manifold algorithm and time-varying hidden semi-Markov model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The fault signal of rotating machinery contains a lot of useful information such as equipment degradation data, but the components are complex. This paper put forward a method of rest life prediction of rotating machinery based on manifold algorithm and time-varying hidden semi-Markov model (HSMM). The local linear embedding (LLE) algorithm can be used to fuse the high dimensional features of the running signals of the equipment, and a new one-dimensional fusion feature set which covers the linear and nonlinear information of the state signals is obtained. The hidden semi-Markov model is combined with the time-varying state transition probability matrix, and the rest life of rotating machinery could be predicted by the fusion feature set. At last, a life cycle signal of rolling bearing is used to verify this method.

articleTitle: Reliability life evaluation of smart electricity meter based on copula function
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Smart electricity meter is an important computing terminal in the construction of ubiquitous power Internet of Things, and its reliable life is very important. In this paper, a reliable life evaluation method of smart electricity meter based on Copula function is proposed. This paper introduces a degradation modeling method for clock and metering units of smart electricity meter, and obtains the reliability function of clock and metering units of smart electricity meter. Copula function is used to describe the correlation between the clock unit and the metering unit, and the reliability function of the whole smart electricity meter is calculated, and the reliability life of the whole smart electricity meter is evaluated.

articleTitle: A study of the roller profile modification design of a cylindrical roller bearing with a titling angle of roller
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The roller stress distribution in the cylindrical roller bearing can be changed by the rollers with a tilting angle, which can also affect the bearing life. Many current studies focused on the roller profile modification design, contact area, contact deformation, and stress distribution for the rollers without t he titling angle. When the rollers with the titling angle, few studies focused on the roller stress distribution for the roller with different profile modification cases and titling resistance capacity. To overcome this question, a non ideal Hertzian conta ct model between the roller and raceway is presented by using the non ideal Hertzian contact theory. The effects of the fully crowned profile, partially crowned profile with one curvature center, partially crowned profile with two curvature centers, and lo garithmic profile on the stress distribution between roller and raceway and titling resistance capacity of different profile modification cases are studied. The results show that the roller stress distribution for different profile modification cases are a symmetrical when the roller is titling; The stress value of roller end increases with the titling angle; Compared to the roller without a titling angle, the increment of maximum contact stress value of the fully crowned profile is smallest in the four diff erent profile modification cases; the increment of maximum contact stress value of the logarithmic profile is largest in the four different profile modification cases; the fully crowned profile has a higher titling resistance capacity; the logarithmic prof ile has a lower titling resistance capacity.

articleTitle: Research on optimization method of aviation equipment spare parts ordering strategy based on PHM
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: As aviation equipment increasingly presents the characteristics of complexity, integration, and intelligence, traditional aviation equipment fault diagnosis technology can hardly meet new needs of equipment. In the 1990s, the United States took the lead in proposing autonomous logistics support, and PHM (Prognostics and Health Management, PHM) is the core technology of autonomous logistics support. PHM technology can evaluate and predict the state of equipment through the inspection of equipment, thus it can provide decision support for the maintenance of equipment. This paper combines PHM technology with aviation equipment spare parts ordering strategy, and proposes a PHM-based aviation equipment spare parts ordering strategy optimization method. The method is verified effectively with a case and can provide certain reference for the application of PHM technology in aviation equipment.

articleTitle: Reliability assessment of switching mode power supply considering capacitor degradation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The reliability of switching mode power supply (SMPS) has an extremely important impact on the safe operation of power electronic systems. Most of faults or failures are caused by the degradation of its key components. However, current research has not made sufficient use of component-level degradation information yet. This paper proposes a reliability assessment method for SMPS based on the film capacitor degradation. Firstly, the working principle of the SMPS is analyzed. The capacitance of the film capacitor is selected as a sensitive parameter affecting the output voltage ripple of the SMPS using multi-parameter sensitivity analysis and a Saber simulation model. Then, by analyzing the failure mechanism of the film capacitor, an accelerated degradation test (ADT) of the film capacitor was carried out using both voltage and temperature as accelerated stresses. Subsequently, the test data of the film capacitors is substituted into the SMPS Saber simulation model to obtain the degradation trajectory of the output voltage ripple. Finally, a random effect Wiener process, which considers the individual variability of the samples, is used to establish the degradation model of the output voltage ripple. The reliability of the SMPS is assessed. And this reliability assessment framework may also be available for other electronic systems.

articleTitle: Uncertainty analysis of light and thin bulk material movement
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: During the process of finishing, loading, stripping, rejecting, turning over, and packaging, the light and thin bulk materials on the ice cream stick production line had motion uncertainty due to the warpage, random friction and collision of natural wood. This paper started with the research on the formation mechanism, influence degree and propagation law of the uncertainty in the movement of bulk materials, to identify and quantify the uncertainty. In the present article, the source of motion uncertainty is analyzed in the actual light and thin bulk ice cream stick production line. Aiming at the influence of motion uncertainty on the processing efficiency and processing accuracy of the light and thin bulk ice cream stick production line, the causes of motion uncertainty is deeply studied including the propagation law, and the performance impact of each process of the production line. Finally, the reliability analysis theory of icecream sticks under random motion uncertainty was explored.

articleTitle: Multi-attribute joint determination of condition-based maintenance and economic manufacturing quantity
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Considering condition-based maintenance (CBM), a multi-objective joint decision model of the classic economic manufacturing quantity (EMQ) is developed. Taking availability, and expected cost per unit time as two utility attributes, the multiattribute utility function is maximized with two decision variables, production lot size and CBM threshold. The degradation process of the system is modeled based on the random coefficient growth model which includes the actual deterioration condition and the random error. The system is renewed immediately when it reaches the pre-set maintenance threshold or fails. Numerical examples based on the data from a steel mill are taken to assess the model and sensitive analysis of parameters is provided.

articleTitle: A GSPN-based method for dynamic system reliability modelling and evaluation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: As dynamics has been significant characteristics of modern systems, many dynamic reliability analysis methods are studied, such as Markov method and dynamic Bayesian network. Among these existing methods, generalized stochastic Petri net (GSPN) has an excellent ability of characterizing the dynamic behaviors of systems, but because of its poor computing capability it can only be applied to simple system reliability analysis. Monte Carlo simulation method is powerful in computing, but it has no ability to model system dynamic behavior intuitively. In view of the fact that both GSPN and Monte Carlo method have a potential of making up the disadvantage of each other, this paper proposes a dynamic reliability analysis methodology by the combination of these two methods. Specifically, the paper defines a new GSPN for modeling dynamic systems. Afterwards, a simulation algorithm for analyzing the new GSPN is developed based on the Monte Carlo theory. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed methodology is validated with a dynamic electromechanical system, which is analyzed by using the new proposed method and traditional Markov method, separately.

articleTitle: Research on damage inspection and evaluation of large volume glass fiber wrapped cylinder in tube trailer in China
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In order to improve the transportation efficiency of tube trailer, the large volume glass fiber wrapped cylinder is used as the gas storage unit in tube trailer. This paper summarizes the typical damage types such as abrasion, cut, impact and stress rupture of the composite overwrap during the using process of large volume glass fiber wrapped cylinders, and the current evaluation standards for the damage of the wrapped cylinders. Through preliminary experimental research, the abrasion and cut damage evaluation standard for continuing to be used is currently set as 30% of the thickness of the composite overwrap layer. However, the evaluation standard for impact damage needs to be studied, which makes the safety performance of cylinders still difficult to assess. The current existing evaluation standard is not suitable for large volume wrapped gas cylinders. In addition, stress rupture as a unique damage type of large volume wrapped cylinder is not involved in the current evaluation standards.

articleTitle: Reliability assessment on the topology of distributed power grid for UAVs
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Abstract–Due to the special structure of distributed power system on UAV and its critical reliability requirements, it is necessary to build an appropriate reliability evaluation method. This paper presents a reliability evaluation method based on N-K cascading fault model. The method is based on the simulation of power system fault, the calculation of DC power flow, and the analyzing of load shedding under different fault combinations. In order to validate the proposal, case studies are implemented on a solar UAV, where classic topology schemes of distributed power system are evaluated. The results show that the evaluation index is reasonable and the proposed method greatly reduces the computational complexity, thus providing a promising reliability evaluation tool for the optimization of grid topology.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of lattice infilled landing impact absorbing structure for a reentry capsule
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The reentry capsule for returning samples from extraterrestrial celestial body usually is of small size and compact layout, while at the same time it must be able to withstand the heavy impact during landing. Thus, the design of the lading impact absorbing structure is very challenging. This study proposes employing the truss lattice infilled sandwich structures to achieve the goal of both lightweight design and effective landing impact absorbing. Firstly, the homogenized equivalent mechanical properties of the BCC and BCCZ lattice structures are analyzed and compared. Then, sizing optimization is performed for the lattice infilled impact absorbing structure based on the design of experiment (DOE) and response surface methodology (RSM). Results indicate that when the incline angles of the bars in the lattice structure are small, the BCCZ lattice infilled structure can have better comprehensive loading-bearing performance, i.e. it can achieve better resistance to landing impact deformation give the same structural weight.

articleTitle: Vibration reliability analysis of circular saw blade for Salix flat stubble
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In In order to solve the damage of the saw blade and the poor quality of the flat stubble caused by the vibration during the salivary sawing process, the structural reliability analysis of the flat stubble circular saw blade was carried out. According to the basis that the absolute value of the difference between the natural frequency of the random structure and the excitation frequency does not exceed the specified value. The reliability model of the random structure vibration of the circular saw blade tool for flat stubble is defined, and the frequency reliability analysis method to avoid the resonance of the circular saw blade is proposed. The first 65th order natural frequency of the circular saw blade was obtained through finite element modal analysis, and the force in the three-coordinate axis direction was obtained through the explicit dynamic analysis of salix sawing through Ls-Dyna. On this basis, the harmonic response analysis was carried out to obtain the lateral displacement-frequency response curve of the circular saw blade, and the frequency reliability of the circular saw blade was calculated by using the probability finite element method. The result analysis shows that with the increase of the modal order, the natural frequency increases, the energy that stimulates the highorder vibration decreases, and the circular saw blade for flat stubble avoids the low-order destructive resonance, and mainly produces high-order resonance fatigue.
