In order to reduce the fatigue risk In order to improve the service life of the saw blade, the rotation speed of the circular saw blade should be reasonably selected; in the case of the standard approach value Y=18, the tool failure probability p<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub> is less than 0.05, the reliability R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub> is greater than 0.95, and the structural frequency reliability of the saw blade is within the speed range. meet the usage requirements

articleTitle: Strength reliability analysis of the emergency break-away fuse pin of civil aircraft pylon
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The break-away fuse pin of civil aircraft pylon is an emergency disconnection connector connecting the engine pylon joints and the wing joints. The break-away fuse pin needs to ensure rapid disconnection and clear damage mode during emergency landing. Taking the C919 aircraft IPS break-away fuse pin as the research object, the strength analysis of the fuse pin structure is carried out, and the influence of the diameter-thickness ratio on the failure mode and failure load of the fuse pin is studied. Considering the dispersity of structural size and material parameters of the fuse pin, use neural network response surface method to analyze the reliability and sensitivity of the fuse pin strength and it is found that the main factors affecting the reliability of the fuse pin emergency disconnection are: friction coefficient, the inner diameter of the fuse pin, and the outer diameter of the fuse pin.

articleTitle: Study on methods of condition monitoring and fault diagnosis for digital nuclear power plant equipment
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This paper studies the algorithm logic of equipment status and fault mode monitoring, based on the equipment operation data collected by the digital Instrument & Control (I&C) system of nuclear power plant, and combined with the specific operation environment of the equipment. The purpose of this study is to provide a method for establishing status monitoring logic of equipment supported by nuclear power plant data acquisition system, and to support the input of nuclear power plant risk monitoring. This paper takes the pump of component cooling water (CCW) system in a nuclear power plant as the research object, and verifies the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Optimum condition-based maintenance of fatigue-sensitive structures with time-variant repair thresholds
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Ship structures are subjected to fatigue damage during their service life. To maintain the safety level, life cycle management methods are often adopted to schedule repair actions. With the development of detection technology, condition-based maintenance (CBM) plays a more important role in life cycle management. Setting the repair thresholds are critical for optimum CBM. Most of the existing CBM policies set constant repair thresholds in each inspection. It is worthy to investigate the effect of setting time-variant repair thresholds in CBM. This paper compares constant repair thresholds and time-variant repair thresholds within the decision tree analysis for optimum CBM policy. Both CBM are derived by minimizing the life cycle costs which is the sum of inspection, repair and failure costs. A fatigue structure is studied and the results show that time-variant repair thresholds CBM can obtain a more economical and flexible maintenance policy compared with constant thresholds.

articleTitle: Reliability optimization design and analysis of pavement milling cutter head
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In the road milling process, the milling cutter head of the construction equipment is easy to fail. In order to ensure that the milling cutter head works reliably, the paper combines the actual working conditions of road milling and uses the orthogonal test method, based on the discrete element method. Numerical simulation of the working process is carried out to obtain the stress distribution of the milling cutter head during the working process. On this basis, the reliability of the milling cutter head is calculated based on the stress-strength interference model, and the reliability of the milling cutter head and the diameter of the cutter head are established through regression analysis., The mapping relationship between milling angle and rotor speed, and the use of genetic algorithm to obtain the parameters of the milling cutter head with the highest reliability The results show that the optimized cutter head diameter is 25 mm, the milling angle is 30 degrees, the rotor speed is 10rad/s, and the advancing speed is 0.15m/s. The reliability of the cutter head without fracture and failure is 0.999402. Taking the Wirtgen W2000 road milling machine as an example, the number of cutter heads installed is 174, and the total reliability of the milling rotor without cutter head fracture is 0.901.

articleTitle: Research of FMEA method based on ontology
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) is a topdown approach to analysis, which is widely used in domestic aerospace, aviation, machinery, and other advanced high-tech fields. As an effective method to improve reliability, the existing analysis process comprehensively considers the failure modes and effects of the system or components, and systematically forms the FMEA report. However, there are still some problems such as low sharing rate, low reuse rate, and high randomness of subjective factors in expert analysis. In this paper, an ontology-based FMEA method research scheme is proposed, the intelligent FMEA ideas are analyzed, the ontology model is constructed, finally, the knowledge concept and relationship are modeled and visualized, which effectively improves the sharing and reuse of FMEA knowledge.

articleTitle: Task-oriented requirement satisfactory degree establish method for maintenance material support capability
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of weak pertinence and lack of quantitative analysis method in maintenance material support capability requirement analysis, a task-oriented analysis method of maintenance material support capability requirement satisfaction was proposed. By decomposing mission and task and combining with mapping relationship, the maintenance material support capability requirements under specific mission task are obtained. By using grey relational analysis method and approximate ideal solution method, a task-oriented model of maintenance material support capability requirement satisfaction degree was proposed to realize the quantitative analysis of maintenance material support capability requirement. Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness and availability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of rolling bearing under multiple working conditions based on multi-scale kernel convolution neural network
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: As the key component of wind turbine, the rolling bearing of gearbox plays an important role in the running process of wind turbine. However, in real-world situations, the working environment and conditions of wind turbine are very bad, resulting in a high failure incidence probability of gearbox rolling bearings. As mechanical vibration signals are typically non-stable, non-linear, and non-periodic, failure mode and its mapping relation to the raw signal signs become very complex. This paper aims to design a convolutional neural network based on multi-scale kernel depth and angular domain re-sampling intelligent fault diagnosis model to accurately diagnose the rolling bearing fault of gearbox. The model can effectively reduce the difference of vibration signals caused by rotational speed changes, and the inception model is used to divide the deep convolutional neural network into multiple branches to extract the features of rolling bearings in uniform or variable rotational speed states. After extracting the features, information fusion and fault classification are carried out. This combination model has excellent feature learning ability and classification performance. Moreover, the proposed method can adapt to fault diagnosis under variable speeds and multiple working conditions, and the robustness and accuracy of fault diagnosis are greatly improved.

articleTitle: Study on stability of interlaminar shear strength of phenolic thermal protective materials under high temperature environment
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In this experiment, carbon fiber reinforced phenolic resin matrix composites were used to prepare laminates. The degradation degree and stability of interlaminar shear strength of experimental samples under different high temperature heating conditions were studied by combining experiment with linear regression statistical analysis. The experimental data were extracted by experiment and then the experimental results were verified by linear regression statistical analysis. The results show that the interlaminar shear strength of the sample is greatly affected by high temperature heating, and the experimental results can be verified by linear regression analysis.

articleTitle: Modified mission reliability evaluation method based on operational characteristics of warship equipment
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The traditional reliability evaluation method does not consider the equipment use environment and multistage mission situation, and can not truly reflect the quality characteristics of equipment in different mission phase. Based on the use characteristics of warship equipment, this paper proposes the methods of considering mission multistage, mission duty cycle correction and maintainability correction when calculating the unit level product mission reliability. It can effectively reflect the use characteristics of ship unit level products, and provides a new method for evaluating the mission reliability of warship equipment.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of gear box for electric drill based on grey correlation and fault tree
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The electric drill gearbox is the key component of electric drill operation. In order to diagnose and prevent its fault and explore the key factors leading to the fault of the electric drill gearbox, the failure mode is analyzed by using grey correlation analysis on the basis of the fault tree method. Combined with the existing data, the fault tree of the electric drill gearbox is qualitatively analyzed and quantitatively calculated, and the structural characteristics of the electric drill gearbox are clarified Point and failure influencing factors. With the help of grey correlation analysis, the grey correlation degree is calculated to find out the weak link of the system.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of dynamic systems based on SVR-NARX model and importance sampling
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In engineering practice, structural system with dynamic output performance has gained more and more attention. Reliability analysis of these dynamic systems based on the real performance function is normally time-consuming, which is hard to accept in engineering. An SVR-NARX (Support vector machine regression-Nonlinear autoregressive with exogenous input) model is, therefore, established in this paper to replace the real performance function for reliability analysis. To further improve the efficiency for dynamic systems with small failure probability, importance sampling is combined with SVR-NARX model. Two nonlinear examples in this paper show that the established SVR-NARX model can accurately describe the dynamic behavior of the systems, and the proposed method is efficient and accurate for the reliability analysis of dynamic systems.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization of wind turbine main shaft using Kriging model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Wind turbine main shaft usually works on the top of the wind turbine. As one of the key components of the main transmission chain of wind turbine, its reliability and quality not only affect its own service life, but also produce stress to other components in the wind turbine. In order to improve the operating conditions of the wind turbine, this study optimized the maximum stress response and volume of the wind turbine main shaft. The structural parameters of main shaft are optimized by multiobjective particle swarm optimization algorithm. Meanwhile, the Kriging model is also used to predict the stress response of the main shaft during the optimization process. At the end of the optimization, the multi-objective optimization of the stress response and volume of the wind turbine main shaft under specific load conditions is realized, which improves the reliability of the main shaft and reduces the mass of the main shaft.

articleTitle: Key meta-action identification for CNC machine tool under dual-criteria
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Reliability and accuracy are two key performance indexes of CNC machine tools, and the parts with greater influence on them are more critical. Aiming at the difficulty of extracting key parts of CNC machine tools, a method considering the dualcriteria of reliability and accuracy of CNC machine tools for identifying key meta-actions is proposed based on the fuzzy theory and the rough theory. Firstly, according to the structure decomposition method FMA(Function-Motion-Action), the functions of CNC machine tools are decomposed into motions and meta-actions. Then, considering reliability criteria, the importance of meta-actions is established by triangular fuzzy theory. On the other hand, considering accuracy criteria, the importance of motions is established by rough number, and the motion error transfer sensitivity is calculated by Sobol' method, so as to obtain the importance of meta-actions under accuracy criteria. After that, the key meta-actions based on dual-criteria both reliability and accuracy are obtained by the Borda method. Finally, an NC turntable is taken as an example to verify the effectiveness of the method. The result shows that the use of the FMA method can simplify the decomposition process of CNC machine tools, and it's more reasonable to identify the key meta-actions by comprehensively considering the reliability and accuracy of CNC machine tools.

articleTitle: Lifetime estimation for load-sharing systems based on Wiener process
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: To ensure the operating reliability and safety, loadsharing technique has been widely applied in many industrial systems. Therefore, how to estimate accurately the lifetime of loadsharing system is an interesting and significant issue in the prognostics and health management (PHM). In this paper, a general degradation modeling method of load-sharing system was proposed based on Wiener process. By fully taking into account the influence of failed components on degradation rate and uncertainty of the remaining surviving components, the probability density function (PDF) of lifetime was derived under the concept of the first passage time (FPT). Additionally, the maximum likelihood estimation method and least square estimation were employed to identify the model unknown parameters. Finally, a numerical case was provided for illustration.

articleTitle: Relation extraction for wind tunnel maintenance based on BiGRU and multi-head attention
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In the process of wind tunnel maintenance and support, fault knowledge was usually stored in an unstructured form which was not easy to be efficiently reused. Therefore, it is necessary to investigate the knowledge extraction technology for wind tunnel fault text. As a key link of knowledge extraction, relation extraction had aroused wide attention. However, there were no reported methods for fault knowledge relation extraction. In this paper, we propose multi-head-attention-based bidirectional gated recurrent networks to extract relationships from text-based wind tunnel fault knowledge. In a case study, the validity of the proposed method is verified by real wind tunnel fault corpus.

articleTitle: Constitutive modeling for the temperature-dependent stress-strain behavior of polymer-bonded composite materials
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Accurate characterization of the tension and compression behavior of polymer-bonded composite materials (PBMs) under different temperatures is essential to understanding their mechanical properties and deformation. Therefore, this study proposed a stress-strain constitutive model to describe the deformation of PBMs, which is generalized and temperature-dependent. The uniaxial tension and compression response of material specimens prior to failure are studied in the temperature range of -40°C to 75°C. The test data demonstrate temperature dependence of the specimens and the corresponding stress-strain curves can be approximated as linear elastic and plastic parts. Based on the testing results, the Ramberg-Osgood type equation is used to describe stress-strain curves. Using the response surface model to fit the relation of parameter and temperatures, a general stress-strain model considering the temperature-dependent was developed. The model effectiveness is validated by using independent testing data and third-party data. Compared with the reference model, the proposed model yields smaller relative errors.

articleTitle: Re-dispatch time demonstration for equipment based on stepwise decision-making algorithm
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the lack of consideration of constraint variables in the formulation of equipment redispatch time in the maintenance concept, a stepwise optimization algorithm model of equipment re-operation time based on multiple resource constraints is constructed. Taking into account the constraints of the equipment and other constraints, it can optimization the calculation of the actual equipment re-dispatch time, and realize the calculation through Python programming, and apply the constructed optimization algorithm. Whether the dispatch time is reasonable lays the foundation for further scientific formulation of maintenance concepts.

articleTitle: Sample plan research of acceptance test for lot-producing spacecraft products
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Lot production of spacecraft products is discussed with the development of commercial aerospace, especially the proposal of LEO communication constellation project, which also brings great challenges to the traditional customized spacecraft development and test program. In order to meet the low-cost and short-duration requirements of the production and delivery process, the idea of sampling inspection is applied to the acceptance test of spacecraft products. The group sampling plan was designed while the feasibility and risk of applying sampling inspection technology to the acceptance test of spacecraft products are discussed. The application of sampling technology can save the test resources, reduce the test duration so that it decreases the cost. But it also brings the risk of not finding all the defectives. The sampling acceptance test method is appropriate for spacecraft products in lot production with high maturity and strong risk tolerance. The research in this paper provides some reference for the test design of spacecraft products in lot production.

articleTitle: An improved inspection strategy analysis for long-term storage product
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: For most military products, such as missiles, torpedoes and their spare parts, after production they must be stored for long time until being put into operational use. During the storage period, the inspections are performed periodically to monitor the functionality of products. However, such inspections expose products to working conditions, yielding significant extra degradation increments. The number of inspections need to be optimized to make the trade-off between the accuracy of parameter estimation and the degradation caused by the inspections. Therefore, during storage opportune inspections are demanded. In this study, the degradation model with binary degradation rates regarding the inspection and storage period is introduced and the corresponding parameter estimating approach is given based on Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE). Moreover, we improve the widely-adopted periodic inspection strategy into a two-stage pattern that the inspection is less frequent in the first stage by adopting a larger interval. The availability and feasibility of the proposed degradation model and inspection strategy are verified through three numerical studies.

articleTitle: Anomaly detection for steam turbine based on dual-attention autoencoder
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Anomaly detection plays an essential role in routine operation and maintenance of steam turbine. Due to vague parameter correlation, various working condition, and nonstationary industry process, there still remain challenges in building representation models to detect abnormal working condition accurately and sensitively. To alleviate this problem, this paper proposes an autoencoder(AE) approach with dual-attention mechanism, including parameter attention and temporal attention, to learn data distribution under the normal working condition. In dual-attention mechanism, parameter attention mechanism exerts varying weight to parameters referring to their current significance, and temporal attention mechanism improves information integration by utilizing the hidden state of gated recurrent unit(GRU) cells. Based on the output of AE, box-cox transformation and three-sigma rule of thumb determine the dynamic threshold. The proposed approach is evaluated through experiments on steam turbine from a real case. The experiment result demonstrates it outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines for advanced alarm time and better stability.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation of multi-state load sharing effect via FM cumulative model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Load sharing effect is functional dependency in k-out-n system. The cumulative loading history model has been widely studied in binary state load sharing effect, however, there are few studies to describe the cumulative loading effect for multi-state cases. When a system performs tasks of multiple efficiency levels, it usually presents a certain number of performance degradation states. Aiming at the dependence of load sharing effect, a multistate failure mechanism accumulation model is proposed to sketch it. The multi-state degradation process is modeled for multi-state component and system. In the case study, dynamic reliability of a voltage-stabilizing system with multi-state load sharing effect is evaluated.

articleTitle: Thermal analysis of vapor chamber of ASAAC module based on model validation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of high precision, small size and light weight of military electronic equipment, the heat flux becomes higher and higher. The vapor chamber has been studied by many researchers in the military field due to its excellent heat transfer performance. Therefore, in this paper the heat dissipation performance of ASSAC module (vapor chamber) is studied by simulation and validation, which is a typical product of airborne. The results indicate that the average temperature of the components of ASSAC module (VC) is lower, the temperature uniformity is better, and the heat dissipation performance is significantly improved compared with the ASSAC module (Aluminum Alloy 6061). The simulation and validation method of the heat dissipation performance of the ASSAC module in this paper is effective and reliable, which can be applied to the optimization of similar airborne products.

articleTitle: Study of residual stress distribution in car body welds based on X-ray diffraction method
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Welding residual stress has a significant influence on the initiation and propagation of fatigue cracks in welded structures. It is important to determine the distribution of residual stress in welding parts when the fatigue life is evaluated. The specimen of aluminum butt welding seam was taken from the car body of high speed train, and surface residual stress was measured by using X-ray diffraction method. The results show that there are obvious differences in the uniformity and diffraction peak intensity of the Debye ring of different parts of specimen. Along the line perpendicular to the weld, the distributions of residual stress appear bimodal shape. The peak values appear in the weld near to base metal and the valley value appears in the center of the weld. The maximum value of longitudinal residual stress is far higher than that of the transverse residual stress. The welding boundary has few effect on the residual stress by measuring the residual stress at different distances from the welding free boundary.

articleTitle: A hybrid fruit fly optimization algorithm based on three dimensional space
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The original fruit fly optimization algorithm (FOA) for the optimal solution in two dimensional space has been proposed to address complex optimization problems in a myriad of domains, such as production scheduling, path planning, financial investment, and software engineering. However, FOA is confronted with two defects unsolved. One is that the convergence speed is relatively low and the other is that the convergence accuracy is relatively low. In this paper, to solve the abovementioned two problems and improve the original FOA, we firstly propose a novel hybrid fruit fly optimization algorithm after due diligence, known as HFOA-3D based on three dimensional space, which takes advantage of crossover operator and mutation operator of genetic algorithm. We also conduct an experiment including five classic test functions to evaluate the performance of HFOA-3D. Finally, the experiment result shows that HFOA-3D outperforms the original FOA in terms of convergence speed and convergence accuracy.

articleTitle: Machine vision inspection of roughness defects in opaque board surface
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: A machine visual method is introduced to inspect roughness defects from the opaque board surface. The new method uses the line-structured light technology with direct triangulation structure to obtain three-dimensional (3D) information. The captured light stripe image modulated by the board surface is processed firstly with the Steger algorithm to extract the center line of the light strip with sub-pixel level. The key parameter used in the Steger algorithm is obtained by estimating the width of light strip. Furthermore, the Zhang Zhengyou's method is used to calibrate the camera parameters, and the 3D depth information is calibrated through the light plane fitting method combining with the principal component analysis (PCA). As a result, the 3D coordinate information corresponding to the center line of the light stripe on the measured surface can be obtained. Finally, the average deviation of profile arithmetic (Ra index) is employed to evaluate the roughness defect of board surface. The experimental results indicate that the method proposed in the paper can achieve a detecting accuracy of 0.02mm (Ra), which can meet the needs of high-quality wooden board for roughness defect inspection. Compared with the traditional contact detecting method and manual method, the proposed method has high detecting efficiency, low cost, reliable detecting result, and holds a good engineering application prospect.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of laminated composite plates based on progressive failure method and universal gray system approach
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The mechanical responses of composite structures are dependent on the parameter uncertainties, such as fiber orientations, ply thicknesses, and applied loads. In view of these problems, a universal gray system approach is applied to accurately reflect the impact of parameter uncertainties on the failure load and the initial damage of composite laminates. Deterministic failure criteria of composite laminates is modified based on nonlinear behavior and maximum stress criteria. The user subroutines USDFLD in Abaqus are used to modify the linear elastic material behavior. The maximum range of failure indexes are obtained and the lower and upper bounds of the uncertain parameters are drawn based on progressive failure method and universal gray system approach. The proposed method is then demonstrated by considering an open-hole composite laminate subjected to different types of load conditions. The results indicate that the framework can find the ranges of exact failure probability distributions in an efficient and accurate manner.

articleTitle: Transmission delay simulation for edge computing network with service integrating mode
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The transmission delay of the edge computing network directly affects the success rate of data package transmission in the network. If the transmission delay is too long, the reliability of the network will decline. It is difficult to accurately calculate the delay and reliability of edge computing networks by traditional queuing theory. ln this paper, as the edge computing nodes in the service integration model, we establish a simulation model of edge computing latency considering the integrated bandwidth, the loss rate of the data package, data volume, processing duration, etc. The latency simulation model is developed based on OMNet++ simulation software. We design and implement the just-in-time reliability algorithm to simulate the execution process of edge computing. We finally analyze the latency of edge computing data and derive the connectivity, timeliness, and service reliability of edge computing networks.

articleTitle: A comprehensive life evaluation method for server hard disk
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This paper introduces a comprehensive life evaluation method of server hard disk based on the material life, technical life and economic life evaluation model of hard disk. Firstly, based on the historical failure database, the Weibull distribution model is established to obtain the material life of the hard disk. Secondly, the concept of Gompertz change curve is introduced to establish the residual technical life model of hard disk. Then, considering the operation of each part of the operation of electronic products, the uncertain variables are determined by using D-S evidence theory, and the economic life evaluation model is established with the minimum operation cost as the optimization objective. Finally, considering the coupling relationship between the three, the comprehensive life evaluation model of hard disk is established. An example of electronic products such as server hard disk which are easy to change and easy to fail is analyzed, the comprehensive life of the product is evaluated, and the rationality and practicability of the proposed method are verified.

articleTitle: Modeling on RMS of UAV swarm based on multi agent simulation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In view of the characteristics of the UAV swarm, such as changeable tasks and time-varying functions, this paper first gave the DoDAF description of architecture tasks. Then the Petri net of time factor is introduced to formalize the agent, and the multi-agent simulation framework is constructed based on the task evolution rules of the system. According to the selforganization and self-adaptive characteristics of the swarm, the random walk rules of communication information are proposed to evaluate the RMS of the dynamic system quantitatively. Through the simulation, the model can illustrate the critical impact of the RMS of the UAV swarm on the operational mission to provide technical solutions and theoretical guidance for the system construction and operational application evaluation.

articleTitle: MEMS transient dynamics simulation and electro-mechanical shock test
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: MEMS devices are widely used in the field of acceleration sensors. Because folded beam usually have threedimensional and movable characteristics, the failure under shock may be caused by fracture and adhesion. Therefore, the mechanical analysis of micro-mechanical structure under impact can have a deeper understanding of its failure mechanism. The three-dimensional model of the micro mechanical structure of ADXL203 is established, and the response law of the micro mechanical structure under the impact pulse is simulated by ANSYS transient dynamics. It is found that the weak link of the structure is at the bending of the folding beam. After the test system is built, the electro-mechanical impact test of ADXL203 is carried out. It is found that the mechanical alone can not cause the failure of the device, but in the case of power on, it will lead to the displacement of the micro mechanical structure, resulting in the short circuit of the device, resulting in over electric stress damage.

articleTitle: Yacht structure evaluation based on multi-scale finite element analysis
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: When the FRP Yacht is sailing on the sea, the variety of the marine environment has higher requirements for the impact performance of the FRP Yacht structure, and under the same impact energy, the impact results of different positions of the impact yacht structure are also different. In order to analyze the impact performance of different structures of yacht, this paper conducts multi-scale impact simulation for different positions of FRP Yacht structure, and evaluates the impact performance of FRP Yacht structure with the method of grey correlation evaluation.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of bearing support structure of device for recovering metallic sodium from sodium slag
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In a device for recovering metallic sodium from sodium slag, the bearing support structure that supports and drives the rotation of the distillation furnace is one of the key components that cause the failure of the device, and its failure form is insufficient strength. In this paper, under the condition of certain material parameters, the bearing mechanism's loadbearing capacity is analyzed by finite element analysis, and the design and optimization of the bearing mechanism based on the response surface method are carried out to guide the fit between the parts in the device. Then establishing a reliability model, the design results were evaluated for their reliability based on the Six Sigma module, which improves the overall reliability of the device. The results show that the maximum equivalent force of the bearing support structure is about 15.066 MPa, which is much smaller than the default structural steel material yield strength of 235 MPa. The maximum deformation after optimization is about 0.02 mm higher than before, which has little impact on the device. This method has a little guiding meaning for similar assembly reliability analysis.

articleTitle: Sparse deep adaptive arbitrary polynomial chaos expansion for flight vehicle reliability-based design optimization
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This paper studies the flight vehicle reliability-based design optimization (FV-RBDO) to reduce the influence of some uncertain factors. For the FV-RBDO, the flight vehicle's highest temperature and reliability calculations usually need huge computational effort. Thus, this paper develops a sparse deep adaptive arbitrary polynomial chaos expansion (Deep aPCE) method to construct the missile's highest temperature surrogate model. The developed sparse Deep aPCE method uses a small number of labeled data to solve the expansion coefficients accurately. Based on the developed sparse Deep aPCE method, the FV-RBDO can be performed efficiently. An engineering case is adopted to validate the developed sparse Deep aPCE method and the FV-RBDO. The results show that the developed sparse Deep aPCE method can build a more precise surrogate model than the existing methods. The engineers can refer to the optimization scheme of the FV-RBDO to design a reliable flight vehicle.

articleTitle: An analysis about dynamic reliability influence on NC machine tools
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: System reliability depends on subsystem reliability and system structure. Different subsystems serve different roles, therefore, confirmation of key subsystems is important to overall system success. In this paper, several independent subsystems are numerically controlled machine tools to make up a complete series system. The reliability model of subsystems has already been discussed. The influence of subsystems is calculated when the whole system lifespan is submitted to Weibull distribution. When a subsystem failure appears, other subsystem failure data is processed according to the censored data, upon which parameter assessing and fitting inspection is done to get a reliability model. At that time,, the dynamic reliability influence and critical reliability influence will be calculated and the system's dynamic influence can be analyzed by its subsystems This provides a way to improve system reliability.

articleTitle: Research on integrated decision-making of civil aircraft system based on four characteristics and cost
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the four indicators of civil aircraft system reliability, safety, maintainability, and testability, as well as the characteristic that operation costs are interval values rather than definite values, for the choice of system configuration, a gray relational entropy based on interval numbers is proposed. The integrated decision-making method of method selection, the gray entropy method is used to optimize the weight of each parameter, so as to obtain the order of the correlation degree of each system configuration, and form an integrated decision-making model. On this basis, several civil aircraft landing gear system configurations were evaluated to verify the validity and feasibility of the decision-making model.

articleTitle: Opportunity group maintenance model of port crane bearings based on equipment status
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This paper proposes a joint optimization problem based on the health status of port crane bearings to make group maintenance decisions. First, perform time and frequency domain analysis and feature fusion for the bearing vibration signal to obtain the health index (HI), and then use Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) to pre-train the degradation model for the HI and transfer to port crane bearings with less data. then the health index is normalized and smoothed, and the threeparameter Weibull distribution is used for function fitting to obtain the health index function. On the basis of the health index function, the cost model, the availability model, and the group maintenance model considering time window strategy and replacement threshold control strategy are constructed. Finally, based on real data from a port of Shanghai Zhenhua Port Machinery Company Limited (ZPMC), genetic algorithm is used to analyze the optimal maintenance plan solution set, and the maintenance plan suggestions for crane bearings under specific preference coefficients.

articleTitle: Deep learning-based satellite heat reliability analysis
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The surrogate model for temperature field prediction is an essential part of the satellite heat reliability analysis. Many data-driven methods have been proposed to construct the surrogate model of the temperature field prediction problem. Nonetheless, some areas of the temperature field still have high prediction errors. To overcome this difficulty, this paper presents a novel data-driven method using the combination of two types of loss functions. First, we establish the mathematical model for the temperature field prediction of the heat source layout (HSL-TFP) problem. Then, we introduce the U-net model framework used in this work. In terms of the loss function, a new loss function combining the traditional MAE loss and max temperature error is proposed to solve the above problem. Experiments show that the proposed loss function can reduce the max temperature error and lower the MAE loss simultaneously, significantly improving the accuracy of reliability analysis. Finally, the U-net model is used to analyze the reliability of satellites, including the failure probability calculation of satellite series-parallel component subsystems. A case is taken as an example to validate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Complex crack detection of postearthquake building using a optimzied YOLOv4 model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: At present, the manual survey based traditional building damage detection highly depends on the prior experience and subjective judgment of the professional inspector. To realize the intelligent detection of building crack, this study proposes a crack detection method using a modified YOLOv4 based on the improvement of focal loss and adding attention modules. Taking consideration of both uneven positive crack and negative noncrack samples as well as different training coefficients in the loss function, the YOLOv4 model was deeply trained. To solve the inapplicability of traditional evaluation metrics for complex regional cracks, a refined evaluation metric is proposed. The proposed method achieved efficient and accurate detection of complex building cracks as large as 69.18%.

articleTitle: Multi-fault situation assessment and diagnosis method of wind turbine blades based on fault tree and Bayesian network
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: A multi-fault diagnosis model of wind turbine blades based on a fault tree and Bayesian network was proposed to promptly obviate the frequent faults of wind turbine blades, prevent malignant accidents, and improve the reliability and safety of eolian power generation systems. Firstly, a fault tree model of wind turbine blades was established based on historical fault statistical data. The structural importance of basic events of the fault tree was subsequently acquired through qualitative analysis. According to the relationship between logic gates and basic events expressed in the fault tree structure model, a Bayesian network model was generated by a conversion algorithm, and a Bayesian network fault diagnosis model based on expert knowledge was further established. Finally, the prior probability of root nodes of the system failure was calculated through fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, and the posterior probability of each fault node was estimated according to the Bayes formula. The proposed method can diagnose and predict multi-fault modes of wind turbine blades and improve the troubleshooting efficiency of wind turbine blades. Moreover, the accuracy and feasibility of the proposed model have been verified by the case study, which indicates that the proposed method is of significant application value in engineering practice.

articleTitle: Stress analysis of centrifugal compressor impeller under multi-field loads
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The impeller of an aero-engine centrifugal compressor is subjected to multiple loads, including aerodynamic loads, thermal loads, and centrifugal loads, which affect the stress of the impeller. To accurately evaluate the influence of each load, the fluid-structure coupling method is used to establish the calculation model of the centrifugal compressor impeller. By carrying out the calculation, the Aerodynamic load and thermal load under design conditions can be obtained. Afterward, the stress analysis of the centrifugal compressor impeller is carried out by applying the various loads calculated before. Comparing the effects of these three loads on the stress state of the impeller, the result shows that the centrifugal load plays a dominant role in the stress state of that, followed by the thermal load and then the aerodynamic load.

articleTitle: Reliability modeling for the FBG sensor considering multi-performance parameters degeneration based on Copula function
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Abstract–Under the long-term alternating load, the multiple performance parameters of the FBG sensor, such as sensitivity, repeatability, consistency, linearity, etc. degrade simultaneously, and the degradation quantities are correlated. The current researches mainly focus on studying the reliability modeling methods for the FBG sensor from the perspective of single performance parameter degradation, and it may be unreasonable and one-sided. Thus, this paper proposes a reliability modeling method for the FBG sensor by considering multi-performance parameters degradation. Based on performance degradation failure theory, a reliability calculation model considering multiperformance parameters degradation for FBG sensor is set up, where Wiener process is adopted to fit the degradation data of single performance parameter and Copula functions are then utilized to model the dependent degradation failure. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method was verified by the reliability modeling and analysis for the FBG sensor by considering the degradation of the strain transfer efficiency and the sensitivity, and the results show that the reliability based on single parameter degradation model is much higher than the one which take into account binary correlation, thus the consideration of the degradation correlation can be proved very necessary.

articleTitle: The successful branching algorithm comparison in probabilistic safety assessment
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In this paper, the technical requirements of quantitative analysis in the PSA standards sought to carry out corresponding research. Different models are used to analyze and compare the commonly used successful branching algorithms, and the compliance of each algorithm with the PSA standards is listed. Algorithm analysis and testing show that the ability to propagate success branch logic is the key to ensuring reasonable results. On the other hand, before carrying out quantitative analysis, we should identify whether there are high probability events (>0.1), non-monotonic system, mutual exclusion logic structure, etc, in the model. Then select the appropriate algorithm, and the analysis results of cutest, importance measure and uncertainty can be reasonable expounded. This paper conducts further research on the technical requirements related to quantitative analysis in the PSA standard, and gives the compliance status of the commonly used successful branch algorithms with the PSA standard. After research, the algorithms that are not recommended include the Ignore Event Tree Success algorithm and the “success probability” processing method. The former is provided in some PSA software, but because it does not consider the logic of successful branching, it will produce erroneous cut sets, which is also a practice that the PSA standard clearly does not support. Even if the numerical results are very different from other algorithms in some cases, they should not be used. Although the latter is considered to be usable in the current PSA standard, manual processing will bring a great workload, and it is not feasible in actual engineering.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of coal loading system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The coal loading system is the core subsystem of the coal transportation and marketing system, and is a piece of very critical equipment for coal loading and transportation. Its reliable operation is crucial for coal transportation and marketing enterprises. This paper takes the coal loading system as the research object, uses the FMECA method to analyze it, and analyzes its hazard evaluation indicators through the two comprehensive evaluation methods of TOPSIS and VIKOR. Through comparison and sorting, the priority level is found as the basis for improving the reliability of the system, thereby realizing the improvement of the quality of coal delivery.

articleTitle: Spindle optimization and reliability analysis of ring hammer crusher
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In this paper, ANSYS Workbench is used to carry out static analysis on the main shaft of ring hammer crusher, and the equivalent stress nephogram and displacement nephogram of the main shaft are obtained, and the strength and stiffness of it are checked. Taking total mass of the main shaft as the objective function, with the maximum strain and equivalent stress, the central composite experimental design method and MOGA algorithm are used to optimize the size structure of the main shaft, so that the optimized size can not only meet the strength requirements, but also reduce the material. Finally, according to the optimization analysis results, the reliability of the optimized spindle is analyzed by six sigma analysis. The results show that the quality of the optimized spindle is reduced by 18.0% under the condition of satisfying the strength and stiffness, and the reliability of it also meets the requirements.

articleTitle: A GABP based method to improved software defect prediction
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Considering the uneven distribution of software defect datasets, the performance of traditional SDP (software defect prediction) model is relatively low, which cannot predict the defects well and fix them in time, resulting in the low reliability of the system. This paper proposed an improved SDP method based on GABP, which helps to allocate test resources reasonably, ensures the quality of software and improves the reliability of the system. Firstly, combining with the traditional BP neural network, SMOTE and TOMEK are applied to select the better data preprocessing method and obtain the initial network architecture; Secondly, GA is employed to optimize the network architecture obtained previously to build the final predictor. Experiments on five real datasets demonstrate that the proposed method can improve the prediction performance and show its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Optimal design of chain equilibrator based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In order to satisfy the overall structure requirements of a self-propelled gun, the mechanism of a chain equilibrator is utilized. According to the working principles and action procedures of the chain equilibrator, the drawing method and the analytical method are used respectively in the design process. In the existing design schemes, the stepwise quadratic programming methods are widely used to solve the unbalanced moment optimization models. However, this type of conventional methods relies heavily on the initial value and gradient, and exhibit the poor ability of global optimization. In this paper, we propose a multi-population genetic algorithm to obtain the optimal solution of unbalanced moment model for improving the design of chain equilibrator. Finally, the results of numerical examples show the superiority of the proposed method in the global search ability than that of stepwise quadratic programming, which is suitable for the design of chain equilibrator. The comparative experiments and analysis show that the drawing method has low design efficiency and is difficult for optimization, whereas the analytical method exhibits the highest design efficiency.

articleTitle: The effects of environmental factors on the stability of smart electricity meters
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Smart electrical meter stability was impacted by surrounding conditions, the degradation behaviors of smart electricity meters with calendar time were investigated using the field operation data. The influences of electrical parameters including power coefficient and basic current, were analyzed in terms of power error under various electrical conditions, and the effects of environmental factors, such as temperature, humidity, and beam on stability of smart electrical meters were investigated furtherly. The power error of smart electricity meters exhibited periodic sinusoidal fluctuation with seasons and days, but is inversely proportional to the temperature. The results may provide guidance to improve the reliability and stability of smart electrical meters.

articleTitle: A chance constraint programming model on orderly maintenance for long-term storage equipment
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Equipment for long-term storage is affected by multiple uncertainties such as environmental factors during storage and will face performance degradation and other problems, so the maintenance of equipment for long-term storage has an extremely important role in maintaining the overall equipment system operational capability. In this paper, considering the uncertainty of the performance degradation process of equipment, the uncertainty of the degradation process is modeled and analyzed by using the Wiener process. With maximizing the starting maintenance time as the optimization objective, an ordered maintenance optimization model under the chance constraint is established and an algorithm is put forward to solve it. Finally, a case study is used to verify the validity of the model.

articleTitle: An imporved algorithm to enumerate all minimal cuts in a network
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Minimal cuts (MCs) play an important role in the network reliability analysis. In this paper, an improved algorithm is proposed for finding all MCs in two-terminal networks that consist of a source node and a sink node. First, a linked path structure indexed by node is introduced and incorporated into the existing algorithm, which accepts both undirected and directed form of networks. Second, the single linked structure is defined and incorporated, which makes up the defect of losing some MCs using existing algorithm for networks consisting single linked nodes or clusters. Finally, with the newly introduced linked path by node and the single linked structure, an improved algorithm for searching all MCs is proposed. Numerical examples shows that the proposed algorithm can save computational effort and generate complete MCs for networks with single linked structures.

articleTitle: Data analysis of power module reliability accelerated test
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: As high-reliability power module have been widely used in spacecraft, how to determine the reliability of power module quickly and accurately is a problem needed to be solved in development stage of manned aerospace engineering and deep space exploration program. According to the research status, the accelerated test is a common and efficient means to verify the reliability of high-reliability power module, and during the verification process, how to deal with the test data of accelerated test is essential to determine the test scheme and reliability level of power module, therefore, the accelerated test data analysis methods for power module according to the test sample states under different accelerated test conditions are given in this paper, the methods includes the analysis means of failure data, the analysis means of degradation data, the analysis means of no failure and degradation data.

articleTitle: Development of an aircraft collision risk assessment model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aircraft collision is a core risk in civil aviation. The research progress of aircraft collision prevention from academy and civil aviation industrial field is analyzed. Although a lot of researches have been carried out, there are still some open problems. In this paper, aircraft collision events occurred from 2016 to 2021 are analyzed. A risk-based aircraft collision checklist is developed based on the analysis of aircraft collision events and the SHELL model. An aircraft collision risk assessment model is proposed based on the checking results and the comprehensive weights of checking items in the aircraft collision checklist. A case of an airline is used to validate the effectiveness the proposed aircraft collision risk assessment model. The result is consistent with the actual situation.

articleTitle: A probabilistic constant amplitude lifetime diagram modeling method considering spatial mapping relation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Conventional constant amplitude life diagrams model cannot reasonably describe mean stress effect and stochastic uncertainty present in the fatigue failure process of composite materials. To address this problem, taking the spatial mapping relationship between probabilistic S-N curves and probabilistic constant amplitude life diagram model as an entry point, a probabilistic constant amplitude life diagram modelling method is proposed under the assumption of linear equations and the assumption of equiprobable quantile point between static strength distributions and fatigue life distributions. The validity of the method is verified by fatigue test data of glass fiber/polyester resin composites. The results indicate that the proposed method can offer an accurate description of the probabilistic behavior of composite materials.

articleTitle: Human factors risk assessment for high-danger production processes based on SPA
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: There are more and more accidents during the highdanger production processes in recent years. These accidents often result in human casualties, economic losses, environment pollution, and negative social impact. Unsafe behavior is one of the direct causes. Therefore, it is necessary to develop the risk assessment of human factors for high-danger production processes. The set pair analysis (SPA) is introduced in this paper. SPA has been widely considered as a systematic and comprehensive assessment method. To illustrate its validity, a chemical plant is chosen as the case study. The results show that SPA is reasonable to provide risk states and trends of human factors.

articleTitle: An enhanced filter method for rolling bearing fault diagnosis with variable speed condition
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Vibration signal processing approaches play a key role in rotating machinery fault diagnosis under variable speed condition. Noting that most sampled signals are often overwhelmed in the heavy noise and variable operation conditions as the fault characteristics cannot detect accurately. This paper develops a preprocessing for non-local means approach to enhance fault components in vibration signal under variable speed condition. First, the instantaneous rotation frequency curve of vibration signal is obtained by time-frequency analysis. With the help of the estimated curve, vibration signal is converted into angular domain by re-sample technique. Second, preprocessing technique is applied to expose the fault components and then filtering by non-local means approach. The preprocessing technique is designed by first-order difference square envelope of angular domain signal. Third, non-local means filter is used to filter the preprocessed signal based on the determined optimal search distance and then minus the filtered signal to acquire the residual components. Finally, envelope order spectrum analysis is employed for the residual signal to detect fault characteristic order. Experimental investigation from faulty bearing demonstrates its good performance in highlighting fault components.

articleTitle: Background color attributes contribute to the perception bias of yellow and amber
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The manipulation of color in display symbology design has long been recognized as a method to improve operator performance. Amber and yellow, as warning codes with different priorities on aviation, are sometimes implicitly distorted when they are overlaid on background colors, known as simultaneous color contrast. To investigate the shifting of color constancy, we performed an empirical experiment by judging whether two target colors (yellow and amber) were consistent under the influence of proximal colors (arranged in the HSB color space). The accuracy and reaction time were recorded in each trial. The Chi-square test indicated that higher saturation and brightness of the proximal color could lead to an identification error. Notably, when the hue value of background colors occurred to 350, amber had the highest potential to be mistaken for yellow. Similarly, yellow may be mistaken for amber when the hue value of its background color was 140. In conclusion, magenta and green color series may not be recommended as background colors of yellow and amber on aviation.

articleTitle: An optimal condition based maintenance model for accelerated degrading products
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Condition-based maintenance (CBM) is an effective method to guarantee product availability and minimze the cost in the operation period. Degradation modeling is important in CBM decision-making. For some products such as mechanical systems, the degradation process is accelerated. The main purpose of this paper is to investigate optimizing the CBM strategy for accelerated degrading products. The maintenance process of accelerated degradation process is illustrated and an accelerated degradation model based on the Inverse-Gaussian process is built. On the constraint of availability, the optimal CBM strategy is obtained by minimizing cost. Finally, a numerical example is introduced to illustrate the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research on opportunistic maintenance strategy of EMU components considering risk cost
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of single and expensive maintenance methods for EMU and insufficient risk-related considerations, a research on the opportunity maintenance strategy of it considering risk costs is proposed. Firstly, based on the existing maintenance system of EMU in China, the preventive maintenance strategy model of EMU components is constructed by introducing the service age regression factor and the failure rate increment factor; secondly, the risk factor is introduced, and the preventive maintenance reliability and the opportunity maintenance reliability threshold of each component are determined according to the opportunity maintenance theory and the reliability requirements of components. The thresholds are adopted for the key components within the opportunity maintenance interval. On the basis of this, a EMU multicomponent opportunity maintenance model and its decisionmaking process are constructed, taking into account the risk cost. Finally, the model is validated by simulating a specific EMU component maintenance case, and solved by genetic algorithm to determine the optimal opportunity maintenance strategy. The simulation results show that the strategy can coordinate the maintenance time of each component, achieve simultaneous maintenance of multiple components, improve maintenance efficiency and reduce maintenance costs, thus verifying the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Remaining useful life prediction of rail transit bearings based on statistical life and degradation characteristics
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: For rail transit bearings, the health state performs twophase behaviour, i.e., the steady operation phase and the rapid degradation phase. In this situation, both the statistical life and the degradation characteristics are useful for predicting the remaining useful life (RUL). However, traditional studies only focus on the rapid degradation phase or ignore the correlation between two different phases, which significantly decrease the accuracy of degradation modeling and RUL prediction. To solve this issue, a two-stage RUL prediction model is developed in this paper. A joint implement of generalized resonance theory based fault diagnosis, feature extraction, degradation modeling and RUL prediction is proposed for bearing health state analysis. The maximum likelihood estimation and monte carlo simulation are combined to update the model parameters, based on which the degradation path and the RUL are predicted accordingly. A real-world case is carried out for illustrating the effectiveness of our methods.

articleTitle: Research on invulnerability of UAV swarm based on cascading failure propagation mode
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm is a self-organizing swarm composed of multiple UAVs, and achieves mission objectives in an adaptive way. At present, the model of UAV swarm is based on complex network. Each UAV is represented as a node, and each link represents the information exchange between UAVs. However, the existing researches do not consider the cascading failure phenomenon of information exchange between swarms, that is, the failure of one or more nodes in the network will propagate to other nodes through the connection between nodes. In this paper, combined with the characteristics of UAV swarm and communication network, a multistate cascading failure model based on information load distribution and a dynamic network reconnection model based on probability are proposed by introducing the information transferring capacity of nodes. The concepts of network structure entropy (NSE) and relative scale of the swarm are introduced as evaluation indexes. Through modeling, simulation and experimental analysis, the propagation rules of cascading failure in swarm and its impact on network invulnerability are studied.

articleTitle: Research and development of mosaic warfare
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: At present, the anti intervention / regional denial capabilities of the world powers are increasing, and the traditional combat forces of the US military are declining. Therefore, the US military has put forward a new combat concept-Mosaic war. In this paper, the concept of mosaic warfare is interpreted from the perspectives of connotation boundary, force organization, architecture composition, force generation and combat network, and a combat loop structure is proposed based on OODA loop. In order to solve the problems of the low project priority, achievement conversion rate to be verified and existing system establishment difficult to break, DARPA has started a series of projects and technical research, its key technologies mainly include UAV cluster technology, electronic countermeasure technology, distributed man-machine cooperation technology, flexible and autonomous communication network technology, simulation experiment analysis and combat effectiveness evaluation technology, and its relevant projects mainly include ofFSET, ACK, DBM, CASCADE, C2E, DyNAMO, SoSITE, and so on. Finally, it effectively promotes mosaic warfare to flexibly reorganize all kinds of combat function units, and forms highly cooperative, autonomous and controllable combat kill network, in order to deal with the threats in great power competition.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of networked control systems considering data link performance correlation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Digital networked control systems are of growing importance in safety-critical systems and perform indispensable function in most complex systems today. Networked degradation such as transmission delay cause such systems to fail to satisfy performance requirements, and eventually affect the overall reliability.Therefore, it is very important to obtain a reliability evaluation model of the entire network system based on the performance of transmission links.However,the existing networked control system performance reliability evaluation models often regard the transmission links as independent, ignoring the relevance of data transmission between links.From the perspective of link correlation, this paper proposes a new method of fusing data-driven and compound Archimedes Copula function modeling to analyze the reliability of networked control system performance. Finally, a networked control system example is provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the model and method.

articleTitle: Vehicle interior road noise predicted using support vector regression
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In this paper, the prediction method of low-frequency vehicle road noise is studied, and the mapping relationship between vehicle road noise and vehicle structural dynamic parameters is discussed. Firstly, through the study of the road noise generation mechanism and NVH (Noise, Vibration and Harshness) target decomposition method, the main influencing factors of vehicle interior road noise and their interaction relationship determined. On this basis, the road noise hierarchical decomposition framework is constructed. Then, combining with 27 data samples which were collected via the road test and design of experiment (DOE), the road noise prediction model is developed through the support vector regression (SVR). In addition, the quantitative mapping relationship between the steering knuckle excitation, chassis component parameters, suspension structure vibration response and vehicle road noise are established as well. Finally, the developed prediction model is verified by 11 samples from the testing set. The test results show that the road noise prediction model based on the SVR algorithm has good prediction accuracy and reliability performance.

articleTitle: A research on state estimation based on causal inference
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Fault diagnosis is to judge whether the system or equipment is faulty, and it is often necessary to consider the current specific status. In this paper, several inference modes based on causal network are analyzed in detail. Both discrete and continuous variables inference are considered for status estimation. Based on actual monitoring data of the nuclear main pump bearing system in a Pressurized-Water Reactor (PWR) nuclear power plant, a causal graph (i.e. Directed Acyclic Graph, DAG) is constructed. And, by using the proposed inference method, the operating state of a concrete bearing is inferred to diagnose the fault. Fault diagnosis and prediction based on causal network is feasible, and the inference process and results are flexible and interpretable, which has great application value and guiding significance.

articleTitle: A maximum relative entropy approach to probability updating using interval information
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Probability updating method has lately received great interest in engineering practice, and the maximum relative entropy (MrE) principle provides the possibility of multiple information utilization in probability updating particularly. A probability updating model processing the interval information is proposed, which is a further extension of the MrE model. The interval information updating effect is placed emphasis investigation, and the sequence effect with multi-type information is discussed in the probability updating process. Theoretical and numerical cases are applied for the demonstration of sequence effect with multi-information constraints. Following this, an electronic component reliability assessment and an actual fatigue problem are utilized for method validation.

articleTitle: Distilled probability regression model for heat reliability analysis
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Facing the complex thermal environment in space, the heat reliability analysis of the satellite is important for the operation. To tackle the resource consumption and overconfidence of traditional methods for heat reliability analysis, a deep learningbased surrogate model is developed in this paper. By distilling from an ensemble, the model maps from a heat layout to a temperature field as an image-to-image probabilistic regression task with uncertainty. With the output obtained by the distilled model, heat reliability based on the failure rate of the circuit board in a satellite is analyzed. The results evaluate the performance of the model for prediction and heat reliability analysis.

articleTitle: Study on quantitative risk assessment of girth weld failure of natural gas pipeline based on reliability
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In order to avoid safety accidents caused by the failure of welding girth weld of long-distance gas pipeline, carry out quality investigation of girth weld of in-service pipeline, and perform quantitative risk assessment based on reliability for girth weld with difficulty in excavation, to effectively improve the effectiveness and economy of excavation point selection.
