In this study, using the probability-based weld structure failure prediction method through girth weld X-ray inspection results during the construction period, calculate the probability of fire and explosion due to leakage/rupture of girth welds in the natural gas pipeline and the impact range based on the basic risk evaluation information such as external environment and personnel distribution in the area of the pipe section where the welds are located. Identify excavation plan based on the evaluation results, and propose effective risk mitigation measures for nonexcavation sites. In the end, practical application cases are listed.

articleTitle: A network-based modelling approach for dynamic reliability analysis under time-varying conditions
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Due to the character of time-varying of reliability for marine diesel engines, the precise reliability assessment for them is still a challenging work in actual applications. Focused on the problems of the weak abilities of the conventional modelling approaches in reflecting the dynamic reliability and describing the fault propagation mechanism of the marine diesel engines, a network-based approach for dynamic reliability modelling of marine diesel engines was proposed to analyze and obtain the reliability under time-varying conditions. The longitudinal propagation and lateral diffusion of reliability fluctuation were considered in modelling, and the propagation mechanism was composed with 5 level, such as reliability factors, failure causes, fault modes, functional components and reliability output. Moreover, the reliability factors were monitored and inspected as the input of the model, and the dynamic reliability of the marine diesel engines were obtained based on the input data. An actual marine diesel engine with 7 subsystems, 17 fault modes and 28 failure causes were investigated to verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A novel methodology for reliability assessment of corroded natural gas pipelines considering two-level correlation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: One of the main causes for the failure of natural gas pipeline is corrosion, which can induce severe consequences due to the inherent combustibility of natural gas. Therefore, it is of great significance to evaluate precisely the reliability of corroded natural gas pipelines. With regard to the confusion and apparent insufficient consideration of correlations surrounding current reliability assessment methods for corroded natural gas pipelines, this paper divides these correlations into two levels: “random variables correlation” (Level 1) and “spatial correlation” (Level 2), and then proposes a novel methodology for pipeline reliability assessment by examining the effects of a separate “two-level” correlation. Depending on the data provide by in-line inspection, the new methodology can calculate the probabilities of small leak and burst failure of a corroded pipeline with multiple interacting defects more accurately and more realistically. This paper uses Gaussian Copula approach to characterize the dependence among the random variables. The spatial correlation among defects is characterized by using an efficient probabilistic method. Finally, the influence of different kinds of correlation on reliability is studied by sensitivity analysis. The calculation results have indicated that the two-level correlation has great impact on the failure probability. The method in consideration of the two-level correlation is more objective and truly reflects the dynamic reliability changes of the corroded nature gas pipeline.

articleTitle: Health assessment of aerospace vehicle power distribution system based on virtual simulator
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: With the significantly increasing growth of assessment requirements of new aerospace vehicle equipment, some problems expose when the vehicle is under designed and analyzed, such as lack of aging diagnosis of the key components, unclarity of the degeneration process, and difficulty in reliability and health assessment of vehicle. These problems lead to lack of a scientific and reliable technology to support vehicle evaluation, and decreasing the vehicle reliability. The research is carried out in this paper based on the characteristics of aerospace vehicle storage and operation, such as lack of data, and difficulty in predicting fault of key subsystems and components. Firstly, the failure modes and effects are presented by analyzing the weakness and failure rule of part of the vehicle power distribution system. At the same time, evaluation indices to reflect the characteristics of vehicle useful life and the digital simulation are put forward. The digital models of vehicle distributor are established, and based on the simulation results, the degradation process is summarized. Furthermore, the fault modes are injected to the digital model and based on the simulation data, machine learning algorithms are built to assess the reliability and predict the health of system. This project indeed is practical to space vehicles with limitations aforementioned, and provides data and technical support for exploring the aging mechanism of vehicle and assessing its reliability and health.

articleTitle: Experimental study on failure of the scratched engine intake pipe under high temperature air burning
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Air intake pipe is located in high temperature region of aeroengine, the leak caused by high temperature gas burning is a possible failure mode. In this paper, the tolerances of working pressures and high-temperature air burning of the intake pipe were experimental investigated. A pipe flame burning test bench with double zone heating and air pressurization was designed, which simulated the working temperature (382°C), air pressure (static and transient) and high temperature burning (500°C, 800°C and 1000°C for 3 minutes respectively) simultaneously. In these circumstances, the tolerance performances of the pipe with or without scratches was compared. There were bulge and multiple microcracks at the burning failure of all pipes. The results showed that the burning failure temperature and time of the scratched pipe were less than those of the intact pipe. The burning failure temperature of the scratched pipe was lower than 1000°C (about 940 ∼ 980°C), and corresponding failure time is less than 3 minutes. The failure mechanism under burning was obtained by the micro morphology of fracture. It provides a reference for fault evaluation and reliability analysis of engine intake pipeline.

articleTitle: Research status and development of mechanical reliability testing and design methods
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of economy and society and the continuous improvement of scientific and technological, the research on mechanical reliability has become one of the key concerns of people around the world. However, due to many reasons, the research on mechanical reliability in China is still relatively backward. In this paper, the concept of mechanical reliability and its domestic and international development status are introduced. The research status, classification, characteristics and application prospect of mechanical reliability test are analyzed. Various mechanical reliability design methods are discussed and compared, and its future development direction is prospected.

articleTitle: An efficient reliability evaluation method involving correlated random variables under distribution parameter uncertainty
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: To fully describe the safety of the structure involving correlated random variables under the distribution parameter uncertainty, it is necessary to obtain not only the mean value of the conditional failure probability, but also to grasp its complete probability characteristics. Due to the large variability of the conditional failure probability, it is difficult to directly use an explicit function to fit its probability distribution. Therefore, the focus of this paper is to first approximate the distribution of the conditional reliability index involving correlated random variables, and then obtain the quantile of the conditional failure probability in form of an explicit formula. For this purpose, the limit state function involving the correlated random variables should be first transformed into the standard normal space based on the three-parameter lognormal transformation, and then the first-three central moments of the conditional reliability index can be calculated by combining the bivariate dimensionreduction integration method combined with the point-estimate method, so that the distribution of the conditional reliability index can be obtained. Finally, an explicit expression of the quantile values of the conditional failure probability can be derived from the distribution of the corresponding conditional reliability index. Two illustrative examples show that the results obtained from the proposed method are almost similar to those of the Monte Carlo simulations, and the proposed method has a wide range of applications.

articleTitle: Analysis of the application prospects of reliability-centered maintenance in the operation and maintenance management of air traffic control equipment
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Firstly, the development history of Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) method in aviation and other equipment fields is introduced, showing that RCM method is becoming more and more standardized and mature, and has become a mandatory course in the field of equipment maintenance management. Then combined with the current situation of RCM operation and maintenance management research of Air Traffic Control (ATC)equipment, it analyzes the key technologies that need to be solved when RCM method is applied to the field of ATC equipment, and finally pointed out the application prospect and important significance of RCM method in the operation and maintenance management of ATC equipment.

articleTitle: A preliminary probabilistic safety assessment for ITER
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor (ITER), the world' largest fusion facility, has officially began assembly work at July 28, 2020 and plan to operation at December 2025. If ITER can operate successfully, which means the people step forward on the road to peaceful use of fusion energy. Meanwhile, how safe about ITER and whether the ITER will cause radiation harm to the surrounding environment and personnel is our concern. A lot of safety assessment work had been done for ITER using a deterministic approach through conservative assumptions and calculations. But it's not enough. This paper aims to estimate the radiological risk of ITER. The first, the probabilistic safety assessment (PSA) progress for ITER was proposed in this paper and then, the preliminary PSA was applied on ITER and the results shows that ITER has a high frequency of accidents in the range of small dose. But the large-scale radiological consequences are unlikely. The reasons for those results are also analyzed in this paper. Those result could provide some valuable reference for risk assessment and safety supervision of fusion commercial reactor in the near future.

articleTitle: Modeling subsea choke valve erosion with a production-driven shock-associated degradation process
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Sand erosion in subsea components can cause serious design and production problems. Choke valves are installed at the wellheads to control the reservoir outflow and protect equipment from unusual pressure fluctuations. They suffer from erosion due to continuous exposure to the abrasive mixture of oil, gas, water, and sand. Severe degradation may cause production slowdown, leading to significant financial losses. Therefore, the capability to predict erosion rates in choke valves given a pre-determined production plan is essential for determining the choke's service life and guaranteeing system integrity. We introduce a productiondriven, shock-associated degradation model to describe the choke valve erosion. The continuous wear is modeled by a Transformed Gamma process, accounting for time- and state-dependent degradation increments. External shocks, i.e., damage caused by sand bursts, are modeled by a compound Poisson process. Both wear and shock process are governed by the production rate that defines the flow velocity inside the pipelines. We derive explicit formulas for the degradation's distribution and introduce an inference procedure based on maximum likelihood estimation. Monte Carlo simulation can be used to estimate the deterioration trend and remaining useful life.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis and fatigue characteristics of ring die
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The ring die granulator is a piece of important equipment in the feed industry. In order to optimize the performance of its key component ring die, the force and action area of the die hole and the inner surface of the ring die are analyzed and solved during the operation of the ring die. Three different die hole layouts and three different widths of ring die are established, and the finite element simulation is carried out. The influence of the above two factors on the strength of the ring die is studied by analyzing the stress and the displacement data. Based on theMonte Carlo method, the probability density function of the random load was derived to obtain the cyclic variation model of ring mode load, and the multi-axis fatigue simulation analysis of ring mode was carried out according to the obtained model. The result shows that the fatigue failure area of the ring die was most likely to occur near the die hole of the restraint end during the pelleting process. Improvement measures were put forward for the ring die structure, and the ring dies life is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Motion reliability analysis of crank-slider mechanism with multi-tolerances
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: An error analysis method with mixed clearance and multi-dimensional tolerances for the offset crank-slider mechanism was proposed in this research. Taking reliability and motion defect-free as performance probability constraints, an optimized design model of mechanism motion accuracy reliability with multi-tolerances was established, which aimed to minimize the maximum failure probability of trajectory point motion accuracy. Taking the rod length and dimensional tolerances into account, the global motion region of the slider in 12 schemes was optimized. Based on the optimization, the optimal design variables such as rod length and tolerances were obtained. The influence of mixed clearances on the reliability of the kinematic accuracy of the mechanism was analyzed quantitatively. The results show that the motion error of the forward interval of the slider is larger than that of the return interval, while the stationarity is lower. while the prismatic clearances increased from 0.01 to 0.02 and 0.03mm, the failure probability increased by 22.87% and 48.27%, respectively. With additional revolute clearances set to 0.0072mm, the corresponding additional increment of failure probability was 5.31% and 5.19%, respectively. Furthermore, enlarging the revolute clearances to 0.0193mm, the failure probability increased by 7.22% and 13.24% additionally. Based on both manufacturing cost and reliability, the design schemes were evaluated comprehensively, and reasonable suggestions for the selection of the optimal design scheme were given.

articleTitle: Research on the rapid evaluation method of mission success probability based on proxy model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Mission Success Probability (MSP) is a critical assessment index for the mission-oriented maintenance and assurance capability of complex equipment. The traditional MSP calculation is based on numerical simulation, which is computationally intensive and inefficient, and assumes a fixed probability distribution for the failure parameters of each module. In actual engineering, the system component may experience life consumption or failure, its failure distribution parameters will change, and the replacement cycle varies. At the same time, the designer needs to adjust the component design parameters at any time during the equipment design to optimize the success rate of the mission. Consequently, it is a meaningful research topic to achieve rapid assessment of MSP in variable scenarios to support utilization and maintenance decisions. In this paper, an end-to-end neural network proxy model oriented to rapid assessment of mission success probability is proposed for series-parallel systems, the design and training methods of the model are described. By comparing it with the traditional simulation-based approach. The results show that the proposed proxy model can significantly improve the computational efficiency while having high accuracy, and can support the rapid evaluation of mission success probability under variable scenarios.

articleTitle: Fault tolerant property of interdependent networks
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Recent years have witnessed a surge of extensive study upon the robustness of a system consisting of interdependent networks. Both the mechanism of cascading failures and the corresponding recovery strategies, which means to heal malfunction of a system before it runs completely into collapse, are two key issues in the field of robustness analysis of interdependent networks. An essential question that has always been ignored is how to design a fault tolerance scheme to buffer against cascading failures. In order to deeply understand the relationship between the fault-tolerance assignment and the robustness of interdependent networks, we propose a cascading failure model with the consideration of the fault tolerance property of the nodes in interdependent networks, where the node are specified different fault tolerant capacity according to their degree values. By theoretical and numerical studies, it is found that the robustness of a system can be improved significantly if the high-degree nodes are assigned high fault tolerant capacity. However, robustness of a system can be hampered if the high degree nodes are assigned low fault tolerant capacity. Our results prove that the fault tolerance assignment scheme of the nodes has great impacts on the robustness of interdependent networks and provide important thoughts to reinforce reliability of the interdependent systems by the proper allocation of fault tolerant capacity.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis based on active learning Kriging model for problems involving multimodally distributed random variables
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: A novel strategy, integrating the λ Mixture Model (λMM) and the Active Learning Kriging model (ALK), is proposed to cope with the problems involving multimodally distributed random variables. First, the λMMs are applied to represent the multimodal probability distributions of random variables, because of their excellent multimodal property. Next, the Rejection Sampling (RS) is adopted to draw the candidate points for the proposed AK-RS, which avoids calculating the inverse Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF) of complex λMM and ensures the independence between samples. Following, an advanced Errorbased Stopping Criterion (ESC) is introduced, to further improve the efficiency of the proposed approach. The study of three cases shows that, the AK-RS can superbly fit the Probability Density Functions (PDFs) of observations, while this method can dramatically enhance the computational efficiency and ensure the achievement of the target accuracy.

articleTitle: Fatigue life prediction and reliability evaluation method for shear impact coupling failure of locking screw
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The locking screw in the drive mechanism bears the radial alternating impact load during the reciprocating motion of the control rod, which is prone to shear impact coupling fatigue failure. The existing fatigue reliability analysis methods can only deal with the single failure mode of shear fatigue or impact fatigue, In order to improve the reliability of reactor operation, a fatigue life prediction model and reliability evaluation method considering shear impact coupling failure mode are proposed. Firstly, the single transient impact simulation analysis of the screw is carried out, and the rain flow counting method is used to decompose the simulation output. Then, the shear fatigue life prediction model is used to calculate the life of the screw. Finally, considering the uncertainty of working condition, material and model parameters, Monte Carlo sampling method is used to calculate the reliability of the screw. The results show that the reliability of the locking screw will decrease rapidly after 2.82 million times of armature impact, and the locking screw is prone to fracture failure. This evaluation method can be used for fatigue life prediction and reliability evaluation of all kinds of screws under shear impact load, and can also help to determine the safety inspection cycle and inspection focus of reactor structure.

articleTitle: Optimization design of hypersonic vehicle propulsion system based on ISIGHT and MATLAB
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Since the beginning of the 21st century, the anti-missile weapons of various countries in the world have continued to develop, and it is difficult for ordinary ballistic missiles to break through the end defenses of the anti-missile system. Therefore, hypersonic vehicles and missiles are born to deal with the application of powerful anti-missile systems. It is generally considered that an aircraft greater than five times the speed of sound is called a hypersonic aircraft. It is exactly because of its extremely high flight speed that high requirements are placed on the performance of the propulsion system of the aircraft. This paper takes the American X-43A hypersonic aircraft as the basic configuration and combines MATLAB to compile the optimization program to realize the multi-objective optimization and reliability design of the aircraft propulsion system in ISIGHT.

articleTitle: Research on preventive opportunistic maintenance strategy for high-speed railway bogies based on mixed failure rate
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the over maintenance and under maintenance problems of key components of high-speed railway bogie, a preventive opportunistic maintenance strategy based on mixed failure rate is proposed. A mixed failure rate model is established by combining the service age correction factor and the failure rate increasing factor, and the optimal preventive maintenance interval of a single component is determined according to the reliability requirements. Considering the economic correlation between components, the opportunistic maintenance strategy is introduced, and the quadratic interpolation method is used to optimize the reliability threshold of opportunistic maintenance, so as to obtain the optimal opportunistic maintenance cost. The model is solved and analyzed by a specific example, and the maintenance strategy is simulated and optimized by genetic algorithm. The research results show that the opportunistic maintenance strategy can reduce the maintenance times and save the maintenance cost while ensuring the reliability of each component, which verifies the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Importance evaluation model of launch site equipment based on FAHP-entropy weight theory
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of lack of quantitative basis for determining the maintenance priority of space launch site facilities, an equipment importance evaluation method based on FAHP-entropy theory was proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors and scoring criteria for the importance evaluation of space launch site facilities and equipment were designed. Secondly, fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) and entropy method were used to assign subjective and objective weights to the evaluation factors, and then the weights were combined to determine the priority of each factor. Finally, the evaluation index of equipment importance was calculated by linear weighted summation, and the approximate solution of equipment importance was obtained by Monte Carlo simulation. Taking the swing rod system equipment as an example, the importance evaluation results are in line with the reality, and the quantitative basis for the decision-making of its maintenance mode can be provided.

articleTitle: Mechanism analysis of hydrogen induced crack formation in welded joint of X80 pipeline steel
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Hydrogen-induced cracking is one of the most common welding defects in welded joints of high-strength steel. Because of its delayed cracking characteristics, major safety accidents are prone to occur during the use of the structure. Therefore, for analyzing the causes of hydrogen-induced cracking, it is of great significance to study the mechanism of hydrogen diffusion and enrichment in welded joints of pipeline steel. In this paper, firstly, the welded joint of pipeline steel is taken as the research object, the finite element simulation of welding process of X80 pipeline steel considering solid phase transformation, which coupled the heatmicrostructure-mechanical-hydrogen diffusion, is established. It makes the numerical simulation of hydrogen diffusion and enrichment in the whole welding process possible. Then, taking the butt joint of diameter 422mm steel pipe as an example, the groove form of butt joint is designed, and the multi pass welding process is determined. Through the established finite element calculation method, the distribution of residual stress and hydrogen concentration during the welding process are calculated. It is found that the residual stress concentration is obvious at the welded joint, and the tensile and compressive stress changes obviously. Finally, the effects of microstructure, stress distribution and temperature gradient on hydrogen diffusion and enrichment were analyzed. It was found that the stress gradient and temperature gradient played a leading role in hydrogen diffusion at different welding stages. The research results reveal some rules, which can provide technical support for the safety and reliability evaluation of offshore pipeline steel structures.

articleTitle: Application of evidence theory in fatigue reliability analysis for impellers with consideration of hybrid uncertainties
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This paper carries out a fatigue reliability analysis for impellers used in hydraulic pumps, with the consideration of both aleatory uncertainty on the geometric dimensioning, material property, load borne, and epistemic uncertainty on the fatigue strength coefficient and fatigue strength exponent. First of all, the Basquin's law is introduced and utilized as the basis for the fatigue reliability modeling. Afterwards, on the foundation of aleatory uncertainty modeling, a parametric finite element simulation analysis is executed to extract the dispersive characteristics of the strain response combining with the construction of interval model to quantify the epistemic uncertainty of fatigue model parameters. Finally, the fatigue reliability evaluation of the impeller with the hybrid uncertainty of probability-interval is implemented, and the belief and plausibility curves of the impeller fatigue reliability are obtained, respectively. It is found that the reliability evaluation results obtained from the fatigue strain range obeying a lognormal distribution is more conservative, compared with those obtained from the fatigue strain range obeying a Normal distribution. Such an observation can provide guidance for promoting the further reliability design and optimization of impellers.

articleTitle: Cell maximum life cycle based reliability analysis method for wireless mobile networks
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The nodes of wireless mobile networks have mobility, which leads to the change of network topology and signal strength. Connectivity, a classical reliability index, calculated by existing methods based on graph theory often needs to find out all paths in fixed topology, which inevitably have combination explosion problems. With the changes of topological structure over time, a heavier calculation amount arises when the reliability of wireless mobile networks is calculated by existing methods to characterize the whole network as components of nodes and edges at every moment of a working phase. To solve the above problem, a new type of reliability analysis index for wireless mobile networks – the maximum life cycle of network cells, and its assessment model and algorithm are proposed, based on the concept of network cells and considered the network cells as components of wireless mobile networks. Through network cells, the reliability can be represented by cell maximum life cycle when it is relevant to the reliability of the whole network, and the focus is narrowed from whole network to the local part. Finally, the analysis and verification of a UAV(unmanned aerial vehicle) group network show that the proposed index has greatly improved the algorithm efficiency compared with the existing reliability analysis index.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of industrial robot electric drive based on physics of failure
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This paper has determined the main failure modes of the electric drive through investigation and analysis of the structure and working conditions of the drive, and found out the corresponding components. Based on Physics of Failure (PoF), the function corresponding to the main failure modes of the electric drive is established, and based on this, a reliability analysis was carried out, which lays a certain foundation for improving the reliability of the industrial robot drive.

articleTitle: Transient dynamic analysis of spur gear pair in aero engine accessory transmission system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This work finalized a transient dynamic analysis of the spur gear pair of an aero engine accessory transmission system. Modal analysis of two gears is carried out by using Modal module of ANSYS Workbench. Combined with the calculation of the friction excitation frequency, it is judged that the gear structure meets the design requirements of avoiding resonance. The transient dynamic analysis of the gear pair under the rated operating state using Transient Structural module shows that the maximum equivalent stress appears in the spline of the hole. The focus is on tooth flank stress and tooth root stress in two intermeshing gears, and the results of numerical simulation are similar to those of theoretical calculation, which verifies the effectiveness of the finite element numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Learning effect and its applications in production, operation and maintenance: a literature review
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The theory of learning effect has gained great interest as a tool to analyze and predict the performance of individuals or organizations. The unique and beneficial characteristics of learning curve models allow more scientific improvement for the planning, organizing and management activities, thus leading to a more efficient system operation. This review focuses on the applications of learning effect in three areas of industrial engineering, including the production scheduling, operation management and maintenance decision-making. In this review, the concept of learning effect and its development process are briefly introduced. After that, a comparison of different commonly used learning and forgetting effect models is conducted. Furthermore, we review and summarize the application of learning effect in industrial engineering in a more comprehensive way. Finally, the limitations of the current studies and possible practical application are discussed. It can be concluded that learning effect is valuable to be applied in the operation and maintenance process of manufacturing system.

articleTitle: Response modeling and optimization based on sequential experimental design
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the modeling problem of complex mapping relationship between influencing factors and responses, this paper implements a mixed sequential design method based on Voronoi and LOLA. And according to the sample points collected by sequential design, a response model is established combined with the LSSVR method. Through function examples, the effectiveness of the method in different complexity levels, different levels of values and different dimensional spaces is verified. Experiments show that the algorithm has high accuracy in different shapes and different dimensions. Finally, the sensitivity analysis of the algorithm is carried out to explore the influence of the number of points added each time on the accuracy of the final response model.

articleTitle: A novel method of aviation safety prediction based on Lstm-Rbf model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The aviation industry has great economic value. The traditional aviation safety management strategy is mainly “post emergency”, which has been difficult to meet the current needs of intelligent and refined safety management. Therefore, this paper proposes a new aviation safety prediction method based on LSTMRBF (Long and Short Term Memory-Radial Basis Function) neural network model. Firstly, based on SHEL (software, hardware, environment, liveware) accident causativeity theory, an aviation causativeity identification model was established to optimize the key causative events. Secondly, based on LSTM network, the temporal analysis model of causative events was established to predict the change trend of each causative event. Finally, the predicted value of the causative event was substituted into the trained RBF fitting model to obtain the results. For this purpose, we employ survey data collected from a transport aircraft. Result shows that the RMSE (Root Mean Square Error) and MAPE(Mean Absolute Percentage Error) are 6.191 and 4.4321(15% lower than the existing prediction model of temporal series prediction method), which proves the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: User demand analysis based on online review mining for product quality improvement
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Online shopping has been integrated into the lifestyle of people in the contemporary society. Online comments made by users after shopping contain rich information. How to extract valuable information from these massive online review data has become a research hotspot of many experts and scholars. A novel Kano model of the classification indicator system based on online review mining is proposed in this paper, which uses two dimensions of review content depth and user attention to divide the review data into four categories. Meanwhile, through the sentiment analysis, the evolutionary sentiment curve of the comments over time can be obtained. Lenovo R7000P laptop is the research object in this paper. According to novel Kano model based on online review mining, the number of must-be demand samples is 469, the number of one-dimensional demand samples is 308, the number of attractive demand samples is 1938, and the number of indifferent demand samples is 308. Finally, the LDA model is used to analyze the four types of data. And the topic word distribution is output.

articleTitle: Bayesian network based fault tree analysis of ship compass system alternative design
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The ship's compass system is a critical system for ship navigation. Once the compass system fails, accidents such as ship collision and grounding may occur, causing damage to the ship and crew. In the engineering design of ship compass system, some ships cannot meet the requirements from IMO for the configuration of magnetic compass equipment, thus innovative alternative design scheme of ship compass system is adopted. However, there is no adequate analysis method in the field of ship engineering to evaluate the reliability of alternative design scheme of the compass system. In this paper, the Bayesian network analysis method based on fault tree is proposed to evaluate the reliability level of the alternative design scheme of the compass system. The method can identified the key risk points that lead to the failure of alternative design scheme of the compass system, and can suggest improvement for the engineering design method and purchase process, providing important information to improve the reliability of the compass system.

articleTitle: Structural safety assessment of self-elevating offshore wind turbine installation platform under complex environmental loads
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: With the rise of offshore wind power, accurately evaluate the structural safety of offshore wind turbine installation platform under complex environmental loads has become an important topic. In this paper, the loads of a self-elevating offshore wind turbine installation platform under different working conditions are calculated and analyzed, and the load combinations under different working conditions are summarized; Then, the overall strength of the main hull of the platform is evaluated under standing condition and towing condition. The standing condition focuses on checking storm condition and lifting operation condition; Secondly, the strength of leg under standing condition is mainly calculated and analyzed, including the overall buckling calculation of leg, the strength check of leg and the local strength check of pin hole of leg; Finally, the safety assessment of the antioverturning stability of the self-elevating offshore wind turbine installation platform is evaluated. This paper comprehensively evaluates the structural safety of the safety assessment of the antitilting under the combined action of complex loads, and draws some useful conclusions, which can provide engineering guidance for the design and operation of the same type of platform.

articleTitle: Correlation-driven bivariate Wiener process modeling subjects to random effects
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: For many high reliable products, the degradation can be characterized in terms of two performance characteristics (PCs). Under this circumstance, both the degradation rates and degradation volatilities between two PCs are correlated due to the common working environment. However, most studies either assume only one PC for the target product, neglecting the commonly encountered bivariate situation, or fail to capture the inevitably degradation volatility correlation between two PCs. This significantly weaken the accuracy of degradation modeling and remaining useful life (RUL) prediction. To solve the issue, we developed a correlation-driven bivariate Wiener process model subject to random effects. Both the degradation rate and volatility are positive functions of the working stress. The expectation maximization method and the Bayesian algorithm are combined to update the model parameters, based on which the degradation path and RUL are predicted accordingly. A case study about bearing vibrations is carried out for illustrating the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Replacement policy for a single-component machine with limited spares in a finite time horizon
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In a maintenance scheduling problem, the optimal policy obtained by using Markov Decision Process (MDP) can be in a control-limit form, which facilitates both computation and implementation of the optimal control. The optimality of control limit policy (CLP) in one dimension has been proven in different models, but few researchers have explored the existence of multidimensional CLP. Besides, most models on maintenance optimization aimed to minimize the long-run expected discounted or average cost, assuming no constraint on the supply of spare parts. However, in industrial systems, since the lead time of spare parts ordering is sometimes fixed and rather long compared to the length of inspection interval, the total number of available spares in a certain time horizon can be limited. Therefore, it is useful to study the replacement policy with limited spares and in a finite time horizon. In this paper, we consider a discrete-time model where the component of a single-unit machine deteriorates according to a Markovian process and needs to be replaced correctively or preventively by consuming a limited number of spare parts. The objective is to find the optimal replacement policy which minimizes the expected total cost in a finite time horizon. MDP is applied to formulate and solve the three-dimensional optimization problem. Structural properties, especially twodimensional control-limit form of the optimal solution, are studied under certain assumptions. Numerical experiments are performed to verify and explore the behaviors and performance of the optimal policy. Finally, we conclude that the optimal solution is a CLP in health condition of the currently working part, but not necessarily in the remained number of spares. However, the numerical experiments show that the optimal two-dimensional CLP has almost the same total cost rate as the true optimal policy, which will help make replacement decisions in real-world maintenance problems. Keywords-replacement

articleTitle: A novel integrated supply chain scheduling for cost optimization under flexible production and transportation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: With the popularity of customized products, the interaction between the various stages of the supply chain has become more complex and closer. As for the scheduling of the twostage supply chain of production and transportation, current research treated production as a single operation, ignoring the impact of the flexible production process on inventory and transportation, and the overall optimization of the supply chain cannot be achieved. This paper focused on the problem of twostage flexible production and transportation supply chain integrated scheduling and proposed an improved geneticannealing algorithm to minimize the total cost of processing, inventory, transportation, and delivery. We proposed a novel multiple-chromosome encoding method to reflect the information of multiple decisions, including operation sequence, transportation batch, and customer delivery sequence, and a chromosomesrelated linkage crossover operator and a multipoint variation operator were designed on it. Two improvement strategies were used in the algorithm, including strategy of machine selection and strategy of batch optimization. The algorithm weighs the impact of decisions at each stage on total cost from an overall perspective to obtain the optimal combination solutions. Compared with the traditional two-stage scheduling algorithm, the proposed algorithm can save the inventory cost, transportation cost and the delivery cost in different scales of customers and orders. The results proved that the integrated scheduling algorithm can significantly save total cost and improve delivery service.

articleTitle: Multi-state reliability evaluation of meta-action unit based on semi-Markov
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In view of the inaccurate reliability evaluation results caused by the deterioration of parts performance of mechanical equipment, a method of evaluating the multi-state reliability of meta-action unit (MAU) under the coexistence of random failure and wear-out failure is proposed. First, the Function-Motion- Action (FMA) decomposition method is used to obtain meta-action (MA) and corresponding MAUs of mechanical equipment. Then the performance degeneration parameters and reliability evaluation index of MAU are identified through the failure modes of MAU, and the law of performance degeneration is modeled by the multi-state theory when both random failure and wear-out failure coexist. Next, the multi-state transition process of MAU is characterized by semi-Markov model, and the steady-state probability of MAU is evaluated using the Two-point Trapezoidal Integral method. The reliability of MAU is then evaluated according to their performance thresholds. Finally, the reliability evaluation results of this paper are compared with that in the case of random failure and wear-out failure, respectively, and the validity of proposed method in this paper are verified.

articleTitle: Prediction of sound absorption and insulation of automobile acoustic packages based on support vector machine
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In this paper, the support vector machine (SVM) is used to study the sound absorption and insulation performance of automobile acoustic packages. In practice, the engine noise is the main sources of vehicle interior noises, The sound absorption and insulation of the main acoustic package components of engine front wall are analyzed in the process of noise transfer path. Through the analysis of the engine noise transfer path, the input and output of the sound absorption and insulation performance prediction model are determined. Then, the sound absorption and insulation prediction model of acoustic packages based on SVM is established in MATLAB. The relevant experimental data is collected, and divided into training samples and testing samples to train and test the developed model. Finally, the results show that the error between predicted values and real values of engine noise absorption and insulation is small, with the maximum error is less than 1dB. This result indicated that the prediction effect is good. Therefore, the developed SVM model can be effectively applied to the study of automobile acoustic packages.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis and process monitoring design for electron-beam-selective-melting system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: As AM (additive manufacturing) technology develop rapidly these years more and more manufacturers tend to apply this technology to product manufacturing. Although AM technology have many advantages in industrial application, it still faces some vital problems such as forming stability and reliability. In this paper, we choose EBSM(Electron-Beam-Selective-Melting) as our research target and conduct FMEA on it. By researching and analyzing the failure mode as well as the cause of failure, we obtain the FMEA table of EBSM system. From the table we can know that electron gun system are key components for the reliability of EBSM system. Aiming at the weak links of EBSM system, we use experimental data to find which processing parameters can reflect the performance of week points and we propose to use process monitoring technology to observe them. With the process parameters of week points, we can find out the problem in time. So as to improve the quality and reliability of AM components and enhance the process stability.

articleTitle: Sizing prosumer microgrid and EV battery stock for swap stations with reliability constraint
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Transactive energy refers to the two-way electricity trading between the distributed energy resources and the utility grid to achieve economic and environmental benefits. This paper designs a grid-tied microgrid for operating electric vehicle (EV) battery swap stations through onsite renewable generation. Particularly we jointly optimize the EV battery inventory and the capacity of wind, solar and energy storage to minimize the station cost under energy reliability and service quality constrains. The performance of renewables-based battery swap station is examined and compared using hourly capacity factor data of wind turbine and photovoltaics from ten US cities with diverse climate profiles. The study concludes with the major findings as follows. First, reducing the photovoltaics cost by 50% makes the stations to install more solar panels in both sunny and windy cities. Second, in grid-tied mode, reducing the energy storage cost by nearly 90% does not significantly stimulate its adoption in sunny or windy locations.

articleTitle: Research on equipment failure decision algorithm based on generative adversarial network
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Vibration signals are effective ways to manifest the degradation profiles of machinery. The generated vibration signals usually vary from distinct fault modes. Effective analyzing the vibration signals, therefore, can result in an accurate fault diagnosis. In this article, a domain-adversarial variational selfcoding generative adversarial network (DAVAE-GAN) is designed for fault diagnosis by utilizing vibration signals. The proposed model skips the vibration signal pre-processing stage and directly extracts the effective fault features. The classification accuracy of the proposed model reaches 96.90% under different working conditions and 93.91% with different equipment situations, which can help decision-makers to conduct the timely preventive maintenance and avoid the occurrence of unexpected shutdowns due to system failure.

articleTitle: Research on the uncertainty of the forebody inlet of hypersonic vehicle propulsion system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: As an important part of the propulsion system, the front body inlet of the hypersonic vehicle propulsion system has many uncertain factors in the entire design and processing process. In order to comprehensively analyze the influence of the precursor inlet on the propulsion system of the aircraft, the quantitative analysis theory under the condition of random and cognitive uncertainty is studied, and the quantitative method under the random uncertainty is analyzed and discussed. Before analyzing the influence Based on the input parameters of the performance of the bulk intake system, the experimental results of the Monte Carlo uncertainty quantification method, the statistical moment uncertainty quantification method, and the generalized polynomial chaotic uncertainty quantification method are compared to prove the generalized polynomial chaotic uncertainty. The reliability of the quantitative method has completed the research and analysis of the influence of the uncertain factors in the design state on the propulsion performance, thus forming a set of quantitative theory for the uncertainty analysis of the complex system.

articleTitle: Implementation framework of management and intelligent application for product quality big data
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Product quality data gradually enters the era of “big data”, and there is an urgent need to carry out quality data management and intelligent application for the whole life cycle of products. Firstly, the scope of product quality big data is defined in three aspects: life stage, object and type; secondly, the framework of product quality big data management and intelligent application is constructed in the mainline of data acquisition, data representation, data push and data application; finally, four key technologies of management and intelligent application are summarized and proposed: semantic identification, formal modeling, intelligent push and intelligent application. It provides technical guidelines for quality big data management and intelligent application, and is of great significance to promote the standardized management of quality big data, data sharing capacity building and intelligent application level enhancement.

articleTitle: The impact of collaboration and big data application capability on supply chain agility-a chain mediation model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Based on the Synergy Theory, this study constructs a chain mediation model to investigate the impact of internal and external collaboration on supply chain agility under the background of big data. The structural equation model is applied to verify the research hypotheses. The results show that Intra-firm synergy has a positive effect on supply chain agility. Supply chain synergy and big data application capability plays an intermediary role between intra-firm synergy and supply chain agility separately, both of which are the key paths for enterprises to improve supply chain agility. Furthermore, they have chain mediation effect between intra-firm synergy and supply chain agility. The study introduces research opportunities in both academic and industry.

articleTitle: Optimum sizing of economic and grid-outage resilient solar array considering the forecasting of solar project cost and customer load demand
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Solar array, as a kind of renewable energy, is becoming popular because it helps reduce carbon emission, and its capability of providing power resilience during grid outages. In this work, long short term memory networks are utilized to forecast solar array installation cost and customer load demand. Then, a simulation-based approach is developed to optimize solar array investment from both power resilience and economic perspectives. Net present value of total system cost, achieved power resilience and the levelized cost of electricity are jointly considered for evaluating solar array investment options. Case studies are conducted for the households in Texas based on the real data of solar irradiation and grid outages. The results illustrate that both solar array size and its installation time influence the optimization of solar array investment. Customers can gain economic benefits and grid-outage power resilience by investing optimal sized solar arrays after a specific time. The proposed method is able to provide insights about decision making of future investment of solar array.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of piston pump based on gamma process with random effects
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This paper proposes a reliability analysis method for piston pumps based on degradation data and considering individual differences. Based on the application of the Gamma process to build a model of degradation data, the random-effects model was introduced to the model of the Gamma process for the individual differences that exist in the degradation process. On this basis, the basic framework of reliability analysis based on Bayesian approach is studied in this paper, and also the estimation of degradation model parameters is investigated, which contains the establishment of a performance degradation analysis model using Bayesian approach, the estimation of model parameters, the acquisition of posterior distribution and the analysis of reliability of piston pumps.The proposed reliability analysis method is verified by carrying out reliability analysis work on the piston pumps.

articleTitle: Digital transformation risks and countermeasures of small and medium-sized cross-border E-commerce enterprises
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The existing trade platforms for small and mediumsized cross-border e-commerce enterprises can no longer meet the growing demand of business volume, which need to implement digital transformation urgently. By investigating the current situation of digital transformation of small and medium-sized cross-border e-commerce enterprises, this paper identifies and analyzes the potential risks at different stages of the whole life cycle of digital transformation data from the perspective of digital economy, and puts forward risk response suggestions for digital transformation of small and medium-sized cross-border ecommerce enterprises in order to guide the smooth implementation of digital transformation of small and mediumsized cross-border e-commerce enterprises.

articleTitle: Structural stress and modal analysis of escalator truss
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: According to design drawings of an escalator truss, the solid model of escalator truss is established, and the finite element analysis model is built up. Based on the finite element model, strength and stiffness of escalator truss structure is checked according to the application criterions. In order to get more accurate stress results of escalator truss structure, the load conditions and constrains are carefully considered, and the analysis results are more realistic. In order to avoid resonance, modal analysis of truss structure is carried out. The results show that the strength and stiffness of the escalator truss meets the national standard. The main excitation frequencies of the escalator truss are avoided in all modes, and the resonance of the escalator will not occur during operation.

articleTitle: Performance degradation assessment of high speed rotor bearing system of control moment gyroscope based on weighted entropy
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the failure rate of the highspeed rotor bearing system (HSRBS) of the control moment gyroscope (CMG) is relatively high and the early faults are difficult to be detected in the closed-loop system, a performance degradation evaluation method of the HSRBS of the CMG based on weighted entropy is proposed. In this paper, the entropy was used as a measure of local time-domain nonlinear complexity, and a health indicator that characterizes the performance state of the HSRBS of the CMG was defined, which can be used to analyze and evaluate the performance degradation. The proposed method was verified by the historical telemetry data of the two years before the abnormality of the CMG on a certain type of spacecraft. The case analysis showed that the method was effective in evaluating the performance parameters of HSRBS without obvious trend.

articleTitle: Gas turbine vibration monitoring based on K-means clustering and apriori correlation analysis
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aiming at a certain type of gas turbine in a state of high vibration value for a long time under a specific working mode, a vibration monitoring and diagnosis method based on association rule mining is proposed. By analyzing historical monitoring data, using median processing and gray correlation analysis to clean and filter the monitoring data, explore the relationship between gas turbine related parameters and vibration values, and establish a combination of K-means clustering and Apriori association rules Analyze the model and conduct simulation experiments ,Summarized the results of association rules applicable to vibration monitoring of this type of gas turbine, put forward reasonable suggestions for equipment use, and provide technical reference and reference for the safe and stable operation of a certain type of gas turbine.

articleTitle: An online real-time health condition monitoring method for industrial equipment based on OS-ELM
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In recent years, equipment health condition monitoring has an increasingly important impact in the industrial environment, which directly reflects the reliability and availability of the equipment. However, most of the commonly used deep learning algorithms need to be trained after the collection of data is completed, which cannot be trained in real-time and adjust the network structure online; on the other hand, the complex network structure requires a feedback session for parameter learning, which further increases the computation volume and computation time. Therefore, this paper proposes an online real-time health condition monitoring method for equipment based on OS-ELM, which dynamically adjusts the network parameters for the batch increase of data and realizes the real-time calculation of equipment health condition values. In the experimental stage, on the one hand, the feasibility and effectiveness of this method is verified by simulating the scenario that data are acquired batch by batch as time changes through real data sets, and on the other hand, the superiority of this method is verified by comparing it with other commonly used machine learning algorithms.

Index Terms: Activation Function Of The Hidden Layer

articleTitle: Optimization and fatigue life analysis of flexible joint
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Abstract–Taking the solid rocket motor flexible joint as the object, in order to meet its lightweight design and fatigue performance requirements, improve the overall performance of the nozzle. Using nonlinear finite element numerical calculation method. Taking the radial size of the joint as a design variable. Establish a flexible joint optimization model based on design variables, constraints and objective functions. Using response surface screening optimization algorithm, obtain the optimized structure of the variable cross-section flexible joint. Calculation and analysis of joint bearing performance. After optimization, the stress of the variable cross-section flexible joint meet the design requirements, and the mass is reduced by 18.81%. Based on the principle of crack propagation, the fatigue life of the joint is calculated and analyzed by using the numerical calculation method of strain fatigue, meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: A reliability analysis method based on quantile regression and feedforward neural network
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The surrogate model-based reliability analysis method has drawn researchers' studies in recent years. Deep learning is a powerful method to construct a surrogate model. Due to the data's existing noise which will lead to aleatoric uncertainty, this paper proposes the Monte Carlo (MC) quantile regression method to build the surrogate model based on quantile regression and feedforward neural network. During the training process, the quantile levels for different inputs are randomly changed in each iteration. In the prediction stage, the same input is attached with varying quantiles to quantify the aleatoric uncertainty, and the input is attached with quantile level 0.5 to predict the output. Two examples are used to validate the effectiveness of the proposed MC quantile regression method. The results show that the MC quantile regression method can accurately quantify the aleatoric uncertainty and construct an accurate surrogate model to analyze system reliability.

articleTitle: Research on aircraft overhaul task flow and technical requirements analysis based on DoDAF
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In order to adapt to the new changes of maintenance object, maintenance mode and business mode faced by aircraft overhaul, based on the idea of architecture framework, this paper proposes the method of aircraft overhaul task flow and technical requirements analysis, and constructs the overall technical framework with the main line of "defining overhaul top-level task-defining overhaul operation stage-defining overhaul task unit - defining overhaul behavior unit-capturing overhaul technical requirements", The specific activities and methods of each step of requirement analysis are studied. Taking the typical aircraft overhaul process as an example, the view model based on DoDAF is established, and the typical system is selected to discuss the development trend of overhaul technology, which verifies the scientific and effectiveness of DoDAF based aircraft overhaul technology requirement analysis method.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis and electronic products evaluation based on electromagnetic performance parameters
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Electronics are susceptible to many forms of electromagnetic interference sources. Under electromagnetic interference, the reliability of electronic equipment may degrade, leading to a shortened lifetime of electronic equipment. Current product reliability analysis methods usually consider product faults from the perspective of life only and ignore the impact of product failure on performance parameters. In this paper, we proposed a reliability analysis and evaluation method of electronic products based on electromagnetic performance parameters. From the perspective of product electromagnetic performance, this method provides a basis for improving the product function design. By locating the weak part of the product, determining the key performance parameters, modeling electromagnetic performance margin, this method also can evaluate the product performance reliability under electromagnetic interference.

articleTitle: Reliability and importance analysis of multi-state system considering common cause failures
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In this paper, a reliability and importance analysis method for common cause failure (CCF) of multi-state system (MSS) based on multi-valued decision diagram (MDD) is proposed. The MDD model mapped from the reliability block diagram (RBD) decomposes components into the collection of components influenced by the CCF and others with different component state probability vectors. An improved variable sorting heuristic algorithm is proposed to minimize the size of the MDD model by considering the number of component states and causality of common cause groups (CCGs). Through the composite importance measures (CIM), the possible state levels and state probabilities are incorporated into the calculation of MSS component importance. Finally, a case study is illustrated to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Kinematic reliability of a dual-axis driving mechanism for satellite antenna considering joint clearance
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The dual-axis driving mechanism is a space actuating mechanism for the satellite antenna to implement precise guidance and positioning. As a precision mechanism, joint clearance is bound to influence the kinematic accuracy. A kinematic reliability analysis method for a dual-axis driving mechanism considering joint clearance is developed in this study. Firstly, the relationship between the joint clearance and the kinematic parameters of the dual-axis driving mechanism is determined. Secondly, the position error model of the antenna reflector considering joint clearance is built based on the differential kinematics. Then, the mean and covariance matric of the position error is derived analytically. Finally, the kinematic reliability of the mechanism is calculated on the basis of the saddle point approximation. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated by comparison with Monte Carlo simulation.

articleTitle: Remaining useful life predict of battery with serial informer
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In the prediction task of remaining battery life (RUL), processes such as data cleaning and feature selection are often used. In this paper, an end-to-end prediction model, named Serial Informer (SI), is designed based on a deep learning approach. A serial self-attention mechanism is used in the model to calculate sequence correlations as weights for the collected data under different cycle counts of battery charging and discharging experiments, which makes the SI fully use the correlation information between sequences during the model training and learning process to achieve the end-to-end long sequence prediction task. The SI was evaluated using lithium-ion battery data from the NASA Ames Prognostics Data Repository. The experimental results show that SI has good prediction results, and it provides a new solution to the battery RUL prediction problem.

articleTitle: Bayesian online reliability estimation based on two-stage wiener process degradation model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Deteriorate process of products with the effect of various degradation mechanism or complex components often shows a multiphase degradation phenomenon. Misspecification of single-phase degradation model will lead to poor performance. To make full use of degradation signals, a two-stage degradation model considering random effects on deteriorate rate and change time point is established to enhance the accuracy of degradation description and reliability assessment. Online parameter updating and reliability estimation are applied to reflect the equipment status and capability. We also analyze the reliability estimation error that a product with two-stage degradation signals may introduce when change point time has not shown off. Simulation study is conducted to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Pre-warning for overload of airport gates based on multi-sample optimal segmentation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In order to reduce the risk of gate position overload operation, this paper introduces the parallel multi-sample prewarning trigger mechanism of the remaining seats available, their occupancy time and their mutual influence effects complied by regulations for aircraft operation and service assurance. Improved method for the segmentation of the warning grade of the optimal pass-through guarantee is put forward. The error function of the standardized pre-warning indicators performed by the significance check is established. In addition, Data processing system (DPS) software in the paper is used to determine the segmentation of pre-warning threshold in apron operation, and the correlation between the error function and the segment quantity curve has been established to evaluate the timing and level of pre-warning activation. The feasibility of pre-warning trigger mechanism has been verified through examples. The prewarning system of the airport gate load is designed and implemented with the carrier of "Ding-Ding" platform and the oriented-users. XML and Yoloy target detection techniques are used to process communication facility data related to apron warning. Through the evaluation of the original data of the apron communication facilities to improve Changsha Huanghua Airport. The results show that a reliable and convenient pre-warning system is an important auxiliary support for risk control, and the pre-warning mechanism can effectively reduce the overload level.

articleTitle: Research on real-time reliability evaluation of Lithium-ion batteries based on Wiener process
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) are widely used in electric vehicles (EVs), but the reliability of them is still a matter of concern today. In order to address this issue, this paper proposes a real-time reliability evaluation model of LIBs which based on the combination of Wiener process and Bayes' theorem. In this model, the processing and assembly errors in the design and manufacturing process of the LIBs, as well as the performance differences in the same batch of batteries, are taken into consideration, and treat them as random parameters. Then, the degradation parameters detected during different service periods of the battery are incorporated into the model to realize the realtime evaluation of battery reliability. Finally, a case study is conducted to verifies the feasibility and practicability of this model.

articleTitle: Research of critical component identification method for spacecraft dimensional stability based on contribution rate
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Influence of each component in the spacecraft structure on the dimensional stability of the structural system is different. Even in the dimensional stability design under the whole satellite configuration, the influence of each component is different. Identifying components that have a great impact on dimensional stability through the contribution rate defined in this paper, and carrying out targeted dimensional stability design, is conducive to reducing costs, saving time, and focusing on design priorities.

articleTitle: Reliability estimation of ELNs based on multi-layer Bayesian theory
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Explosion logic networks (ELNs) are detonation sequences realized by using the unconventional detonation characteristics of explosives. For removing the restrictions of small sample data of ELNs, the multi-layer Bayesian theory is employed as a basis of that to carry out a comprehensive as well as convincing reliability estimation of ELNs. Firstly, the physical characters of ELNs are analyzed by drawing its control, detonation wave propagation, as well as output state diagrams. Accordingly, the reliability estimation model is designed and the reliability reached by which is computed by the multi-layer Bayesian method after the data of this study was extracted by an experiment.

articleTitle: Prediction and analysis of electric meter failure number based on field fault data
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The prediction of electric meter failure number is helpful to formulate the operation and maintenance management strategy of electric meter scientifically, which is a difficult point in this field. Based on the on-site fault data of electric meters, this paper adopted the Weibull distribution to predict the failure number of a single batch electric meter in the future, forming a prediction method suitable for the failure times of electric meters and the changes of the number of future failures of each batch of electric meters were analyzed and compared over the years. The research results have reference value for making operation plan and reserve strategy of electric meters.

articleTitle: Research progress and development path of network invulnerability of information equipment
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
