abstract: As more and more information equipment is installed in the army, its invulnerability has gradually become an important part of the construction and development of the army. Based on the structural characteristics of the network composed of information equipment, this paper summarizes and summarizes the evaluation methods of invulnerability of undirected unauthorized network, undirected weighted network, directed unauthorized network and directed weighted network in the face of enemy attack in information equipment. Then the characteristics of the four kinds of networks are compared from the aspects of application scope, method measurement and complexity, and several methods to improve invulnerability are summarized. Finally, the future development path is prospected, in order to provide some reference for the invulnerability of information equipment network.

articleTitle: A reliability prediction method of smart meter based on dynamic Bayesian networks
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Smart meters are versatile metering devices and the basic equipment of power grid data acquisition. However, large installation quantity, wide installation area and long detection cycle aroused the requirement that the reliability prediction model with real-time analysis capability should be established to provide the basis for the maintenance and replacement plan of smart meters. Dynamic Bayesian network (DBN) has flexible structure, can update the model parameters according to the real-time information, which can meet the needs of real-time analysis. In this paper, the dynamic Bayesian Networks of smart meter is constructed according to the functional structure firstly. for expressing the degradation processes of functional modules and calculating the reliability curve of smart meter system secondly, the failure rates of functional modules are used to value the dynamic nodes. Finally, the backward reasoning ability of dynamic Bayesian network is used for fault diagnosis, and the weak links order in the smart meter system in different time is determined to provide a reference for the design optimization of smart meter.

articleTitle: Abnormal characteristics capture for thermal power unites before unexpected breakdown based on correlation analysis of operation parameters
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Thermal power generation is the main force of power industry. With the development of communications technologies, more and more power plants are equipped with high-precision sensors, so operating data can be gotten in real time. Therefore, unexpected breakdown detection based on operating data has become an urgent demand under the condition of digitalization. In this paper, an abnormal characteristics capture method for thermal power units before unexpected breakdown based on correlation of operating parameters is proposed. First, the Person correlation coefficient and the Box-Cox transformation are introduced to extract the correlation of the features, and the mutual information is used to screen out the correlation features used as indictor for abnormal characteristics. Secondly, a method based on three-sigma rule and Johnson transform is presented for dynamical feature threshold calculating. At last, a case study is used to illustrate the effectiveness of the method. The results show that the dynamic threshold method can predict the breakdown earlier.

articleTitle: Stochastic model calibration using the Bray-Curtis distance-based uncertainty quantification metric
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In the practical engineering, it is usually unaffordable to conduct multiple full-scale physical experiments due to the budget limit. In such scenario, it is challenging to estimate the key parameters of imprecise probability models given insufficient test data. To address this issue, a stochastic model calibration method is developed in this paper. In the proposed framework, the approximate Bayesian computation method is employed as an efficient tool in which the Bray-Curtis distance is embedded as a novel uncertainty quantification metric. We validate the proposed method via a dynamic numerical case study of three-degree spring-mass system.

articleTitle: Non-contact fault detection based on smart phone: analysis and design
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The detection and diagnosis of rotating machinery faults are of great significance. Although many online detection technologies have been developed, obtaining an accurate estimation of the faults of a complex system is still a practical challenge. Due to economic reasons concerning the cost related to data acquisition and analysis, or due to practical reasons such as the inaccessibility of locations for measurement, noncontacted diagnosis has drawn worldwide attention. In this study, a non-contact portable fault detector based on smart phone is designed using the improved maximum correlated kurtosis deconvolution (IMCKD) technique. The designed fault detector integrates acoustic signal acquisition, IMCKD signal processing technique, fault diagnosis and monitoring into a smart phone, which avoids the traditional sensor placement problemand achieves a real-time heath monitoring and efficient fault detection for rotating machinery. The applications in terms of functionality, flexibility and precision in faulty diagnosis is verified by two case studies with different damage scenarios for a real locomotive rolling bearing.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Smart Meter Based on Multiple Type-I Censored Data
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Smart meter is an integral part of our state smart grid, which involves the interests of millions of households. Reliability evaluation based on operating data is an important problem in the implementation of smart grid operation and maintenance management. In view of the data characteristics of the same type and the same batch of smart meter with multiple Type-I censored data, i.e., unequal time censored data, this paper introduces Weibull distribution to model its failure time data. Then, this paper applies the maximum likelihood method to estimate unknown parameters of the distribution. Moreover, the reliability evaluation model of the smart meter is established, and partial failure data of meters from one region is collected to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation evaluation method of aviation equipment MCSP based on finite state machine theory
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aiming at potential problems such as the lack of process relevance of each mission execution process, and the inability to effectively consider maintenance scenarios and elements in the current aviation equipment multi-section mission completion success probability(MCSP) assessment method, this paper proposes a method for modeling and simulation of the success probability of multi-section missions based on the finite state machine theory, and uses the AltaRica language as the model basis to elaborate on the specific model elements and model simulation principles, and finally builds a basic calculation example with the help of simulation software to verify the application of the model system, modeling method, simulation method and other technical content, and provides effective support for the evaluation of the multi-MCSP of aviation equipment.

articleTitle: Research of multi-source reliability test in the uncertain systems
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Reliability test data reflects the reliability level of various products and provides important information for the subsequent improvement, use, and guarantee of the product. However, the complicated operation process and long test cycle of many reliability tests make it hard to guarantee the quality of test data. Since the lack of usable statistical data, this paper proposes an approach to evaluate multi-source reliability and provides a reference for the related work of the Chinese Academy of Engineering Physics (CAEP) on the quality evaluation of multisource heterogeneous information and the reliability evaluation based on failure information fusion. Firstly, we establish an uncertain tests optimization model (UTOM) by data envelopment analysis (DEA) model. Then, we convert the UTOM into an equivalent deterministic model for easy calculation by the uncertainty theory. Ultimately, a numerical example is to verify this model. Based on its result, we conclude the UTOM can meet the need of evaluating multi-source data scientifically and providing valuable data for product reliability evaluation.

articleTitle: Defensive capability optimization of consecutive k-out-of-n: F system under deterministic risks
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Consecutive k-out-of-n Systems are widely used in practical engineering, including pipeline systems, quality control sampling systems, and vacuum acceleration systems. This paper focuses on how to evaluate the system's defensive capability quantitatively. Under cost constraints, the optimization model of defensive capability for consecutive k-out-of-n: F systems are established. The genetic algorithm based on defensive importance measure is designed to solve the mentioned mathematical model. The results of simulation experiments verify that defensive importance-based optimization algorithm applies to solving the optimal configuration under various risk scenarios, and the distribution laws of the optimal configuration under continuous risk or equal interval risks are summarized.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of multi-task system based on survival signature
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: For a complex multi-task system composed of multiple parallel subtasks, traditional reliability analysis methods will lead to a huge solution scale. Survival signature has great advantages in analyzing the reliability of multi-task systems. We decomposed the complex system layer by layer according to the correlation between each parallel subtask. Uses probabilistic graph model and Bayesian formula to deal with the problem of component sharing. The reliability calculation formula based on survival signature of the multi-task system is derived. We also give a general survival signature-based reliability analysis method for multi-task systems. Finally, the method and its correctness are verified through simple two-task and complex multi-task shared component system cases.

articleTitle: Diagnosis model of prostate cancer based on machine learning algorithm
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Prostate cancer is one of the most common malignant tumors in middle-aged and elderly men. Its incidence has been in the forefront of male malignant tumors, which has caused great harm to human health. How to predict prostate cancer patients and improve the diagnostic efficiency of prostate cancer has always been one of the key issues in the diagnosis of prostate cancer. In this paper, according to the collected data of patients, combined with medical guidelines and expert doctors ' advice, the data cleaning and statistical analysis were carried out, and 28 predictive variables were selected and extracted. These variables have been confirmed to have an impact on the occurrence of prostate cancer, and then a prostate cancer diagnosis model is established based on 4 machine learning methods. Finally, through the verification and evaluation of the model, the optimal prostate cancer diagnosis model is identified, the characteristics are further discussed, and the subsequent optimization suggestions of prostate cancer diagnosis model are given.

articleTitle: An improved heuristic for lower reliability bound evaluation of multistate networks
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Many real networks consisting of components that work at different levels of capacity can be regarded as multi-state flow networks. The reliability evaluation of this kind of networks is an NP-hard problem. Therefore, as the scale of the real network increases, the computational resources for the calculation of the exact value grows exponentially. This leads one to consider its approximated value, namely the reliability bound. Most of the time, decision makers focus on the issue of lower reliability bound (LRB). By inputting one d-MP into the recursive sum of disjoint product (RSDP) method at a time, a series of LRBs can be obtained. At this time, the ordering of minimal path vectors (d- MPs for short) greatly affects the tightness of LRB convergence. This paper proposes an improved heuristic to sort d-MPs and then put them into the union probability calculation. Through three computational experiments, we proved that the proposed heuristic has significant advantages in improving the tightness of LRBs.

articleTitle: Study on reliability prediction of mechanical equipment in nuclear power plant
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Equipment reliability data is an important basis for the safety assessment in Nuclear Power Plant (NPP), as well as the development of operation and maintenance programs. At present, reliability data for safety assessment mainly relies on general data from nuclear power plants. However, in many cases, general data are not be applicable to evaluate the safety of the system, and there is even no general data available. Therefore, we need to consider other reliability prediction methods to deal with such situations. In this paper, the reliability prediction method of mechanical equipment is used. Besides, two equipment of NPP facilities was chosen as case studies. Based on the comparison between the prediction results and general data, it shows that the reliability prediction method of mechanical equipment can provide a useful reference for determining equipment reliability data in NPP.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of temperature transmitter in harsh environment based on failure physics
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The temperature transmitter is one of the most commonly used equipment in many industries and it is rather important to ensure the reliability during the design stage. In this paper, reliability analysis of the temperature transmitter for ethylene cracking furnace of which the environment was quite harsh was carried out. Firstly, the risk priority number method was adopted to perform the failure mode and effects analysis. Thermal and vibration simulations were conducted to investigate the temperature distribution and vibration response of the temperature transmitter in harsh environment. The mechanisms of high temperature oxidation corrosion and high temperature medium erosion of the temperature transmitter were also studied by microscopic and macroscopic examinations as well as fluid simulations. It is concluded that the harsh environment characterized by high temperature and acid-base environment, high vibration, high corrosive media scouring could result in special failure mechanisms for the temperature transmitter. The high temperature of the header and the local resonance of the temperature transmitter should be focused on in the reliability design. The metal material, processing technology and shape characteristics of the armor of the temperature transmitter sensor should be focused on to improve the reliability.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of ram air turbine blade based on AK-MCS algorithm
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The Ram Air Turbine is an important part of the aircraft emergency power and hydraulic system. In this paper, the simulation system of NACA-4418 airfoil, blade chord length and twist are established. Flow Simulation plug-in is used to carry out fluid Simulation analysis on the impeller system, the surface pressure, surface relative pressure, surface shear stress, surface fluid density and velocity of the impeller were analyzed respectively. After fluid simulation of the impeller, the surface pressure and relative pressure are obtained, and the static stress analysis of the impeller in the corresponding environment is further carried out to judge the reliability of its operation. Finally, the reliability of turbine blades is calculated based on AK-MCS algorithm. The results show that the surface pressure of the impeller is affected by the overall structure of the impeller and the number of blades. From the perspective of relative surface pressure, ‘three blades’, ‘five blades’ and ‘seven blades’ have better reliability. Finally, based on AK-MCS algorithm analysis and calculation, the five-blade impeller has the highest reliability.

articleTitle: Relevant degree analysis of machining center component based on relevant failure model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Failure correlation will contribute to increasing failure rate in the presence of machining center system components, how to determine relevant degree among relevant models of system parts is key to make a reliability analysispin failure location and implement reliability growth of equipment system. Based on directed graph of relevant failures, relevant degree calculation problem of system components node has been transformed into important degree calculation problem of complex network node, making transposition of adjacency matrix of directed graph, combining with the pagerank algorithm, relevant degree of directed graph will be solved in machining center system, which will provide guidance for reliability design and maintenance plan.

articleTitle: Performance estimation of explosive logic networks using analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This paper emphasizes applying the analytic hierarchy process method to carry out a comprehensive performance estimation of an ELN for removing the limitations of lacking testing data and existing methods are insufficient to tackle with highly hierarchical structures of the ELN. The hierarchical model of the ELN is firstly constructed from both components as well as function point of view. Then the analytic hierarchy process method was adopted to model the ELN, where the expert's opinion is involved. Accordingly, the performance of the ELN is concluded at the system level, component level until the basic function of each component level. Moreover, the performance of the ELN for accomplishing two waveforms is computed and the detailed analytical results of waveforms are provided.

articleTitle: LSTM and ELM based transfer learning approach for online bearing remaining useful life prediction
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Rolling bearings are important components for mechanical equipment. Approximately 30% of rotating machinery failures are caused by rolling bearing damage according to statistics. These failures may cause serious consequences that are difficult to estimate. In recent years, deep learning has been widely used in bearing remaining useful life (RUL) prediction, and has achieved remarkable results. However, as bearing performance varies dramatically in the late degradation stage, most existing deep learning-based RUL prediction methods have some drawbacks regarding solving this problem. In this paper, a nonlinear fusion transfer learning method based on long-short term memory networks (LSTM) and extreme learning machines (ELM) is proposed to realize online bearing RUL prediction, especially in the late degradation stage. Specifically, since it is easier to obtain offline bearing vibration signal data, we choose it as the source domain data and the online bearing data as the target domain data. Time-frequency domain features in the source domain are extracted firstly. Subsequently, these features are fed to the LSTM and ELM respectively. Then, the prediction results of the two networks are trained by non-linear fusion based on ELM network. Afterwards, the network is transferred to the online bearing to predict its RUL. Comparison experiments are designed and implemented with a public dataset. The experimental results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.
