articleTitle: Research on mechanical reliability analysis based on hybrid uncertain parameter
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: To address the reliability analysis in the presence of mixed uncertainty, i.e. random, fuzzy and interval, this paper propose an uncertain measure-based framework. In the proposed method, different variables are modeled under a unified uncertain framework. In terms of reliability analysis, the concept of reliability index is extended to an uncertain measure-based reliability index and computed via the “response-threshold” model. The proposed method is beneficial in the reliability analysis and evaluation of complex system where the multi-source is not rare.

articleTitle: Research on component parameter library of physics of failure simulation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: As an emerging reliability prediction technology, physics of failure simulation has certain applications in various industries. However, during the application process, it was discovered that this technology has problems such as too many simulation model parameters and long modeling time. In order to solve this problem, through investigation and comparison of domestic and foreign component modeling standards, IPC 782A and MIL-STD-1835D were selected as the data basis to construct a component parameter library, which has been integrated into CARMES. In this way, the efficiency of component modeling is highly improved, the threshold of physics of failure simulation application is lowered.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation of spindle stiffness of railway turnout ballast cleaning machine
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The railway turnout ballast cleaning machine has a very complex working environment, where and the operational loads conditions are extremely harsh on the spindle. The spindle is one of the key parts that cause the malfunction of the ballast cleaning machine, and the failure form of the spindle is insufficient stiffness. So, the stochastic finite element method is applied to analyze the influence of the uncertainty of the structural size, material parameters and external load of the spindle on the stiffness reliability of the spindle, and evaluated the stiffness reliability in this paper. The finite element analysis model of the spindle is simulated by ANSYS software, and the spindle's stress, strain, natural frequency, and mode shape are analyzed. The spindle stiffness reliability model is established, and the stiffness reliability of the spindle is evaluated based on Six Sigma.

articleTitle: Research on product health state assessment method based on fuzzy C-means clustering
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: As there are only two kinds results of product health assessment which are qualified and unqualified, it is impossible to determine the effect of the range change of each product performance indicators. This paper proposes a Fuzzy C-means (FCM) cluster health state assessment method based on sensitive testing data of product. Firstly, in the model training process of the method, the input parameters are obtained by screening sensitive product test data, building characteristic vector and normalization, and then through the FCM clustering analysis, the product sensitive test data are gathered for the two types of normal and fault. In the model application process, the degree of membership of the assessment data with normal clustering center is calculated. Finally, constructing the health status assessment criterion to calculate health status. The model presented in this paper provides a new way of thinking for the research of product health status assessment.

articleTitle: A corrosion fatigue life evaluation method for shipboard aircraft structure with coating
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In corrosive environment, the use of shipboard aircraft has two main characteristics: The main load causing fatigue damage occurs during flight, and flight time is much shorter than the ground parking time. Therefore, failure or accident caused by corrosion damage of shipboard aircraft structure is mainly caused by failure of coating anticorrosion function during ground parking. At present, few quantitative models for the life of organic coatings. And the influence of coating life is seldom considered in the corrosion fatigue test of shipboard aircraft structures with coating. In this paper, the degradation model of the coatings in corrosive environment is established by analyzing the degradation curve of low-frequency impedance of coating, and then the lifetime of organic coating was determined. Then combined with the equivalent damage evaluation method of fatigue damage in corrosive environment, the corrosion fatigue life evaluation method of shipboard aircraft structure with coating protection system is proposed. Compared with the present corrosion fatigue test, this method is more scientific, generalized, and convenient for application.

articleTitle: A novel mixed-effect model for multi-stress accelerated life test evaluation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Multi-stress accelerated life test can be used to solve the life prediction problem of high reliability products in composite environment. The multi-stress accelerated model plays a key role in the multi-stress accelerated life test. Because the damage caused by different environmental stresses to products is not a simple linear superposition, the correlation between different acceleration stresses should be considered. However, most of the multi-stress acceleration models remain in the two-stress model and do not consider the correlation between the stresses. To overcome this problem, we develop a mixed-effect multi-stress acceleration model to consider the correlation between stresses. Then a parameter estimation method based on EM algorithm is proposed and lifetime prediction is calculated. Finally, a real case of intelligent electric meters is used to demonstrate the superiority of the proposed model and method.

articleTitle: Research on designed life simulation verification method of spaceborne attitude and orbit control computer
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Nowadays, the spaceborne attitude and orbit control computer (SAOCC) is considered as the brain of the spacecraft. The failures of the SAOCC could result in a failure of the spacecraft mission. Based on higher expectations of the spacecraft's service life, it becomes more and more urgent to develop an efficient approach to validate the long service life of SAOCC. However, due to the high cost of aerospace products, using physical test methods to evaluate product life significantly increases the R&D costs, which is not conducive to the verification and application of new technologies. In this paper, we propose a life evaluation method for SAOCC based on physics of failure theory and simulation technology. Taking the digital prototype as the evaluation object, we use the proposed method to evaluate the life of the product and locate the potential design flaws. This method provides a new perspective on solving the problem of long-life verification of spacecraft electronic products, and can also provide valuable guidance to the design team in the development phase.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of wind turbine gearbox based on residual neural network
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Gearbox is a key component of wind turbine drive train, and its failure will lead to equipment downtime, economic loss, even threaten to human life. It is, therefore, necessary to perform fault diagnosis on gearbox. In this article, the fault diagnosis of gearbox is performed based on the residual neural network. In the first place, the one-dimensional vibration signal is used as the input signal data, and a residual neural network is applied to extract features for fault diagnosis. A convolutional neural network model is established for comparison. The feasibility of the proposed method and the superiority of the residual neural network are verified by comparing the number of iterations of the two models with respect to the fault identification accuracy, the value of the loss function, and the confusion matrix of the classification results. The results show that the residual neural network model can achieve higher fault identification accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on a system controller fault detection method based on correlation matrix
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In this paper, based on the correlation matrix, the fault detection method of controller is studied based on the fault diagnosis characteristics of environment control and life support system(ECLSS). Combined with the characteristics of actual system fault diagnosis, the reasons for the existence of the feedback loop are analyzed, the different diagnostic effects caused by voltage and current detection methods are compared, and the detection method of breaking the feedback loop by manual testing is proposed. Through modeling and analysis, complete design ideas and methods are provided for improving testability design of controller products, which can help guide Built-In-Test(BIT) design of controllers.

articleTitle: A heat reliability analysis method based on ensemble of deep surrogate models
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: As the complexity of satellite working environment increases, assessing the heat reliability of the satellite remains a challenge. How to perform reliability analysis on the satellite in the design phase is of great value. As a deep surrogate model, neural network has been used in the reliability of complex system. However, the representation ability of a single neural network is limited and cannot give predictive uncertainty to represent the confidence of the model in the output. Thus, this paper uses the ensemble of convolutional neural networks to address these problems. Ensemble of deep surrogate models can not only give more accurate predictions, but also give the predictive uncertainty to judge the quality of the predictions. With a high-precision surrogate model, reliability analysis can be performed more accurately, and the analysis results have more reference value. To demonstrate and verify the effectiveness of the improved method, one satellite temperature field example is employed.

articleTitle: HI construction based on multiple performance indicators with applications in DC-DC power circuit of NPP
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The initial failure signal of the DC-DC power circuit is not obvious and is often covered by noise. The key performance indicators (KPIs) extracted are different in sensitivity to the initial failure and degradation state of the power circuit. When the power circuit is degraded, a single monitoring signal is usually nonmonotonic and cannot accurately reflect the health state of the power circuit. In this paper, a method to fuse the various key performance parameters of the power circuit is adopted for constructing a single Health Indicator (HI). The proposed method is based on the Cumulative Sum of the Mahalanobis Distance (MDCUMSUM). A regression model is trained for predicting the degradation trend of the DC-DC circuit. The experimental results show that the constructed health indicator can better reflect the state of the circuit considering the monotonicity and prognosability.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of wind turbine gearbox based on convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Gearboxes are crucial components of wind turbines, which is costly, hard to repair, and contribute the longest downtime to wind turbines. Fault diagnosis is a feasible and promising technique to analysis and diagnosis the failure properties of the rotational machinery for instance gearboxes. In this paper, The main research is to use CNN to identify the fault of wind turbine gearbox. Initially, on the basis of vibration signals, STFT method is used for obtaining the two-dimensional time-frequency domain signal. Subsequently, Convolution Neural Network is applied to extract failure features. The feasibility of this method is verified by comparing the results of a convolutional neural network powered by one-dimensional vibration signals.

articleTitle: Experimental study on temperature distribution and dynamic variation of an air-cooled proton exchange fuel cells
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The current kilowatt-level air-cooled proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFC) usually use an axial fan to dissipate heat. However, even though the speed of the axial fan is controllable, the temperature at different locations of the stack is significantly different. In this paper, thermal imaging technology is used to study the static and dynamic heat distribution of aircooled PEMFC. The temperature variation at different positions of the fuel cells stack during the step loading of current and the effect of temperature on the cell voltage at different current are investigated. The experimental results indicate that the average temperature variation of the stack is similar with a same loading step from different current. At steady states of different currents, the heat distribution of the fuel cells stack at steady state is uneven and the temperature in the middle part of the stack is ∼10°C higher than that at the edge of the stack. With the increase of load current, the cell voltage uniformity of the stack becomes worse as the temperature distribution becomes more uneven. Therefore, the impact of uneven temperature distribution on stack performance and life of air-cooled fuel cells should be considered at high current densities.

articleTitle: Corrosion life prediction of organic coating by gray model based on low-frequency imdepance modulus
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: When an organic coating is exposed to a corrosive environment for a long period, the combined effects of various factors would result in a gradual declination of the anti-corrosion performance. Therefore, the service life of organic coatings is shortened and the protective effects on the substrate is weakened. However, the coating corrosion process can't be exhibited well by traditional performance parameters. The electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) can be applied to coating impedance analysis, and represents the failure process of the coating. To predict the life of organic coating in the corrosive environment, this paper utilizes the gray theory model and the exponential model for fitting the low-frequency impedance module value. The results indicate that the gray theory model has a better fitting effect than the conventional exponential model. Meanwhile, the gap between predictions and threshold gets narrow when the experimental data is gradually closed to the organic coating life. Thus, the gray theory model is recommended to predict the life of the organic coating.

articleTitle: Failure analysis and design improvement of 'DC / DC converter no output problem' based on FTA
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In this paper, the FTA method is used to locate and analyze a certain aerospace 'DC / DC converter no output problem'. Through fault tree analysis, the mechanical stress damage event of multilayer ceramic capacitor is accurately located, and the detailed mechanism analysis and problem recurrence are carried out. Finally, the problem is solved by replacing the bracket capacitor and optimizing the damping characteristics of PCB.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation of supercapacitors based on pseudo-failure calendar lifetime distribution
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Supercapacitors are new types of electrical energy storage components with an electric double layer. Ageing characteristics, lifetime and reliability evaluation are of great significance for quality evaluation and rational use. This paper focused on the pseudo-failure calendar lifetime distribution and reliability evaluation of supercapacitors. High-temperature accelerated calendar ageing test of supercapacitors is carried out, and equivalent series resistance and capacitance were tested. Pseudo-lifetime is calculated and distribution is fitted. Fitting results showed that the pseudo-lifetime of supercapacitors is more in line with Weibull distribution. Finally, the reliability curve and its bounds with 95% confidence are made, as a result of the reliability evaluation of supercapacitors.

articleTitle: Inference on the Weibull distribution with heavily censored data
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: It is common and difficult to analyze the reliability based on heavily censored data in engineering application. For this problem, an improved method is proposed in this paper under the Weibull distribution based on the Bayesian theory and non-linear regression method with heavily censored data. First, prior distributions for failure probability at each time in sample are set using the Bayesian theory. Next, the hyper-parameters are determined when the information entropy of prior distribution is maximized to compute the Bayesian estimation of failure probabilities at the time in sample. Then, the Weibull parameters are estimated through the distribution curve fitting directly with the non-linear regression method using the data pairs of times in sample and corresponding failure probability estimations. Finally, after the comparison with existing methods by a Monte Carlo simulation study and the illustration of a real data example, the proposed method is proved to be accurate and robust.

articleTitle: Resilience analysis for tightly coupled constellations of teams
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Due to the unrealistic of on-orbit maintenance in space, it is essential to enhance the constellation system's resilience, i.e., the ability of the system to withstand disruptions and return to a normal state quickly. In this paper, we propose a resilience analysis framework for tightly coupled constellations of teams. The maximum revisit interval is used as the key performance parameter of the system in the resilience measure. We first analyze the probability and the effects of the system's operation mode change, and then provide a Monte Carlo method for the system resilience quantification. Finally, a tri-satellite constellation of four teams is used as a case to verify the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Research on fatigue reliability of steel crane girder based on SVM
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Based on the reliability theory of building structure, the fatigue failure reliability of the crane girder structure is calculated and analyzed. To avoid the limitation of the current first-order second moment method and second-order second moment method on the variable function, and avoid the artificial interference of the variable distribution characteristics of the function, the reliability index calculation results are analyzed. In view of the prominent fatigue failure, complex influence variables and a small number of test samples of steel structure crane girder, the SVM support vector machine model calculation method is introduced to generalize the data and regression results to solve the reliability calculation problem. Through comparison in the calculation process, this method avoids the shortcomings of the first-order second moment method and the second-order second moment method and can be used as the basis for determining the value of the partial coefficient used in the partial coefficient method, which plays a guiding role in the calculation of the fatigue failure reliability of the crane girder.

articleTitle: Integrity assessment of Moda crude oil pipeline based on multi in-line inspection datasets
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Scheduled in-line inspection (ILI) has been proved to be the best approach for the integrity assessment of in-service oil and gas pipelines. Corrosion growth rates are essential to identify real active corrosion defects and assess the future integrity of pipeline. However, it is difficult to determine the accurate corrosion rates only based on one single ILI run. Alignment and comparison between multi inspection runs are necessary. In this study, two inspection datasets of Moda crude oil pipeline are aligned and metal loss defects are compared to identify active corrosion and calculate real corrosion growth rates. Raw inspection signals of highlighted defects are reviewed and analyzed. The integrity assessment of this pipeline is performed based on the comparison work.

articleTitle: Study on configuration risk management application of advanced NPP
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This paper combines the requirements of nuclear power plant configuration risk management, and according to the design characteristics of advanced nuclear power plants HPR1000, studies the configuration risk management equipment scope, configuration risk threshold setting, and management measures taking in the implementation of configuration risk management and risk-managed technical specifications (RMTS) application. The relevant suggestions are provided to support the implementation of advanced nuclear power plant configuration risk management technologies.

articleTitle: Reliability assessment of point-absorber wave energy converters based on FMEA
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The implementation of wave energy is considered a clean and inexhaustible energy resource, capable of generating more than 2TW of worldwide energy supply. This study focus on the risk identification and failure modes and effects analysis (FMEA) of point-absorber wave energy converters (WEC) which is one of the most promising solutions among available technologies to convert wave energy. After the establishment of risk framework and FMEA, the crucial failure modes and the priorities of each risks are determined to provide reference for the operations and maintenance of point-absorber wave energy converters.

articleTitle: Solve condition-based replacement and inventory control problem in a K-out-of-N system with the concept of divided-and-conquer
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The maintenance of complex industrial equipment is often modeled as the Markov Decision Process through joint optimization of components replacement and spare inventory control. However, the size of state space is overwhelming for the practical problem, which is intractable for Value/Policy Iteration algorithms. This paper focuses on a K-out-of-N system, where the structure dependencies are emphasized by the model. To tackle the “curse of dimension” problem, we propose a heuristic algorithm with the concept of Divided-and-Conquer. In the “Divided” part, the multiple components and spare inventory are separated into N subproblems. In the “Conquer” part, we integrate the subsystems to make the spare purchase decision, which balances the risk of performance loss and the cost of holding. A numerical study is conducted by analyzing a 2-out-of-3 system. The result shows the satisfactory performance of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Test equipment diagnosis based on fault tree and Bayesian network
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: To ensure the high safety operation of test equipment and improve the diagnosis accuracy, this paper proposes a fusion fault diagnosis method based on the fault tree (FT) and Bayesian network (BN) model. To achieve a more comprehensive and in-depth diagnosis, and adapt to the characteristics of less fault data of the test equipment, the advantages of the FT and BN model are fully demonstrated to yield a combination results of qualitative and quantitative. Finally, the correctness and validity of the proposed model are verified by using a typical test equipment model.

articleTitle: The study of failure characteristics of MCU based on the after-sale reverse analysis
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In recent years, smart door locks including password keyboards, fingerprint recognition and communication function have seen explosive growth, and a large number of enterprises engaged in the manufacture of intelligent home appliances. As a result, there are many after-sales problems, especially the product without power, no reaction phenomenon caused by the failure of the master control chip is relatively common, which greatly affects the user experience. For this, this paper takes mainstream smart door lock products on the market as the research object, and a series of failure analyses and root cause searches are executed to find the reasons for master control chip failure. The research shows that the failure of the intelligent door lock master chip is caused by the static damage of the chip pin due to insufficient static protection, which is directly related to the improper production and assembly process.

articleTitle: Wind turbine reliability analysis with fault-related weighted Bayesian networks
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Due to each component has an unbalanced influence on the reliability of the whole machine during the failure process of wind turbines as well as the multi-fault correlation is complicated, a method for reliability analysis of multi-fault mode correlation failure based on weighted Bayesian networks is proposed. By analyzing the wind turbine fault data, the weight of the wind turbine subsystem is calculated based on the combined weight method of fuzzy analytic hierarchy process, entropy weight method and historical fault maintenance data method, and the reliability of the subsystem is obtained by using the weighted reliability calculation formula; Considering the correlation of subsystem faults and the characteristics of Bayesian graphics and probabilistic reasoning, combined with Copula function model and Bayesian network, a wind turbine reliability model considering fault-related Bayesian network is established. Research shows that the reliability of the wind turbine system is between completely independent and completely correlated faults when weighting is considered, which can provide a reference for the reliability design and optimization of wind turbines.

articleTitle: Multi-source uncertainty analysis on system-level reliability accelerated demonstration test
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: As conventional reliability demonstration test (RDT) can be time and cost prohibitive, reliability accelerated demonstration test (RADT) with harsher-than-normal stress levels is widely adopted for system-level products with high reliability and long life to verify whether they can meet a specified reliability requirement. However, the multi-source uncertainty due to the discrepancy of lifetime distribution and variances of field stress and usage rate could lead to an inaccurate estimation. This paper proposes a mathematical approach on the true demonstrated reliability of the zero-failure system-level RADT and discusses multi-source uncertainty effects. First, we present the RDT model with a Weibull lifetime distribution. Then, the comprehensive acceleration model is derived by synthesizing voltage and temperature stress, as well as usage rate in a time scale. Further, a system-level RADT model is established by connecting system target with unit reliability based on the risk priority number (RPN) method. The analysis method is illustrated using a numerical example on the solid-state drive (SSD), and sensitivity analysis is provided to evaluate the acceleration model and lifetime distribution uncertainty over the field product population.

articleTitle: Research on durability improvement technology of ship power shafting based on torsional vibration
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: According to the structure and working condition characteristics of marine power shafting, this paper establishes a shafting torsional vibration dynamic test-bed, and analyzes the influence of the selection of power source, the design of spring damper, flywheel position, fillet radius and other factors on the torsional vibration fatigue of shafting from four aspects. The dynamic simulation model of torsional vibration of shafting is established, and the motion response of shafting under random excitation is simulated and analyzed. The results show that it is in line with the actual situation. According to the dynamic analysis results, the fatigue life of shafting under different structural factors is further analyzed, and the influences of the design of spring damper, flywheel position, and fillet radius size, fatigue life of shaft, as well as assembly interference and cracks on the fatigue life of shafting are obtained. Finally, the suggestions to improve the durability of shafting are given.

articleTitle: Analysis of the epidemic vaccination evolution through the K-shell decomposition method
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Recently, the novel coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) has been raging around the world. Vaccination is currently the most effective way to control the spread of infectious diseases. In this paper, an epidemic vaccination model based on k-shell decomposition method is established to analyze the influence of vaccination on the spread of infectious diseases from the perspectives of mandatory vaccination and voluntary vaccination. For the compulsory vaccination strategy, the importance of the nodes in the network is sorted by the k-shell decomposition method. And the nodes with greater node importance are forced to be vaccinated. For the voluntary vaccination strategy, the influence of the initially vaccinated node on the remaining nodes is analyzed based on the evolutionary game model. Finally, the numerical simulation experiments are carried out using the USAir network and the Facebook network. The results show that compared to the mandatory vaccination strategy, the voluntary vaccination strategy can achieve a smaller epidemic size when the core number vaccinated is equal. For the Facebook network, vaccinated nodes in the lower layer instead of the higher layer can yield a smaller epidemic size if vaccination is carried out by layer.

articleTitle: Multi-source dynamic time series data processing method based on comprehensive weighted fusion
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the fusion problem of multi-source heterogeneous dynamic data sources, based on the subjective and objective comprehensive weighting idea, an efficient multi-source dynamic data fusion algorithm is proposed. First, the outlier detection method based on linear regression model is used to preprocess the multi-source dynamic time series data. Then, determine the weight of the dynamic data. The prior weight of the data source is determined by the AHP method, cyclic scoring method, etc., and the posterior weight is determined according to the similarity between the time series data. Based on the Euclidean distance, a similarity measure between different data sources and a similarity measure between different dynamic data samples are constructed respectively. The former is used for the fusion of dynamic data standard deviation expectations, and the latter is used for the fusion of mean expectations. Finally, the comprehensive weight of each dynamic time series of each data source is obtained, and the comprehensive weighted fusion method is used to obtain the expected value and standard deviation of the dynamic response. The analysis of the calculation example shows that the proposed algorithm has higher computational efficiency than the method that treats dynamic data as several discrete static data.

articleTitle: Detection method of metal surface defect based on joint-supervision strategy
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Detection of metal surface defect plays an important role in industry field. In order to detect the metal surface defects efficiently, an end-to-end joint supervision strategy defect detection algorithm network is designed, which contains two steps. Firstly, a segmentation network is to learn and train about targets labeled by pixel level. Secondly, a detection network is proposed to detect targets labeled by image level, considering the results of joint segmentation network. The joint loss function is applied to generate segmentation and detection results in the two networks. We have evaluated the proposed algorithm in KolektorSDD-a data set of industrial quality detection. Comparing with the traditional methods, better results in segmentation effect and detection accuracy are presented. The proposed algorithm is highly engineering valuable, and providing a research foundation for metal defect detection in a variety of industrial field.

articleTitle: Product reliability improvement method based on root cause analysis
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Based on the brief introduction of root cause analysis method (RCA), combined with the analysis and improvement process of the sealing performance failure problem of a certain box structure, the important role and broad prospect of the application of RCA in the product reliability problems analysis and improvement are described in detail.

articleTitle: Type-I censored reliability acceptance plan for weibull distributed products by fusing different types of expert information
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The reliability acceptance test (RAT) is to check whether the product meets the reliability requirement. It is essential to choose a test plan with controllable customer's and the producer's risks. The reliability acceptance test adopted from GJB899A always leads to either long test duration or high risks, which makes it more difficult to be applicated. In this paper, a method to calculate the two types of risks by fusing multiple forms of expert information is proposed. The D-S based fusing method is applicated in this method. Then, the test plans with acceptable risks can be further derived. The proposed method is applied to a case study and the results verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Comprehensive hazard analysis of heavy CNC machine tools based on fusion fault correlation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Risk priority number analysis is often used in the hazard analysis of small and medium-sized CNC machine tools. Due to the lack of fault data and difficulty in tracing the source of heavy CNC machine tools, the reliability of traditional RPN analysis is reduced and lacks practical reference value. In response to this problem, this paper analyzes the fault correlation between machine tool subsystems based on the laboratory decision-making method (DEMATEL) and the House of Reliability (HoR), and introduces the “trapezoidal fuzzy number” to process the expert evaluation results to obtain a comprehensive hazard analysis of the machine tool. Compared with the traditional RPN analysis, the comprehensive fuzzy RPN analysis results of the fusion fault correlation are more in line with the actual situation, which provides a reference for the formulation of heavy machine tool maintenance strategies and lays a foundation for improving its reliability.

articleTitle: A dynamic friction moment calculation method of an angular contact ball bearings
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Angular contact ball bearings (ACBs) are widely applied in various precision rotational systems due to the simple structure, high speed and high rotation accuracy. Most current works have analyzed the friction moment of ACBs under the assumption that the contacts in the contact zones are pure rolling. However, in actual applications, the balls and rings will be slipping relative to each other. Under high speed conditions, the relative slip in the contact zones are obvious. Moreover, the relative slip will have a manifest influence on the friction moment and the contact forces in the contact zones. Thus, it's unreasonable to assume the contacts in the contact zones are pure rolling under high speed conditions. This work proposed a dynamic friction moment calculating method for an ACB considering the skidding in the contact zones based on the quasi-dynamic model. In the model, the gyratory motion and relative slip in the contact zones are considered. The contact forces are obtained by the quasi-dynamic model. The sliding friction moments caused by the differential slip (DS), the rolling friction moments caused by EHL (elastohydrodynamic lubrication) rolling resistance, the rolling friction moments produced by the EMH (elastic material hysteresis) and viscous friction moments generated by the gas-oil mixture are calculated. Moreover, the sliding friction moment caused by the differential slip is calculated by the elastohydrodynamic lubrication theory. The friction moments computed by Palmgren method and the proposed method are analyzed to prove the accuracy of the proposed method. The influence of inner ring speed on the contact forces, contact angle and the ACB friction moment are studied. The results suggest that the proposed method can give a more accurate and effective way to calculate the ACB friction moments.

articleTitle: Using MLD to identify the weak links for the civil construction quality of the HTGR spent fuel storage facility
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: As the new Generation IV of high temperature gas cooled reactor nuclear power plant(HTGR), HTGR is upcoming nuclear fuel loading. HTGR is known for its excellent inherent safety. The quality of construction is an important factor for the safety of HTGR. Hence, how to ensure the quality and safety during the construction has been focused on in the process of HTGR construction. This paper presents the work using master logic diagram(MLD) to identify the weak links for the civil construction quality of the HTR-PM spent fuel storage facility. In the work, the MLD will be used to establish the process of the construction logic in order to find the potential weak links which will be modified to guide the preparation of construction programmes. It turns out to be a good experience to understand that risk tools are not limited to the calculation of the risk metrics of Nuclear Power Plant such as Core Damage Frequency(CDF), it has a wide range of applications. From the perspective of system engineering, it solves: what can go wrong, what's the consequence and what's the likelihood.

articleTitle: Numerical investigation on the ultimate strength assessment of a box girder with initial deflection
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: To explore the moment-carrying capacity of a box girder with flexural deck after internal explosion, extensive nonlinear finite element analyses have been performed on the box girder model as well as the corresponding upper-deck structure with initial deflection. The dimensional variable was set as 0, 0.02, 0.05, 0.08, 0.1, 0.12 and 0.15 respectively to evaluate the effect of deformed degree on ultimate strength of the box girder. It was shown that the dominant deformation mode was transformed from compression to bending. The flexural rigidity and ultimate bending moment decreased by 34% and 32% respectively compared to the model with no initial deformation. The plastic ultimate moment almost decreased linearly with the increase of initial deformation. The fitting curve as well as its expression of the effective section area reduction coefficient were drawn according to stress equivalence principle. The fitted curves in the two models show a similar trend with a few minor differences and it was applicable to assess the box girder model with the reduction formula obtained from the stiffened plate model which was safer in the considered regime.

articleTitle: Numerical study on the ultimate bearing capacity of a liquid hydrogen cylinder at room temperature and low temperature
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: China is actively developing liquid hydrogen fuel heavy trucks with the rapid development of hydrogen industry. Liquid hydrogen cylinders are pressure equipment for storing liquid hydrogen fuel. They bear internal pressure load caused by temperature rise in working process, and burst failure by internal pressure may occur under extreme conditions. Therefore, the research on the ultimate bearing capacity of liquid hydrogen cylinders is of great significance to ensure the safety of liquid hydrogen cylinders. In this paper, internal pressure ultimate bearing capacity of a vacuum insulated double-layer austenitic stainless steel liquid hydrogen cylinder with a nominal volume of 500 L is studied by finite element numerical simulation considering geometric nonlinearity, material nonlinearity and contact nonlinearity both at room temperature of 20°C and low temperature of -160°C. The results show that the ultimate internal pressure bearing capacity of the inner vessel of the liquid hydrogen cylinder at -160°C is 2.10 times of that at room temperature; the inner vessel contacts with the outer vessel after large plastic deformation, then the outer vessel and the inner vessel bear the internal pressure load together, which improves the overall ultimate internal pressure bearing capacity of the liquid hydrogen cylinder; the overall ultimate internal pressure bearing capacity of the whole liquid hydrogen cylinder at -160°C reaches 18.98 MPa, which is 1.28 times of that of its inner vessel at the same low temperature and 1.61 times of that of the whole cylinder at room temperature.

articleTitle: Remaining useful life prediction of bearings based on GCN and Bi-LSTM
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Bearing remaining useful life (RUL) prediction plays an important role in the field of industrial equipment health management. How to improve the accuracy of bearing RUL prediction has become one of the research topics today. The traditional RUL prediction method needs to manually extract the degradation features of the bearing, and the model lacks the ability to actively extract the feature, so the accurate mapping relationship between the bearing vibration signal and the RUL cannot be obtained. This paper proposes a bearing RUL prediction model based on GCN and Bi-LSTM. The model extracts the correlation relationship between the feature parameters of the bearing vibration signal through GCN, and extracts the feature information of the bearing state through Bi-LSTM to make a judgment on the current state. The experimental results of bearing RUL prediction show that the GCN-Bi-LSTM model proposed in this paper can accurately predict RUL compared with LSTM and Bi-LSTM models, and the method has certain application value.

articleTitle: Damage quantification in composite laminates using phased-array ultrasound
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Multilayer composite materials are prone to delamination damage under local impact load, which leads to a sharp decline in structural strength and a severe weaken of carrying capacity. It is extremely important to conduct low-speed impact damage experiments on composite laminates and quantitatively assess the degree of damage. It is of great significance to ensure the structural performance and reliability evaluation of the product by carrying out damage detection on key components in the manufacturing process. Combined with phased-array ultrasonic detection technology, a threedimensional reconstruction technique is proposed to carry out nondestructive testing and damage quantification of composite laminates. A set of quasi-static indentation experiments with different displacement was carried out on four carbon fibers reinforced epoxy matrix composite plates with the same manufacturing parameters. The geometric information of the detection plate and the setting parameters of the detection equipment was used to perform three-dimensional reconstruction. The intuitive imaging of the plate damage was obtained using the ultrasonic inspection data. The damage can be identified and located utilizing the ultrasonic data, and it can be quantified by the 6dB-drop method. Impact damages size and impact energy is connected to establish a prediction model for impact damage size. The effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper is verified by comparing the experimental results and the microscopic measurement results of the damage cross-section.

articleTitle: A novel design for wireless and flexible damage detection using guided waves
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Most of the structural damage detection approaches available in the Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) literatures require direct contact between targets and the sensors since the collect data have to transfer to the data processing and diagnosis hub. These methods are found predominantly feasible for offline SHM systems; however, wiring in an online SHM has been found to be arduous. In this study, with ceramic powders and graphene conductive particles introduced, a flexible piezoelectric transducer is fabricated by tape casting process. Then, a wireless transducer system based on magnetic resonance coupling is design to achieve a non-contact guided wave transmission. Two coils, one of which makes direct electrical connection to the flexible transducer and the other of which is connected to the input channel of the receiver are designed to perform the wireless transmission. The guided wave signal generated by the flexible transducer can be wirelessly transferred from the transducer coil to the receiver coil based on magnetic resonance coupling concept. The prototype of the proposed wireless guided wave system is used to demonstrate the effectiveness of the guided wave signal transmission. The results indicate that the developed wireless transducer system provides a potential method for SHM using guided waves. Moreover, the developed integrated transducer with lowcost and small size can be attached to the detected structure without long wires, which will enhance the robustness and convenience of defect detection.

articleTitle: A biofuel risk management model for biomass-based heat sources considering supply-demand-side uncertainties
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Biofuel-based heat sources are gradually penetrated into heating systems in Northern China in the background of carbon neutrality. It is essential to conduct biofuel risk management study, not only for enhancing the ability of continuous heat supply for heating systems, but also improving the ability of effective cost control. A biofuel risk management model is thus proposed innovatively for biomass-based heat sources considering supply-demand-side uncertainties. The developed model integrates Chance-constrained programming, Two-stage stochastic programming and the traditional linear programming into a general framework. After that, the developed model is applied in to a real heat-source case of biofuel risk management under uncertainties and the corresponding solutions on biofuel risk management are generated. The beneficial results of biofuel allocation pattern can be obtained for decision-makers to provide the fuel management support under different risk levels. Besides, a trade-off analysis between the constraint-violation risk and the system cost can also be provided to conduct in-depth analysis.

articleTitle: Are replacement last policies always better than replacement first policies?
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This paper considers a simple age-based replacement problem where the arrival of replacement opportunities follows a homogeneous Poisson process. Iskandar and Sandoh (2000) extended the seminal opportunity-based age replacement in Dekker and Dijkstra (1991) by introducing the opportunities in restricted duration, and dealt with the replacement first policies. In this paper, we formulate the replacement last policies for Iskandar and Sandoh model in the sense of Zhao and Nakagawa (2012). It is shown that the corresponding optimal replacement last policies are trivial, so they can be reduced to the existing age-based replacement policies

articleTitle: Research on incentive mechanism of major project subcontractor considering social responsibility
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Social responsibility is significant to the sustainable development of major projects. Aiming at the problem that major project subcontractors are not actively fulfilling their social responsibilities and have serious opportunistic behaviors that lead to low project efficiency, this paper started from the perspective of incentive mechanism design and used principalagent theory to establish a sub-bidding incentives model which considering fairness preferences. The results show that compared with the single subcontractor incentive model and the multi-bid incentive model that does not consider fairness preference, subcontractors' social responsibility effort level and engineering efficiency are significantly improved in the case of the sub-bidding incentive model considering fairness preference. Furthermore, the social responsibility efforts increase with the perceived fairness of subcontractors, decrease with the cost factor, the degree of risk avoidance and the size of the subcontractor's risk. Reasonable mechanisms can effectively restrict the opportunistic behaviors of subcontractors, improve social responsibility and engineering effectiveness. The research conclusions provide theoretical methods and decision-making basis for the sustainable development of the major projects and the contract design of improving the social responsibility of stakeholders.

articleTitle: Analysis of the failure modes and causes of the IPM module
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Abstract–The plastic integrated circuits have been applied widely in the electronic components nowadays. With the enormous production and application of the plastic integrated circuits, the reliability of plastic integrated circuits had been brought to the forefront of the semiconductor industry. This paper taken an IPM module as the test devices, to analysis the main failure modes and causes of the IPM module through a certain analysis process, included the common DPA, FA and optical microscopy techniques, to make sure of the quality and reliability of the IPM module satisfied the national standard or industry standard.

articleTitle: State of health estimation for Lithium-ion battery based on fusion features
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: An accurate battery state-of-health can effectively avoid the safety problems caused by lithium-ion batteries. In this paper, a novel feature extraction method based on autoencoder is proposed. First, measured features as well as calculated features are extracted from the battery current and voltage parameters as the initial feature set. Then the parameters which has low correlation to battery SOH in the initial feature set are removed. Finally, the remaining features are fused with an autoencoder to obtain the target feature set. The proposed feature extraction method is validated in a public dataset, and the results shows that the proposed method improves the SOH estimation accuracy by at least 26% compared to the current feature extraction method.

articleTitle: Life evaluation of optocoupler based on accelerated model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: As a weak-strong electric control component, the optocoupler is widely used in the power grid industry. Its service life directly determines quality and transmission efficiency of the power grid, so how to evaluate the service lifetime becomes very important. In this research activity we focused on an optocoupler from a power grid company. By analyzing the sensitive stress that leads to its degradation, four groups of accelerated life tests based on hot flash is designed, and the test data are analyzed through mathematical modeling. The outfield life of the actual working conditions is extrapolated and the results show that this method can accurately predict the optocoupler life.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of CNC boring and milling machine based on FMECA and optimized RPN method
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: CNC machine tools have excellent performances such as high quality, high efficiency, and high reliability, and occupy an important position in its equipment manufacturing industry. They are called modern work machines. FMECA and RPN analysis have become an important part of the reliability analysis of CNC machine tools. Take a CNC boring and milling machine as the research object to analyze its functional principle and mechanical structure. On this basis, the fault data of CNC boring and milling machine is analyzed by FMECA and optimized by RPN analysis. The two methods analyze the CNC boring and milling machine, find out the weak links of the machine tool, and then carry out further maintenance to achieve the purpose of reducing the failure of the machine tool. The results show that the results of the two methods are basically the same, and the high-incidence parts of machine tool failures can be found more accurately, which provides a basis for subsequent machine tool repairs and maintenance.

articleTitle: Development of evaluation indicators for nuclear power unit risk monitoring and management software
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Nuclear energy plays a crucial role in the carbonconstrained world. In China there are a total of 62 nuclear power units, 51 of which are into operation in 2021. Nuclear safety is the top priority in the development of nuclear energy. Risk assessment and prediction are done in parallel at the beginning of the design of nuclear power plants. Two probabilistic safety targets which are Core Damage Frequency(CDF) and Large Release Frequency(LRF) should be evaluated and demonstrated to fulfill the regulatory requirements prior to granting the operating license, and risk monitoring and management will last for the whole lifespan of nuclear power units.

articleTitle: Uncertainty analysis of virtualized systems with live migration
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Benefiting from the advantages of virtualization technology, virtualized systems have been widely studied and adopted in enterprise systems, aimed at reducing resource usage and enhancing system reliability. An important feature of virtualized systems is the virtual machine (VM) live migration, which brings convenience to transfer running VMs from one physical server to another without service interruption. To achieve a high available/reliable virtualized system, it is crucial to evaluate its system availability/reliability. The model-based approach is commonly used and proved effective. However, it is well-known that the model parameters typically involve estimation error due to the limitation of data samples or expert's knowledge, so-called uncertainty. In this paper, we analyze the uncertainty propagation in the availability model of a virtualized system with live migration through a momentbased approximation method. A numerical experiment is conducted to quantify the impact of the parameter uncertainty on the system availability.

articleTitle: Failure mechanism analysis and reliability evaluation of wind turbine pitch control system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In recent years, the new clean energy mainly based on wind energy has been developed rapidly, and the reliability of wind turbines has also received more and more attention. In view of the problems existing in the current reliability evaluation, such as dependence on failure data and lack of understanding of failure mechanism, a reliability evaluation method based on failure mechanism tree is proposed in this paper and the reliability evaluation of wind turbine pitch control system is completed with consideration of the correlations of the failure mechanisms, which is achieved by combining the system failure mechanism and failure behavior from the perspective of performance parameters

articleTitle: Topology optimization study of complex spatial transposition mechanism with nonlinear characteristics
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the lightweight design of the space station transposition mechanism with nonlinear characteristics, a topological optimization analysis model is established, and the force-displacement curve of the local nonlinear structure is obtained based on the finite element simulation, The equivalent stiffness of the structure is also solved according to the working conditions of the actual structure, which can be well consistent with the test results. Further, the variable density topology optimization analysis method (SIMP method) is proposed and the weight reduction design of the intermediate bracket of the space station indexing mechanism is carried out. Finally, The structural weight reduction reaches 24%, and it achieves the purpose of lightweight design of the space station transposition mechanism, which illustrates the effectiveness of the proposed method. Thus, the topology optimization analysis method with local nonlinear characteristics established in this paper provides a solution for the lightweight design of the space station transposition mechanism, and also provides a reference for the topology optimization of other structural mechanisms with nonlinear characteristics.

articleTitle: Ergonomics reliability evaluation of HMI design considering special circumstances based on improved SPAR-H and CRITIC
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Under special environment, the ergonomic reliability of human machine interface (HMI) was evaluated by improving the standard plant analysis risk-human reliability analysis (SPAR-H) method. In our improvement process, the ergonomic reliability evaluation method of nucleic acid extractors is improved according to the basic idea of SPAR-H, the secondary index of Performance Shaping Factors (PSFs) is constructed, and a new PSFs system is proposed. Secondly, subjective weight and objective weight are obtained by combining grey correlation analysis (GRA) and introducing the Gini coefficient modification method. Then the new PSFs multiplier was modified by combining subjective and objective weights, and the ergonomic reliability was evaluated based on SPAR-H. Eventually, according to the statistical verification of man-machine reliability experiment results, the proposed method is verified by statistics.

articleTitle: Uncertainty optimization design of hypersonic vehicle propulsion system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Hypersonic aircraft refers to an aircraft whose flight speed exceeds 5 times the speed of sound, which can be divided into winged and non-winged aircraft. Because of its huge military value, many scholars from various countries have gathered here. However, the current research is mainly based on the traditional method, namely the design optimization of a single discipline and goal. However, there are many uncertainties in the design, research and manufacturing of aircraft propulsion systems. This paper proposes an optimization method for multidisciplinary reliability design of aircraft propulsion system. Because the design and optimization of aircraft propulsion system is a multidisciplinary coupling and systematic optimization problem, the propulsion system is divided into three parts, namely the front body/intake duct, the isolation section/combustion chamber, and the rear body/exhaust nozzle. From the perspective of economic cost and performance, they are divided into precursor aerodynamics disciplines, combustion chamber propulsion disciplines and quality disciplines. In this paper, the deterministic and reliability-based multidisciplinary design optimization of the aircraft propulsion system is mainly conducted. The conclusion is that the reliability-based multidisciplinary optimization results are better than the deterministic results, and reliable design results are obtained.

articleTitle: Reliability concept and measure of an unmanned aerial vehicle swarm
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In this paper, the hierarchy and characteristics of an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm are analyzed, and the three basic faults are presented: the entity fault, information transmission fault and process fault. Based on the causes and criteria, the concept of swarm reliability is defined, and a measurement model of mission reliability is constructed. This provides a basis for further research into UAV swarm reliability and a method for the evaluation of UAV swarm mission completion ability.

articleTitle: A method for reliability analysis based on active learning
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The surrogate model-based reliability analysis method has received a lot of researches. Deep learning (DL) is a powerful method for building a surrogate model. However, DL needs a lot of training data to train the neural network model, which will lead to higher computational cost. Thus, this paper develops a method to reduce the amount of training data based on active learning. By quantifying the epistemic uncertainty of neural network, the most uncertain data will be selected and added to the training dataset. Then, the neural network model is iteratively trained based on the updated training dataset. The reliability analysis of a truss structure is used to validate the developed method, and the result shows that the developed method can apparently reduce the amount of training data.

articleTitle: Research on supply chain risk evaluation based on clustering method
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This paper presents a supply chain risk evaluation and prediction model based on K-means clustering and LightGBM classifier. Supply chain risk evaluation and prediction is an important problem. With the development of economic globalization, market competition is not the competition between enterprises as in the past, but the competition between supply chains. The model takes many variables such as market environment factors, resource constraints, transportation network factors and management factors as inputs. The data we used is a supply chain data set of an equipment group, which covers many variables such as market environment factors, resource constraints, transportation network factors and management factors. After the supply chain risk evaluation based on K-means clustering, the model is classified by LightGBM to generate the prediction model, and the effectiveness of the model is verified on the real data set. The results of K-Means cluster evaluation show that supply chain risk can be divided into four categories: market environment problems, resource constraints, transportation network problems and management problems, among which market environment problems and resource constraints are the most frequent.

articleTitle: Reliability modeling and analysis of lunar patrol probe moving subsystem
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: In order to effectively assess reliability index of the mission process of lunar patrol probe moving subsystem, aiming at the characteristics of multi-task phase of space products and the shortcomings of traditional reliability modeling, a reliability assessment method based on the joint modeling of event sequence model is proposed, and the reliability modeling of different mission stages is obtained. The reliability of multi-stage mission process and the statistical inference of failure probability of components are carried out. The results indicate that the proposed method provides an effective technical support for the development of lunar patrol probe moving subsystem.

articleTitle: Prediction of reliability degeneration of composite structures under hygrothermal environment
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel degradation model of mechanical properties of composite structures under hygrothermal environment, and develops a procedure of predicting the reliability degeneration. The influence of moisture concentration, temperature and the long-term effects of hydrolysis are considered in the degradation model. The structural distribution of moisture concentration is calculated using Fick's diffusion law and finite element analysis. The hygrothermal expansion is considered using classic laminate plate theory. The reliability index is calculated using first-order reliability method. Numerical examples are presented to demonstrate the validity of the degradation model and reliability degeneration prediction procedure.

articleTitle: System mission reliability test environment construction method based on function operational scenarios
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: This article proposes a specific method for constructing a system mission reliability test environment based on function operational scenarios, including the analysis of the function operational scenario of the system mission reliability test, the environmental condition demand analysis of the system mission reliability test, and the system mission reliability test. Environmental design, etc., and verify the effectiveness of the method through application examples.

articleTitle: Motion reliability and sensitivity of folding wing based on BP-ANN
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: The methods for motion reliability and sensitivity of folding wing deployable mechanism are established based on BPANN (Error Back Propagation Artificial Neural Networks) and Sobol indexes. Dynamic principle and failure modes are studied of this kind of mechanism as well as its function indicator and influence factors. It is also developed that the usage of BP-ANN in folding wing deployable mechanism function indicator. Besides, the expressions of variance based Sobol indexes are deduced. An engineering-used folding wing deployable mechanism is analyzed as a case by which the validity of proposed methods is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Microstrip reliability assessment under high temperature in 5G application
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Owing to high output power in 5G Active Antenna Unit(AAU), much more energy transform to heat for the sake of power amplifiers’ efficiency loss. This article study high temperature reliability of printed circuit board(PCB) microstrip based on accelerated aging theory. At the beginning, the study background was given and major reliability related parameter was discussed. Then mission profile experiment was specially designed based on refinement temperature distribution. After that PCB with different line width was manufactured with common material. Preconditioning was execute when start the ageing test. Finally the samples’ parameters were measured by standard method. The test data showed that the material used in AAU can withstand temperature as higher as 145°C for 10 years, the adhesion force measurement result was lager than 2ib/in, and that characteristic impedance changing after aging test was also acceptable.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of fatigue performance of compensation wire rope for elevatoraper
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering (QR2MSE 2022)
abstract: Based on the fatigue life test method of steel wire ropes, this paper studies the fatigue performance reliability of elevator compensation steel wire ropes in actual field applications, so as to improve the reliability of wire rope field application and elevator operation safety. First, according to the actual field application of a certain type of wire rope combined with the equivalent test form, the life testing machine is calculated to have a loading force of 7.5KN and a bending fatigue number of 1.5 million times; then, pretension is applied to the wire rope to eliminate residual stress, and then the wire rope is subjected to 1.5 million bending fatigue life test. The analytical test results are: after the wire rope has completed 1.5 million bending fatigue tests, the measured comparison value of the wire rope diameter and the initial diameter is 98.08%, the elongation rate is 0.14%, the total broken wire is 0, and the worst lay length is 0. The worst strand is 0, adjacent broken wires are 0, the number of broken wires within one twist pitch is 0, and there are no obvious signs of wear and broken wires on the surface. The test results prove that this type of elevator compensating wire rope has very good fatigue performance reliability. The research in this paper is expected to provide an important reference for improving the reliability of wire rope field application and elevator safe operation.
